raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Lets MuseSpark Open (816B-A42B) serve on **Ampere (sm80)** with the AutoRound INT4 checkpoint `intel-ai/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-INT4`, using route-major Marlin WNA16 experts. Stacked on #61879 (`muse-spark-support` @ `6cc692b`). Before this, the NVIDIA path in #61879 required Hopper (route-major) or Blackwell (FlashInfer TRT-LLM) and accepted only NVFP4/BF16 checkpoints.

Commit 1 is the same fix as PR A: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62068, which targets `main`. It is included here because INT4 output is garbage without it. Drop it on rebase once PR A lands.

## Claims

- MuseSpark INT4 (AutoRound/INC, `auto_round:auto_gptq` packing) loads and serves on 8x A100-80G at TP8:
  - 47.6 tok/s at 1 stream;
  - 628 tok/s aggregate at 32 concurrent;
  - 865,400 KV tokens at 32k context.
- MoE block output matches an fp32 reference: cos-sim 0.99999 for BF16 experts (layers 0, 1) and INT4 experts (layer 5).
- Quality on sm80:
  - arithmetic 10/10;
  - perplexity 1.21;
  - needle retrieval pass at 17,847 tokens;
  - images 4/4;
  - audio WER 0.06 / 0.10 / 0.00 on 3 LibriSpeech clips (with an audio-aware system prompt).
- The RoPE cos/sin cache is sized by `max_model_len` instead of the 1M-token config, which frees about 11.5 GiB per GPU at TP8.
- Route-major experts (Triton BF16, Marlin NVFP4/WNA16) run on any non-Blackwell CUDA GPU. Blackwell still uses FlashInfer TRT-LLM.
- `MuseSpark1xForCausalLM` accepts `INCConfig` and `AutoGPTQConfig`:
  - symmetric int4/int8 only;
  - act-order and asymmetric checkpoints are rejected with `NotImplementedError`.

## Validation

**Setup:**

| | |
|---|---|
| GPUs | 8x A100-80G PCIe; NVLink in pairs (0-1, 2-3, 4-5, 6-7), PCIe between pairs |
| Driver / CUDA | R570, CUDA 12.9 wheels (toolkit 12.9) |
| Software | torch 2.13.0+cu129, transformers 5.21.0.dev0, vLLM built from this branch for sm80 |
| Checkpoint | `intel-ai/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-INT4` (466 GB, local copy) |

**Serve command** (`serve.sh` with its defaults expanded):

```bash
VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-12.9 \
vllm serve /ephemeral/muse-int4 --served-model-name muse-spark-int4 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 --max-model-len 32768 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.92 --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --kv-cache-memory=5543755776 \
  --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image":4,"video":0,"audio":1}' \
  --reasoning-parser muse --tool-call-parser muse --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
```

`/ephemeral/muse-int4` is a local copy of `intel-ai/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-INT4`. `--kv-cache-memory=5543755776` is 5.16 GiB per GPU, the headroom vLLM reported for TP8 with fp8 KV.

**Unit tests** (CPU, `--noconftest`): **30 passed**.

```bash
python -m pytest -v --noconftest \
  tests/kernels/moe/test_routed_experts_per_expert_gate_up.py \
  tests/kernels/moe/test_muse_spark_wna16_config.py \
  tests/kernels/moe/test_muse_spark_moe_deployment.py
```

The first two files are new; `test_muse_spark_moe_deployment.py` is from #61879.

**Lint:** `ruff check` and `ruff format` (ruff 0.14.0) are clean on all 4 commits. mypy and the full pre-commit suite were not run.

**Numerics.** Forward hooks captured MoE block inputs and outputs on rank 0 (TP8, 12-token prompt). These were compared to an fp32 CPU reference built from the checkpoint, with int4 dequantized from `qweight`/`scales`:

| Layer | Experts | cos-sim without commit 1 | cos-sim with commit 1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | BF16 (Triton route-major) | −0.07 | 0.99999 |
| 1 | BF16 (Triton route-major) | not measured | 0.99999 |
| 5 | INT4 (Marlin WNA16) | −0.11 | 0.99999 |

Pooler, router logits and pre-expert norm already matched at cos 1.0 without commit 1.

**Throughput and KV capacity.** `bench.py`: 512 output tokens, `ignore_eos`, temperature 0, streaming. Columns c8 and c32 are per-stream / aggregate tok/s.

| Config | KV tokens (max conc. @32k) | c1 tok/s | c8 | c32 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TP8, bf16 KV, util 0.92, text-only | 370,044 (11.29x) | 48.2 | 33.1 / 262.9 | — |
| TP8, bf16 KV, util 0.92, MM | 312,099 (9.52x) | 48.2 | 34.1 / 271 | 19.9 / 634 |
| TP8, fp8 KV, util 0.92, MM | 388,827 (11.87x) | 47.6 | 32.9 / 261.7 | 19.7 / 624.8 |
| TP8, fp8 KV, `--kv-cache-memory` 5.16 GiB, MM | 865,400 (26.41x) | 47.6 | 32.0 / 254 | 19.0 / 605 |
| TP4×PP2, fp8 KV, MM | 1,048,201 (31.99x) | 44.2 | 17.6 / 140 | 11.6 / 370 |
| **This 4-commit series**, TP8, fp8 KV, 5.16 GiB, MM | **865,400** | **47.6** | **32.4 / 257** | **19.7 / 628** |

- Rows 1–5 ran on the pre-split tree: the same code plus VM-only debug instrumentation. The last row is the exact 4-commit series with the serve command above.
- Mean TTFT at c1 was 0.082–0.105 s.
- GPU memory used: 76,239 MiB per GPU (text-only, bf16 KV) and 79,327 MiB per GPU (fp8 KV, 5.16 GiB) of 81,920 MiB.

**Quality:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Arithmetic word problems (10, exact match) | 10/10 in every config |
| Dickens passage perplexity | 1.21 (fp8 KV) / 1.22 (bf16 KV) |
| Needle retrieval, 17,847 prompt tokens | pass (fp8 KV configs, TP4×PP2, this series) |
| Images | 4/4: tabby cat; Eiffel Tower → Paris; exact invoice OCR (`INVOICE #48213 … Total due: $1,274.50`); two-image prompt |
| Audio, 3 LibriSpeech clips, 16 kHz | WER 0.06 / 0.10 / 0.00 with an audio-aware system prompt. The only differences are "Mr." vs "MISTER". Content questions answered correctly |
| Smoke prompts | coherent: factual QA, code, translation |

## Details

**Commits:**

1. **`[Bugfix][MoE] Keep per-expert gate/up halves separate under stacked mappers`** (same as PR A: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62068)
   - `LlamaModel.hf_to_vllm_mapper` stacks per-expert `gate_proj` / `up_proj` into `gate_up_proj` and sets `shard_id`.
   - `RoutedExperts.load_weights` then chunks each half as a fused tensor, so `up` overwrites `gate`.
   - The fix restores the name from `shard_id` for per-expert names only.
   - This is the root cause of the garbage output (see the numerics table).
2. **`[Model] MuseSpark: size the RoPE cache by max_model_len`** (`model.py`, +3/−4)
   - The cache was sized by `max(config.max_position_embeddings (1M), max_model_len)`: a 1M-entry fp32 cos/sin cache per RoPE layer, about 11.5 GiB per GPU at TP8.
   - The first load OOMed during Marlin repacking at 78.15 GiB allocated per GPU.
   - The rotary embedding is unscaled `RotaryEmbedding`, so positions never exceed `max_model_len`.
   - This commit could equally be a review suggestion on #61879.
3. **`[Model] MuseSpark: route-major experts on pre-Blackwell CUDA (Ampere/Ada)`** (`muse_moe_runner.py`, +15/−4)
   - Replaces `is_device_capability_family(90)` with `_use_route_major_on_this_gpu()` (CUDA and not ≥ sm100) in `MuseSparkUnquantizedFusedMoE` and `MuseSparkModelOptNvFp4FusedMoE`.
   - Nothing in the route-major path is Hopper-specific.
   - BF16 experts (layers 0 and 61 of the INT4/NVFP4 checkpoints) now run on `TritonExperts`.
   - NVFP4 can use Marlin W4A16 on sm75+, matching vLLM's generic ModelOpt NVFP4 Marlin fallback.
4. **`[Model] MuseSpark: GPTQ-format INT4/INT8 experts (AutoRound/INC, GPTQ) on Marlin`** (+210/−4, including a 53-line test)
   - `MuseSparkWNA16FusedMoE(AutoGPTQMoEMethod)`: route-major Marlin experts. The MuseSpark post-expert-norm finalize is attached in `process_weights_after_loading`. Requires SwiGLU.
   - `_inc_experts_bits` resolves per-expert bit widths from AutoRound `extra_config`. The checkpoint lists its BF16 experts (layers 0 and 61) individually, and those layers fall back to `MuseSparkUnquantizedFusedMoE`.
   - Symmetric int4/int8 only. Act-order and asymmetric checkpoints raise `NotImplementedError`.
   - `MuseSparkRoutedExperts.load_weights` sends per-expert HF tensors (`<E>.<proj>.<param>`) through the per-expert mapping in `RoutedExperts`. The consolidated NVFP4/BF16 path is kept for stacked tensors.
   - `MuseSpark1xForCausalLM.supported_quantization_configs` gains `INCConfig` and `AutoGPTQConfig`.
   - New test: `tests/kernels/moe/test_muse_spark_wna16_config.py`.

**Why INT4 on Ampere:** NVFP4 activations and the TRT-LLM MoE kernels are unavailable on A100/A800. The INT4 W4A16 checkpoint (466 GB) fits on 8x80 GB with room for the KV cache. The NVFP4 checkpoint (533.0 GB) does not.

**Limitations:**
- **Custom all-reduce is unavailable on this topology.** vLLM refuses custom all-reduce on more than two PCIe-only GPUs, and here NVLink only joins pairs. That applies at TP8 and at TP4, so PyNCCL is used. TP4×PP2 gives more KV (1.05M tokens) but about 45% lower throughput.
- **Audio needs a system prompt.** With no system prompt, 2 of 3 clips got "I don't have the ability to listen" even though the audio tokens reach the model. This is model behaviour, not a vLLM bug, and belongs in the model recipe.
- **Private DeepGEMM pin.** #61879 pins a private `Inferact/DeepGEMM` fork that could not be fetched (tarball 404 / clone hangs). For this build it was stubbed by pointing `DEEPGEMM_SRC_DIR` at an empty directory. The sm80 path ran end to end without it, but the pin itself has to be fixed in #61879.
- **NVFP4 on sm80 is unlocked by commit 3 but not run end to end.** The checkpoint needs about 73 GiB per GPU for weights alone at TP8, which leaves no KV room at util 0.92.
- **Fused paths not available on Ampere.** The FlashInfer TP-MoE finalize and the CuTe-DSL finalize are unavailable, so the native/Triton finalize is used. FP32 router input is off (`HAS_ROUTER_OUTPUT=False`).
- **Not tested:**
  - non-INC GPTQ MuseSpark checkpoints (shared code path, but no checkpoint available);
  - INT8;
  - Ada (sm89);
  - video input.
- **Docs.** #61879 has no supported-models or recipe entry for MuseSpark yet. Once it does, add: INT4 (AutoRound/GPTQ) on sm80+ via Marlin, and NVFP4 on sm75+ via Marlin W4A16 (memory permitting).

**AI assistance:** This PR was submitted by a human reviewer with the assistance of [Digby.ai](https://digby.ai), which was used for debugging, benchmarking scripts and drafting. The human author reviewed all changed lines.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [ ] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [ ] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Benchmark the fused Muse-Spark QK-norm + RoPE + KV-insert kernel vs unfused.
+
+``tuned_us`` forces the cp.async schedule ``fused_qk_norm_rope`` only auto-selects
+on SM 9.0; ``unfused_us`` is what production runs.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import itertools
+
+import torch
+
+import vllm._custom_ops as ops
+
+HEAD_DIM = 64
+DEFAULT_TOKENS = [1, 8, 64, 256, 1024, 4096, 8192, 16384, 32768, 65536]
+
+try:
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.nvidia.ops.cute_dsl.qk_norm import (
+        qk_norm,
+        supports_qk_norm,
+    )
+
+    HAS_CUTEDSL = supports_qk_norm(torch.bfloat16, HEAD_DIM)
+except ImportError:
+    HAS_CUTEDSL = False
+
+
+def make_cos_sin_cache(max_pos, rotary_dim, base, device):
+    inv_freq = 1.0 / (
+        base
+        ** (
+            torch.arange(0, rotary_dim, 2, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+            / rotary_dim
+        )
+    )
+    t = torch.arange(max_pos, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    freqs = torch.einsum("i,j->ij", t, inv_freq)
+    return torch.cat((freqs.cos(), freqs.sin()), dim=-1)
+
+
+class Case:
+    """Everything a single (num_tokens, config) measurement needs."""
+
+    def __init__(self, num_tokens, nq, nkv, dtype, kv_cache_dtype, device):
+        self.num_tokens = num_tokens
+        self.nq, self.nkv = nq, nkv
+        self.dtype = dtype
+        self.kv_cache_dtype = kv_cache_dtype
+        self.eps = 1e-5
+        self.block_size = 128
+        self.rotary_dim = HEAD_DIM
+
+        self.qsz, self.kvsz = nq * HEAD_DIM, nkv * HEAD_DIM
+        self.row = self.qsz + 2 * self.kvsz + self.qsz  # [q | k | v | o_gate]
+        self.qkv = torch.randn(num_tokens, self.row, dtype=dtype, device=device)
+        self.pristine = self.qkv.clone()
+
+        max_pos = 32768
+        self.cos_sin = make_cos_sin_cache(max_pos, self.rotary_dim, 500_000.0, device)
+        self.positions = torch.randint(
+            0, max_pos, (num_tokens,), dtype=torch.int64, device=device
+        )
+
+        num_blocks = (num_tokens + self.block_size - 1) // self.block_size + 1
+        storage = torch.uint8 if kv_cache_dtype != "auto" else dtype
+        self.kv_cache = torch.zeros(
+            num_blocks,
+            nkv,
+            self.block_size,
+            2 * HEAD_DIM,
+            dtype=storage,
+            device=device,
+        )
+        self.k_cache, self.v_cache = self.kv_cache.transpose(1, 2).split(
+            HEAD_DIM, dim=-1
+        )
+        self.slot_mapping = torch.randperm(
+            num_blocks * self.block_size, dtype=torch.int64, device=device
+        )[:num_tokens]
+        self.k_scale = torch.tensor(1.0, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+        self.v_scale = torch.tensor(1.0, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+        self.ones = torch.ones(HEAD_DIM, dtype=dtype, device=device)
+        self.q_fp8 = torch.empty(
+            num_tokens, self.qsz, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn, device=device
+        )
+        self.q_scale = torch.tensor(0.37, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+
+    def views(self):
+        q, k, v, _ = self.qkv.split([self.qsz, self.kvsz, self.kvsz, self.qsz], dim=-1)
+        return q, k, v
+
+    def fused(self, use_rope=True, quant_query=False):
+        ops.fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert(
+            self.qkv,
+            self.positions,
+            self.nq,
+            self.nkv,
+            HEAD_DIM,
+            self.eps,
+            cos_sin_cache=self.cos_sin if use_rope else None,
+            rotary_dim=self.rotary_dim if use_rope else 0,
+            slot_mapping=self.slot_mapping,
+            kv_cache=self.kv_cache,
+            block_size=self.block_size,
+            kv_cache_dtype=self.kv_cache_dtype,
+            k_scale=self.k_scale if self.kv_cache_dtype != "auto" else None,
+            v_scale=self.v_scale if self.kv_cache_dtype != "auto" else None,
+            q_fp8_out=self.q_fp8 if quant_query else None,
+            q_scale=self.q_scale if quant_query else None,
+        )
+
+    def separate_query_quant(self, use_rope=True):
+        self.fused(use_rope)
+        ops.scaled_fp8_quant(self.qkv[:, : self.qsz], scale=self.q_scale)
+
+    def _insert(self):
+        _, k, v = self.views()
+        ops.reshape_and_cache_flash(
+            k.view(-1, self.nkv, HEAD_DIM),
+            v.view(-1, self.nkv, HEAD_DIM),
+            self.k_cache,
+            self.v_cache,
+            self.slot_mapping,
+            self.kv_cache_dtype,
+            self.k_scale,
+            self.v_scale,
+        )
+
+    def unfused_rope(self, token_heads_per_warp: int = -1):
+        ops.fused_qk_norm_rope(
+            self.qkv,
+            self.nq,
+            self.nkv,
+            self.nkv + self.nq,  # v heads plus the o-gate
+            HEAD_DIM,
+            self.eps,
+            self.ones,
+            self.ones,
+            self.cos_sin,
+            False,
+            self.positions,
+            token_heads_per_warp,
+        )
+        self._insert()
+
+    def unfused_nope(self):
+        q, k, _ = self.views()
+        qk_norm(q, HEAD_DIM, self.eps)
+        qk_norm(k, HEAD_DIM, self.eps)
+        self._insert()
+
+    def fused_bytes(self):
+        el = self.qkv.element_size()
+        cache_el = self.kv_cache.element_size()
+        read = (self.nq + 2 * self.nkv) * HEAD_DIM * el
+        write = (self.nq + self.nkv) * HEAD_DIM * el
+        cache = 2 * self.nkv * HEAD_DIM * cache_el
+        return self.num_tokens * (read + write + cache)
+
+
+def _l2_bytes(device) -> int:
+    return torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device).L2_cache_size
+
+
+def _peak_bandwidth(device) -> float:
+    """Measured large-copy bandwidth, in GB/s -- the practical ceiling."""
+    n = 1 << 28  # 256 Mi elements = 512 MiB each way at 2 bytes
+    a = torch.empty(n, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+    b = torch.empty_like(a)
+    for _ in range(3):
+        b.copy_(a)
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    start, end = torch.cuda.Event(True), torch.cuda.Event(True)
+    start.record()
+    iters = 20
+    for _ in range(iters):
+        b.copy_(a)
+    end.record()
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    ms = start.elapsed_time(end) / iters
+    return (2 * a.numel() * a.element_size()) / (ms * 1e-3) / 1e9
+
+
+def time_eager(fn, warmup=20, iters=100) -> float:
+    for _ in range(warmup):
+        fn()
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    start, end = torch.cuda.Event(True), torch.cuda.Event(True)
+    start.record()
+    for _ in range(iters):
+        fn()
+    end.record()
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    return start.elapsed_time(end) / iters * 1e3  # us
+
+
+def time_graph(fn, warmup=10, iters=50, inner=32) -> float:
+    """GPU time per call; ``inner`` calls per graph amortize the ~2 us replay."""
+    side = torch.cuda.Stream()
+    side.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    with torch.cuda.stream(side):
+        for _ in range(warmup):
+            fn()
+    torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(side)
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        for _ in range(inner):
+            fn()
+    for _ in range(3):
+        graph.replay()
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    start, end = torch.cuda.Event(True), torch.cuda.Event(True)
+    start.record()
+    for _ in range(iters):
+        graph.replay()
+    end.record()
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    return start.elapsed_time(end) / (iters * inner) * 1e3  # us
+
+
+def main():
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    p.add_argument("--nq", type=int, default=32, help="query heads per rank")
+    p.add_argument("--nkv", type=int, default=4, help="kv heads per rank")
+    p.add_argument("--kv-cache-dtype", default="auto", choices=["auto", "fp8"])
+    p.add_argument("--dtype", default="bfloat16", choices=["bfloat16", "float16"])
+    p.add_argument("--tokens", type=int, nargs="*", default=DEFAULT_TOKENS)
+    p.add_argument("--csv", default=None)
+    p.add_argument("--no-graph", action="store_true")
+    p.add_argument(
+        "--query-fp8", action="store_true", help="compare fused Q quantization"
+    )
+    args = p.parse_args()
+
+    device = "cuda"
+    dtype = getattr(torch, args.dtype)
+    if args.query_fp8:
+        if args.kv_cache_dtype != "fp8":
+            p.error("--query-fp8 requires --kv-cache-dtype fp8")
+        timer = time_eager if args.no_graph else time_graph
+        print(f"device: {torch.cuda.get_device_name()}; nq={args.nq}, nkv={args.nkv}")
+        print("layer,tokens,separate_us,fused_us,speedup")
+        rows = []
+        for use_rope, nt in itertools.product([True, False], args.tokens):
+            case = Case(nt, args.nq, args.nkv, dtype, args.kv_cache_dtype, device)
+            separate_us = timer(lambda c=case, r=use_rope: c.separate_query_quant(r))
+            case.qkv.copy_(case.pristine)
+            fused_us = timer(lambda c=case, r=use_rope: c.fused(r, quant_query=True))
+            row = (
+                "rope" if use_rope else "nope",
+                nt,
+                separate_us,
+                fused_us,
+                separate_us / fused_us,
+            )
+            rows.append(row)
+            print(f"{row[0]},{nt},{separate_us:.3f},{fused_us:.3f},{row[4]:.3f}")
+        if args.csv:
+            import csv
+
+            with open(args.csv, "w", newline="") as f:
+                writer = csv.writer(f)
+                writer.writerow(
+                    ["layer", "tokens", "separate_us", "fused_us", "speedup"]
+                )
+                writer.writerows(rows)
+        return
+    peak = _peak_bandwidth(device)
+    print(
+        f"device: {torch.cuda.get_device_name()}   measured copy peak: {peak:.0f} GB/s"
+    )
+    print(
+        f"config: nq={args.nq} nkv={args.nkv} head_dim={HEAD_DIM} "
+        f"dtype={args.dtype} kv_cache={args.kv_cache_dtype}\n"
+    )
+
+    modes = ["rope", "nope"]
+    l2 = _l2_bytes(device)
+    print(
+        f"rows marked * have a working set inside the {l2 / 2**20:.0f} MiB L2, "
+        "so their bandwidth is not an HBM number\n"
+    )
+    header = (
+        f"{'layer':>5} {'tokens':>7} {'fused_us':>9} {'unfused_us':>11} "
+        f"{'tuned_us':>9} {'speedup':>8} {'GB/s':>8} {'SOL%':>6}"
+    )
+    rows = []
+    for mode, use_graph in itertools.product(modes, [False, True]):
+        if use_graph and args.no_graph:
+            continue
+        if mode == "nope" and not HAS_CUTEDSL:
+            print("skipping the NoPE baseline: CuTe-DSL qk_norm unavailable")
+            continue
+        label = "graph" if use_graph else "eager"
+        print(f"── {mode} layer, {label} ──")
+        print(header)
+        timer = time_graph if use_graph else time_eager
+        for nt in args.tokens:
+            case = Case(nt, args.nq, args.nkv, dtype, args.kv_cache_dtype, device)
+            use_rope = mode == "rope"
+            fused_us = timer(lambda c=case, r=use_rope: c.fused(r))
+            baseline = case.unfused_rope if use_rope else case.unfused_nope
+            unfused_us = timer(baseline)
+            tuned_us = (
+                min(timer(lambda c=case, t=t: c.unfused_rope(t)) for t in (4, 8))
+                if use_rope
+                else unfused_us
+            )
+            nbytes = case.fused_bytes()
+            gbps = nbytes / (fused_us * 1e-6) / 1e9
+            sol = 100.0 * gbps / peak
+            resident = "*" if nbytes < l2 else " "
+            print(
+                f"{mode:>5} {nt:>7} {fused_us:>9.2f} {unfused_us:>11.2f} "
+                f"{tuned_us:>9.2f} {tuned_us / fused_us:>7.2f}x {gbps:>8.0f} "
+                f"{sol:>5.1f}%{resident}"
+            )
+            rows.append((mode, label, nt, fused_us, unfused_us, tuned_us, gbps, sol))
+        print()
+
+    if args.csv:
+        import csv
+
+        with open(args.csv, "w", newline="") as f:
+            w = csv.writer(f)
+            w.writerow(
+                [
+                    "layer",
+                    "timing",
+                    "tokens",
+                    "fused_us",
+                    "unfused_us",
+                    "tuned_us",
+                    "gbps",
+                    "sol",
+                ]
+            )
+            w.writerows(rows)
+        print(f"wrote {args.csv}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+    )

+    assert swa_table.shape == (num_seqs, num_window_blocks)
+    assert swa_max_len == window + block_size - 1

+        torch.arange(num_seqs, device=device, dtype=torch.int32),

+        swa_max_len,

+        "auto",
+        "NHD",
+        0.0,
+        one,
+        one,
+        None,
+        partition,
+        1,
+        window,
+    )

+    ref = torch.empty_like(query)
+    for i, length in enumerate(seq_lens_list):
+        blocks = block_table[i, : (length + block_size - 1) // block_size].long()
+        keys = key_cache[blocks].reshape(-1, num_kv_heads, head_size)[:length]
+        values = value_cache[blocks].reshape(-1, num_kv_heads, head_size)[:length]

+            values[max(0, length - window) :],

+        )

+def make_norm(
+    cls,
+    *,
+    has_weight=True,
+    zero_centered_gamma=True,
+    is_post_norm=True,
+    eps=EPS,
+):
+    norm = cls(
+        HIDDEN,

+        is_post_norm=is_post_norm,
+        zero_centered_gamma=zero_centered_gamma,

+            )

+def make_residual_boundary(rows, *, post_input_scale=False):
+    post_norm = make_norm(
+        MuseSpark1xRMSNormWithInputScale if post_input_scale else MuseSpark1xRMSNorm,
+        has_weight=post_input_scale,
+        is_post_norm=True,
+        eps=1e-8,
+    )
+    pre_norm = make_norm(MuseSpark1xRMSNorm, is_post_norm=False)
+    connection = MuseSpark1xNormPreservingResidualConnection(HIDDEN).cuda()
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        connection.gate.copy_(torch.linspace(-0.9, 0.9, HIDDEN, device="cuda"))
+    connection.materialize_coefficients()
+    branch = torch.randn(rows, HIDDEN, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    stream = torch.randn(rows, HIDDEN, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    boundary = MuseSpark1xResidualStream(
+        stream=stream,
+        branch=branch,
+        post_norm=post_norm,
+        connection=connection,
+    )
+    return boundary, pre_norm
+
+
+def reference(norm, x):
+    """The same norm in fp64, weight and all."""
+    x64 = x.double()
+    weight = norm.weight.double()
+    if norm.zero_centered_gamma:
+        weight = weight + norm.gain_center
+    if norm.applies_weight_before_norm:
+        x64 = x64 * weight
+        return x64 * torch.rsqrt(x64.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + EPS)
+    normed = x64 * torch.rsqrt(x64.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + EPS)
+    return normed * weight
+
+
+def rel_err(got, ref64):
+    return (got.double() - ref64).abs().max().item() / ref64.abs().max().item()

+    x = torch.randn(num_tokens, hidden, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 3
+    w = torch.randn(hidden, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.1
+    ref = fused_rmsnorm_fwd(x, w, 1e-6, gain_center=1.0, input_scale=input_scale)

+    assert take_expanded(first.clone(), top_k) is None
+    assert take_expanded(first, top_k - 1) is None

+            router_score_division_eps=DIVISION_EPS,
+        )
+        runner = FusedMoEFactory(
+            num_experts=num_experts,
+            top_k=top_k,
+            hidden_size=hidden_size,
+            intermediate_size=intermediate_size,
+            renormalize=True,
+            router=router,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix="moe.experts",
+            params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            scoring_func="sigmoid",
+            e_score_correction_bias=expert_bias,
+            routed_scaling_factor=ROUTE_SCALE,
+            routed_experts_cls=MuseSparkRoutedExperts,
+            runner_cls=MuseMoERunner,
+            runner_args={"post_expert_norm": norm},
+        )
+    runner.cuda()
+    routed = runner.routed_experts
+    loaded = list(routed.load_weights(list(ckpt.items())))
+    assert len(loaded) == len(ckpt)
+    routed.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(routed)
+    experts = routed.quant_method.moe_kernel.fused_experts
+    assert experts.post_gemm2_hook is runner.post_expert_finalize
+    assert isinstance(runner.post_expert_finalize, MusePostExpertFinalize)
+    assert not runner.post_expert_finalize.pre_norm_all_reduce
+    return router, runner, vllm_config
+
+
+def run_moe(runner, vllm_config, x, logits):
+    with set_current_vllm_config(vllm_config), set_forward_context(None, vllm_config):
+        return runner.forward(hidden_states=x, router_logits=logits)
+
+
+def assert_cudagraph_replays(runner, vllm_config, x, logits, next_x, next_logits):
+    """A captured forward replayed on new inputs matches an eager forward."""
+    with set_current_vllm_config(vllm_config), set_forward_context(None, vllm_config):
+        # FlashInfer autotuning must happen before capture.
+        for _ in range(3):
+            runner.forward(hidden_states=x, router_logits=logits)
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+
+        x_static, logits_static = x.clone(), logits.clone()
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+            out_static = runner.forward(
+                hidden_states=x_static, router_logits=logits_static
+            )
+
+        expected = runner.forward(
+            hidden_states=next_x, router_logits=next_logits
+        ).clone()
+        x_static.copy_(next_x)
+        logits_static.copy_(next_logits)
+        graph.replay()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out_static, expected)
+
+
+def swiglu_moe_ref(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    w13: torch.Tensor,
+    w2: torch.Tensor,
+    topk_weights: torch.Tensor,
+    topk_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    norm_fn: Callable[[torch.Tensor], torch.Tensor],
+    act_quant: Callable[[torch.Tensor], torch.Tensor] | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """fp32 SwiGLU MoE with ``norm_fn`` applied to each BF16 expert output."""
+    out = torch.zeros(x.shape, dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device)
+    for e in range(w13.shape[0]):
+        token_idx, slot = (topk_ids == e).nonzero(as_tuple=True)
+        if token_idx.numel() == 0:
+            continue
+        gate, up = (x[token_idx].float() @ w13[e].float().t()).chunk(2, dim=-1)
+        inter = F.silu(gate) * up
+        if act_quant is not None:
+            inter = act_quant(inter)
+        y = norm_fn((inter @ w2[e].float().t()).to(torch.bfloat16)).float()
+        out.index_add_(0, token_idx, y * topk_weights[token_idx, slot, None])
+    return out

+"""Hopper coverage for MuseSpark's NVFP4 Marlin and BF16 Triton experts."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from tests.kernels.moe.muse_spark_utils import (
+    assert_cudagraph_replays,
+    make_runner,
+    nvfp4_quant_config,
+    run_moe,

+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.experts.marlin_moe import MarlinExperts
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.experts.triton_moe import TritonExperts
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.marlin_utils_fp4 import (
+    is_fp4_marlin_supported,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.nvfp4_emulation_utils import (
+    dequantize_to_dtype,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.common.layers import MuseSpark1xRMSNormWithInputScale
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+if not (current_platform.is_device_capability_family(90) and is_fp4_marlin_supported()):
+    pytest.skip("Requires an SM90 GPU with Marlin", allow_module_level=True)
+
+E, N, K, TOPK, M = 8, 256, 512, 2, 8
+
+
+def _build(checkpoint: dict[str, torch.Tensor], quant_config=None):
+    norm = MuseSpark1xRMSNormWithInputScale(
+        K,
+        eps=1e-8,
+        has_weight=True,
+        is_post_norm=True,
+        zero_centered_gamma=True,
+    ).cuda()
+    norm.weight.copy_(torch.linspace(-0.2, 0.2, K, device="cuda"))
+    expert_bias = torch.linspace(-0.5, 0.5, E, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
+    router, runner, vllm_config = make_runner(
+        norm,
+        expert_bias,
+        checkpoint,
+        quant_config,
+        hidden_size=K,
+        intermediate_size=N,
+        top_k=TOPK,
+    )
+    experts = runner.routed_experts.quant_method.moe_kernel.fused_experts
+    return router, norm, runner, vllm_config, experts
+
+
+def _nvfp4_checkpoint() -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)
+
+    def packed(*shape):
+        return torch.randint(
+            0, 256, shape, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda", generator=g
+        )
+
+    def rand(*shape):
+        return torch.rand(*shape, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda", generator=g)
+
+    return {
+        "w13_weight": packed(E, 2 * N, K // 2),
+        "w13_weight_scale": torch.ones(
+            E, 2 * N, K // 16, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn, device="cuda"
+        ),
+        "w13_weight_scale_2": rand(E, 2) * 0.01 + 0.01,
+        "w13_input_scale": rand(E, 2) + 0.5,
+        "w2_weight": packed(E, K, N // 2),
+        "w2_weight_scale": torch.ones(
+            E, K, N // 16, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn, device="cuda"
+        ),
+        "w2_weight_scale_2": rand(E) * 0.01 + 0.01,
+        "w2_input_scale": rand(E) + 0.5,
+    }
+
+
+def _dequant(q, scale, global_scale):
+    return dequantize_to_dtype(
+        q, scale, global_scale, torch.bfloat16, block_size=16, swizzle=False
+    )
+
+
+def _expected(router, norm, hidden_states, router_logits, w13, w2):
+    topk_weights, topk_ids = router._compute_routing(hidden_states, router_logits, None)
+    return swiglu_moe_ref(
+        hidden_states,
+        w13,
+        w2,
+        topk_weights,
+        topk_ids,
+        lambda y: norm.forward_native(y, out_dtype=torch.float32),
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("down_scale", [1.0, 1e-4])
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_hopper_marlin_moe_runs_with_triton_finalize(
+    dist_init, workspace_init, down_scale
+) -> None:
+    checkpoint = _nvfp4_checkpoint()
+    checkpoint["w2_weight_scale_2"].mul_(down_scale)
+    router, norm, runner, vllm_config, experts = _build(
+        checkpoint, nvfp4_quant_config()
+    )
+    assert type(experts) is MarlinExperts
+    assert experts.g1_alphas is not None
+    assert experts.g1_alphas.shape == (E,)
+
+    hidden_states = torch.randn(M, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda") / 10
+    router_logits = torch.randn(M, E, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
+    output = run_moe(runner, vllm_config, hidden_states, router_logits)
+    assert output.shape == hidden_states.shape
+    assert output.dtype == hidden_states.dtype
+    assert torch.isfinite(output).all()
+
+    w13 = torch.empty(E, 2 * N, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    for expert in range(E):
+        for shard, rows in ((0, slice(0, N)), (1, slice(N, 2 * N))):
+            w13[expert, rows] = _dequant(
+                checkpoint["w13_weight"][expert, rows],
+                checkpoint["w13_weight_scale"][expert, rows],
+                checkpoint["w13_weight_scale_2"][expert, shard],
+            )
+    w2 = _dequant(
+        checkpoint["w2_weight"],
+        checkpoint["w2_weight_scale"],
+        checkpoint["w2_weight_scale_2"],
+    )
+    expected = _expected(router, norm, hidden_states, router_logits, w13, w2)
+    assert (output.float() - expected).norm() / expected.norm() < 5e-2
+
+    assert_cudagraph_replays(
+        runner,
+        vllm_config,
+        hidden_states,
+        router_logits,
+        torch.randn_like(hidden_states),
+        torch.randn_like(router_logits),
+    )
+
+
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_hopper_bf16_boundary_layer_runs_with_triton_finalize(
+    dist_init, workspace_init
+) -> None:
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(1)
+    weights = {
+        "w13_weight": torch.randn(
+            E, 2 * N, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda", generator=g
+        )
+        / 10,
+        "w2_weight": torch.randn(
+            E, K, N, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda", generator=g
+        )
+        / 10,
+    }
+    router, norm, runner, vllm_config, experts = _build(weights)
+    assert type(experts) is TritonExperts
+
+    hidden_states = torch.randn(M, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda") / 10
+    router_logits = torch.randn(M, E, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
+    output = run_moe(runner, vllm_config, hidden_states, router_logits)
+    assert output.shape == hidden_states.shape
+    assert output.dtype == hidden_states.dtype
+    assert torch.isfinite(output).all()
+
+    expected = _expected(
+        router,
+        norm,
+        hidden_states,
+        router_logits,
+        weights["w13_weight"],
+        weights["w2_weight"],
+    )
+    assert (output.float() - expected).norm() / expected.norm() < 0.02

+"""Deployment policy for the MuseSpark1x post-expert-norm MoE (CPU only)."""

+import pytest

+    _validate_route_major_deployment,

+
+
+def _moe_config(
+    *,
+    tp_size: int = 1,
+    ep_size: int = 1,
+    dp_size: int = 1,
+    sp_size: int = 1,
+    enable_eplb: bool = False,
+    routing_method: RoutingMethodType = RoutingMethodType.MiniMax2,
+    skip_final_all_reduce: bool = False,
+) -> FusedMoEConfig:
+    parallel_config = FusedMoEParallelConfig(
+        tp_size=tp_size,
+        pcp_size=1,
+        dp_size=dp_size,
+        ep_size=ep_size,
+        tp_rank=0,
+        pcp_rank=0,
+        dp_rank=0,
+        ep_rank=0,
+        sp_size=sp_size,
+        use_ep=ep_size > 1,
+        all2all_backend="allgather_reducescatter",
+        enable_eplb=enable_eplb,
+    )
+    return FusedMoEConfig(
+        num_experts=32,
+        experts_per_token=8,
+        hidden_dim=2048,
+        intermediate_size=1024,
+        num_local_experts=32 // ep_size,
+        num_logical_experts=32,
+        moe_parallel_config=parallel_config,
+        in_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        max_num_tokens=64,
+        activation=MoEActivation.SILU,
+        device=torch.device("cpu"),
+        routing_method=routing_method,
+        skip_final_all_reduce=skip_final_all_reduce,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "kwargs,expect_pre",
+    [
+        # TP shards the intermediate dim, so GEMM2 rows are partial sums and
+        # must be summed *before* the row-wise norm.
+        ({"tp_size": 8}, True),
+        # EP leaves every expert whole on its owning rank, so the ranks hold
+        # disjoint addends, summed after the norm by the runner's all-reduce...
+        ({"ep_size": 8}, False),
+        # ...or, with DP+EP, by the prepare/finalize combine.
+        ({"ep_size": 8, "dp_size": 2, "sp_size": 4}, False),
+        ({"ep_size": 8, "dp_size": 2}, False),
+        ({}, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_supported_deployments_reduce_only_before_the_norm(kwargs, expect_pre):
+    """The finalizer's only collective is the pre-norm TP all-reduce.
+
+    Under EP, DP ranks call it with different token counts, so any other
+    collective would hang.
+    """
+    config = _moe_config(**kwargs)
+    validate_deployment(config, kernel_routes=True)
+    assert needs_pre_norm_all_reduce(config) is expect_pre
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "kwargs,reason",
+    [
+        ({"routing_method": RoutingMethodType.Unspecified}, "MiniMax2"),
+        ({"routing_method": RoutingMethodType.DeepSeekV3}, "MiniMax2"),
+        ({"enable_eplb": True}, "EPLB"),
+        # Sequence parallel without an all2all combine has nothing to fold
+        # the reduce-scatter into.
+        ({"tp_size": 8, "sp_size": 8}, "sequence-parallel"),
+        # The runner reduces inside, so an un-reduced output cannot be honored.
+        ({"tp_size": 8, "skip_final_all_reduce": True}, "un-reduced"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_unsupported_deployments_are_rejected(kwargs, reason):
+    """Unsupported deployments must raise, not skip the norm or miscount sums."""
+    with pytest.raises((NotImplementedError, ValueError), match=reason):
+        validate_deployment(_moe_config(**kwargs), kernel_routes=True)
+
+
+def test_routing_is_only_constrained_when_the_kernel_routes():
+    """Modular experts take topk_ids from MuseSpark1xRouter, so any routing works."""
+    config = _moe_config(routing_method=RoutingMethodType.Unspecified)
+    validate_deployment(config, kernel_routes=False)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "kwargs,match",
+    [
+        ({"tp_size": 8}, None),
+        ({"ep_size": 8}, None),
+        ({"dp_size": 2}, "DP1"),
+        ({"sp_size": 2}, "sequence-parallel"),
+        ({"enable_eplb": True}, "EPLB"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_hopper_route_major_deployments(kwargs, match):

+        _validate_route_major_deployment(_moe_config(**kwargs))
+        return
+    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match=match):

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""MuseSpark1x post-expert finalize kernels: CuTe-DSL and Triton."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.common.ops.fused_finalize import (
+    fused_post_expert_finalize,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.nvidia.ops.cute_dsl.moe_finalize_rmsnorm import (
+    moe_finalize_with_rmsnorm,
+    supports_moe_finalize,
+)
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+requires_cutedsl_finalize = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not (
+        current_platform.has_device_capability(100)
+        and supports_moe_finalize(torch.bfloat16, 4096)
+    ),
+    reason="Requires the SM100+ CuTe-DSL MoE finalize",
+)
+
+
+def _ref_finalize(rows, norm_weight, weights, eps, weight_first, gain_center=1.0):
+    """``sum_k weights * norm(rows[:, k])`` in fp32."""
+    x = rows.float()
+    gain = 1 if norm_weight is None else norm_weight.float() + gain_center
+    if weight_first:
+        x = x * gain
+    y = x * torch.rsqrt(x.square().mean(-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
+    if not weight_first:
+        y = y * gain
+    return (y * weights.float()[..., None]).sum(1)
+
+
+# 2048 is the widest row served by a single warp; wider rows reduce through
+# shared memory. MuseSpark1x's compressed MoE hidden dim is 4096.
+@requires_cutedsl_finalize
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("hidden_dim", [2048, 4096])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("weight_before_norm", [False, True])
+def test_masked_slots_never_produce_nan(
+    hidden_dim: int, weight_before_norm: bool
+) -> None:
+    """An EP rank that owns no expert in the batch must contribute exactly zero.
+
+    Its unwritten workspace holds arbitrary bits and ``NaN * 0`` is NaN, so
+    zero-weighting the rows is not enough.
+    """
+    dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    topk = 8
+    num_tokens, rows_total = 5, 40
+    # Uniform bf16 bit patterns: ~0.4% are NaN/Inf, so a row this wide almost
+    # surely holds one.
+    gemm2_output = (
+        torch.randint(
+            0, 65536, (rows_total, hidden_dim), device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32
+        )
+        .to(torch.int16)
+        .view(dtype)
+    )
+    expert_weights = torch.randn((num_tokens, topk), device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+    permuted_idx = torch.full((num_tokens, topk), -1, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+    rms_norm_weight = torch.randn(hidden_dim, device="cuda", dtype=dtype) * 0.1
+    output = torch.empty((num_tokens, hidden_dim), device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+
+    moe_finalize_with_rmsnorm(
+        gemm2_output,
+        expert_weights,
+        permuted_idx,
+        rms_norm_weight,
+        output,
+        topk=topk,
+        eps=1e-6,
+        weight_before_norm=weight_before_norm,
+    )
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(output, torch.zeros_like(output), rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+
+@requires_cutedsl_finalize
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("weight_before_norm", [False, True])
+def test_fp32_routing_weights_match_bf16(weight_before_norm: bool) -> None:
+    """fp32 routing weights are read as-is, not rounded to the activation dtype."""
+    dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    hidden_dim, topk, rows = 4096, 8, 17
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    gemm2_output = torch.randn(rows * topk, hidden_dim, device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+    weights_fp32 = torch.rand((rows, topk), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    permuted_idx = torch.arange(rows * topk, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32).view(
+        rows, topk
+    )
+    rms_norm_weight = torch.randn(hidden_dim, device="cuda", dtype=dtype) * 0.1
+
+    def run(weights: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        out = torch.empty((rows, hidden_dim), device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+        moe_finalize_with_rmsnorm(
+            gemm2_output,
+            weights,
+            permuted_idx,
+            rms_norm_weight,
+            out,
+            topk=topk,
+            eps=1e-6,
+            weight_before_norm=weight_before_norm,
+        )
+        return out
+
+    got = run(weights_fp32)
+    rounded = run(weights_fp32.to(dtype))
+    ref = _ref_finalize(
+        gemm2_output.view(rows, topk, hidden_dim),
+        rms_norm_weight,
+        weights_fp32,
+        1e-6,
+        weight_before_norm,
+        gain_center=0.0,
+    )
+
+    err_fp32 = (got.float() - ref).abs().max().item()
+    err_rounded = (rounded.float() - ref).abs().max().item()
+    # bf16 weights carry ~3 decimal digits, so rounding them is the larger error.
+    assert err_fp32 <= err_rounded, f"fp32 {err_fp32} should beat bf16 {err_rounded}"
+    torch.testing.assert_close(got, ref.to(dtype), rtol=0.02, atol=0.02)
+
+
+_SHAPES = [(4096, 8), (8192, 9), (513, 3)]  # tiled, looped, masked-column kernel
+_LAYOUTS = ["dense", "expert_map", "permuted"]
+_WEIGHTS = [None, "first", "after"]
+
+
+# A Latin square: every shape/layout, shape/weight and layout/weight pair once.
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "tokens,hidden,topk,layout,weight_mode",
+    [
+        (33, *_SHAPES[i], _LAYOUTS[j], _WEIGHTS[(i + j) % 3])
+        for i in range(3)
+        for j in range(3)
+    ]
+    + [(0, 4096, 8, "permuted", "after")],
+)
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_triton_finalize_masks_remote_experts(
+    tokens, hidden, topk, layout, weight_mode
+):
+    """Remote route workspaces can be NaN and must never enter normalization."""
+    torch.manual_seed(42)
+    routed = torch.randn(tokens, topk, hidden, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    weights = torch.rand(tokens, topk, device="cuda")
+    ids = torch.arange(topk, device="cuda").expand(tokens, -1).contiguous()
+    # Deliberately non-contiguous ownership, so range-based masking is wrong.
+    expert_map = torch.arange(topk, device="cuda").roll(2)
+    expert_map[1::2] = -1
+    if layout == "dense":
+        local = torch.ones_like(ids, dtype=torch.bool)
+    else:
+        local = expert_map[ids] >= 0
+        if tokens:
+            local[0] = False
+            ids[0] = 1
+    routed.masked_fill_(~local[..., None], float("nan"))
+    norm_weight = torch.randn(hidden, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) / 10
+    output = torch.empty(tokens, hidden, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    if layout == "permuted":
+        idx = torch.arange(tokens * topk, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+        idx = idx.view(tokens, topk).masked_fill(~local, -1)

+def build_moe(norm_cls, ckpt: dict[str, torch.Tensor], quant_config=None):
+    # Non-zero so selecting on biased scores and normalizing unbiased ones is
+    # distinguishable from using one set for both.
+    expert_bias = (torch.rand(E, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32) - 0.5) * 0.4

+        )

+        expert_bias,
+        ckpt,
+        quant_config,
+        hidden_size=K,
+        intermediate_size=N,
+        top_k=TOPK,
+    )
+    assert router.routing_method_type == RoutingMethodType.MiniMax2
+    routed = runner.routed_experts

+def _inputs(seed: int):
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)

+def _bf16_checkpoint(seed: int = 0):
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    return {
+        "w13_weight": torch.randn(E, 2 * N, K, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        / 15,
+        "w2_weight": torch.randn(E, K, N, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) / 15,
+    }
+
+
+def _quant_side(w: torch.Tensor, global_scale: torch.Tensor):
+    """Quantize [rows, cols] to (packed fp4 uint8, linear fp8 block scales)."""
+    q, sf = ops.scaled_fp4_quant(
+        w.to(torch.bfloat16),
+        global_scale.to(torch.float32).reshape(1),
+        is_sf_swizzled_layout=False,
+    )
+    assert q.shape == (w.shape[0], w.shape[1] // 2)
+    assert sf.shape == (w.shape[0], w.shape[1] // 16)
+    return q, sf
+
+
+def _dequant(q, sf, gs):
+    return dequantize_nvfp4_to_dtype(
+        q,
+        sf,
+        gs,
+        dtype=torch.float32,
+        device="cuda",
+        block_size=16,
+        is_sf_128x4_layout=False,
+        is_sf_linear_layout=True,
+    )
+
+
+def _nvfp4_checkpoint(seed: int = 0):
+    """A checkpoint-layout NVFP4 MoE layer with distinct w1/w3 scales."""
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+    w13 = torch.randn(E, 2 * N, K, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) / 15
+    w2 = torch.randn(E, K, N, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) / 15
+
+    # modelopt convention: dequant scale s = amax / (448 * 6), quantize with 1/s.
+    w13_s2 = torch.empty(E, 2, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    w13_q = torch.empty(E, 2 * N, K // 2, device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+    w13_sf = torch.empty(E, 2 * N, K // 16, device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+    for e in range(E):
+        for col, rows in ((0, w13[e, :N]), (1, w13[e, N:])):
+            jitter = 1.0 + 0.4 * torch.rand((), generator=g, device="cuda")
+            s = rows.abs().max() / FP4_SF_MAX * jitter
+            w13_s2[e, col] = s
+            q, sf = _quant_side(rows.float(), 1.0 / s)
+            w13_q[e, col * N : (col + 1) * N] = q
+            w13_sf[e, col * N : (col + 1) * N] = sf.view(torch.uint8)
+
+    w2_s2 = torch.empty(E, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    w2_q = torch.empty(E, K, N // 2, device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+    w2_sf = torch.empty(E, K, N // 16, device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+    for e in range(E):
+        s = w2[e].abs().max() / FP4_SF_MAX
+        w2_s2[e] = s
+        q, sf = _quant_side(w2[e].float(), 1.0 / s)
+        w2_q[e] = q
+        w2_sf[e] = sf.view(torch.uint8)
+
+    return {
+        "w13_weight": w13_q,
+        "w13_weight_scale": w13_sf.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn),
+        "w13_weight_scale_2": w13_s2,
+        "w13_input_scale": torch.rand(E, 2, generator=g, device="cuda") + 0.5,
+        "w2_weight": w2_q,
+        "w2_weight_scale": w2_sf.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn),
+        "w2_weight_scale_2": w2_s2,
+        "w2_input_scale": torch.rand(E, generator=g, device="cuda") + 0.5,
+    }
+
+
+def _dequant_nvfp4_weights(ckpt: dict[str, torch.Tensor]):
+    w13 = torch.empty(E, 2 * N, K, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    w2 = torch.empty(E, K, N, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    for e in range(E):
+        for col, sl in ((0, slice(0, N)), (1, slice(N, 2 * N))):
+            w13[e, sl] = _dequant(
+                ckpt["w13_weight"][e, sl],
+                ckpt["w13_weight_scale"][e, sl],
+                1.0 / ckpt["w13_weight_scale_2"][e, col],
+            )
+        w2[e] = _dequant(
+            ckpt["w2_weight"][e],
+            ckpt["w2_weight_scale"][e],
+            1.0 / ckpt["w2_weight_scale_2"][e],
+        )
+    return w13, w2
+
+
+def _rel(actual: torch.Tensor, expected: torch.Tensor) -> float:
+    return ((actual.float() - expected).norm() / expected.norm()).item()

+    def quant_gemm2_input(inter: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        iq, isf = _quant_side(inter, 1.0 / a2)
+        return _dequant(iq, isf, 1.0 / a2)
+
+    norm_fn = functools.partial(norm.forward_native, out_dtype=torch.float32)
+    with set_current_vllm_config(vllm_config):
+        ref_full = swiglu_moe_ref(x_dq, w13, w2, topk_weights, topk_ids, norm_fn)
+        ref_q2 = swiglu_moe_ref(
+            x_dq, w13, w2, topk_weights, topk_ids, norm_fn, quant_gemm2_input
+        )
+    # The kernel's internal GEMM2-input NVFP4 quantizer is only approximated by
+    # the reference. Measured: rel_q2 ~2.3e-2, rel_full ~1.0e-1.
+    assert _rel(out, ref_q2) < 5e-2
+    assert _rel(out, ref_full) < 1.5e-1
+
+
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_muse_spark_bf16_moe_kernel_router_matches_reference(dist_init, workspace_init):
+    """The fused router must select on biased scores but weight by unbiased ones."""
+    ckpt = _bf16_checkpoint(seed=3)
+    router, routed, _, vllm_config, runner = build_moe(MuseSpark1xRMSNorm, ckpt)
+
+    captured: list[UnfinalizedMoEOutput] = []
+    experts = routed.quant_method.moe_kernel.fused_experts
+    inner = experts.post_gemm2_hook
+
+    def _spy(unfinalized, out):
+        captured.append(unfinalized)
+        inner(unfinalized, out)
+
+    experts.post_gemm2_hook = _spy
+    try:
+        x, logits = _inputs(3)
+        run_moe(runner, vllm_config, x, logits)
+    finally:
+        experts.post_gemm2_hook = inner
+
+    # Otherwise the kernel did not defer and the norm was silently skipped.
+    assert len(captured) == 1
+    kernel_weights = captured[0].expert_weights.float()
+
+    scores = torch.sigmoid(logits.float())
+    biased = scores + router.expert_bias
+    ids = torch.topk(biased, TOPK, dim=-1).indices
+    unbiased_norm = torch.gather(scores, 1, ids)
+    unbiased_norm = unbiased_norm / (unbiased_norm.sum(-1, keepdim=True) + DIVISION_EPS)
+    biased_norm = torch.gather(biased, 1, ids)
+    biased_norm = biased_norm / (biased_norm.sum(-1, keepdim=True) + DIVISION_EPS)
+
+    got = kernel_weights.sort(dim=-1).values
+    want = unbiased_norm.sort(dim=-1).values
+    wrong = biased_norm.sort(dim=-1).values
+    assert (want - wrong).abs().max() > 1e-2
+    assert (got - want).abs().max() < 5e-3
+    assert (got - wrong).abs().max() > 5e-3
+

+def make_cos_sin_cache(max_pos, rotary_dim, base, device, dtype=torch.float32):
+    """The table ``RotaryEmbedding`` builds: cos||sin, fp32 for Muse-Spark."""
+    inv_freq = 1.0 / (
+        base
+        ** (
+            torch.arange(0, rotary_dim, 2, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+            / rotary_dim
+        )
+    )
+    t = torch.arange(max_pos, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    freqs = torch.einsum("i,j->ij", t, inv_freq)
+    return torch.cat((freqs.cos(), freqs.sin()), dim=-1).to(dtype)
+
+
+def qk_norm_rope_ref(x, positions, cos_sin_cache, rotary_dim, eps):
+    """fp32 reference for one q or k branch, rounded once; no table means NoPE."""
+    out = x.float()
+    out = out * torch.rsqrt(out.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
+    if cos_sin_cache is not None:
+        half = rotary_dim // 2
+        cs = cos_sin_cache[positions].float()
+        cos = cs[..., :half].unsqueeze(1)
+        sin = cs[..., half:].unsqueeze(1)
+        # GPT-J interleaved: the rotated pair is (2i, 2i+1).
+        x0 = out[..., :rotary_dim:2]
+        x1 = out[..., 1:rotary_dim:2]
+        out = out.clone()
+        out[..., :rotary_dim:2] = x0 * cos - x1 * sin
+        out[..., 1:rotary_dim:2] = x0 * sin + x1 * cos
+    return out.to(x.dtype)
+
+
+def assert_fp8_cache_close(got, expected, exact_fraction=0.999):
+    """e4m3 caches agree within one code (reciprocal multiply vs divide)."""
+    diff = (got.int() - expected.int()).abs()
+    within = diff <= 1
+    assert bool(within.all()), (
+        f"fp8 cache differs by more than one code in {int((~within).sum())} "
+        f"of {diff.numel()} elements"
+    )
+    exact = float((diff == 0).float().mean())
+    assert exact >= exact_fraction, (
+        f"only {exact:.5f} of the fp8 cache is bit-identical to "
+        f"reshape_and_cache_flash, expected at least {exact_fraction}"
+    )
+

+def make_case(num_tokens, nq, nkv, dtype, device, with_gate=True, seed=0):

+    return qkv, qsz, kvsz, gate

+        exp_v,

+    )
+    if kv_cache_dtype == "auto":

+def test_single_chunk_per_token():
+    """Few heads and a huge batch widen the chunk to one per token (degenerate)."""
+    device, dtype, eps = "cuda", torch.bfloat16, 1e-5
+    # nq + 2*nkv = 4 slots, and enough tokens that the widest chunk is chosen.
+    num_tokens, nq, nkv, max_pos, block_size = 40000, 2, 1, 4096, 16

+    positions = torch.randint(

+    )
+    num_blocks = num_tokens // block_size + 2
+    kv_cache = torch.zeros(
+        num_blocks, nkv, block_size, 2 * HEAD_DIM, dtype=dtype, device=device
+    )

+    ops.fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert(

+    for got, src, n in ((q_out, q_in, nq), (k_out, k_in, nkv)):
+        ref = qk_norm_rope_ref(

+def test_load_weights_moves_per_row_qk_scales_with_the_interleaved_rows(
+    monkeypatch,
+) -> None:
+    """A PTPC-FP8 q/k projection dequantizes unchanged across the row interleave."""
+    head_dim, q_rows, k_rows, hidden = 8, 4 * 8, 2 * 8, 16
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    weight = torch.randn(k_rows, hidden)
+    scale = torch.rand(k_rows) + 0.5
+    block_scale = torch.rand(k_rows, hidden // 4)
+    input_scale = torch.tensor(0.25)
+    # Same length as the k rows but indexed by input channel: must not move.
+    per_channel_input = torch.rand(k_rows)
+    o_proj = torch.randn(hidden, q_rows)
+    layer = "model.language_model.layers.3.self_attn"
+    seen: dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
+
+    class RecordingLoader:
+        def __init__(self, module) -> None:
+            pass
+
+        def load_weights(self, weights, *, mapper=None) -> set[str]:
+            seen.update(dict(weights))
+            return set(seen)
+
+    model = object.__new__(MuseSpark1xForCausalLM)
+    model.model = SimpleNamespace(
+        config=SimpleNamespace(
+            head_dim=head_dim, num_attention_heads=4, num_key_value_heads=2
+        )
+    )
+    with monkeypatch.context() as patch:
+        patch.setattr(amd_model, "AutoWeightsLoader", RecordingLoader)
+        patch.setattr(
+            amd_model, "materialize_residual_path_constants", lambda _model: 0
+        )
+        MuseSpark1xForCausalLM.load_weights(
+            model,
+            [
+                (f"{layer}.k_proj.weight", weight),
+                (f"{layer}.k_proj.weight_scale", scale),
+                (f"{layer}.k_proj.weight_scale_block", block_scale),
+                (f"{layer}.k_proj.input_scale", input_scale),
+                (f"{layer}.k_proj.input_channel_scale", per_channel_input),
+                (f"{layer}.o_proj.weight", o_proj),
+            ],
+        )
+
+    def interleave(t: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return (
+            t.reshape(-1, 2, head_dim // 2, *t.shape[1:])
+            .transpose(1, 2)
+            .reshape(t.shape)
+        )
+
+    assert torch.equal(seen[f"{layer}.k_proj.weight"], interleave(weight))
+    assert torch.equal(seen[f"{layer}.k_proj.weight_scale"], interleave(scale))
+    assert torch.equal(
+        seen[f"{layer}.k_proj.weight_scale_block"], interleave(block_scale)
+    )
+    assert torch.equal(
+        seen[f"{layer}.k_proj.weight"] * seen[f"{layer}.k_proj.weight_scale"][:, None],
+        interleave(weight * scale[:, None]),
+    )
+    assert seen[f"{layer}.k_proj.input_scale"] is input_scale
+    assert seen[f"{layer}.k_proj.input_channel_scale"] is per_channel_input
+    assert seen[f"{layer}.o_proj.weight"] is o_proj

+"""MuseSpark1x text config normalization and the DSpark draft config."""
+
+import json

+TEXT: dict[str, Any] = {

+        "topk": 8,

+        "future_unknown_key": 1,

+
+def test_text_config_eos_default():
+    assert MuseSpark1xTextConfig().eos_token_id == [200001, 200008]
+    assert MuseSpark1xTextConfig(eos_token_id=200001).eos_token_id == 200001
+

+    c = MuseSpark1xTextConfig(**TEXT)
+    assert isinstance(c.moe, MoEArgs) and c.moe.topk == 8
+    assert isinstance(c.metap, MetapArgs) and c.metap.use_metap
+    assert isinstance(c.gated_delta_net, GatedDeltaNetArgs)
+    assert c.gated_delta_net.conv_size == 4
+    assert not hasattr(c.moe, "future_unknown_key")
+    assert not hasattr(c.gated_delta_net, "future_unknown_key")
+
+
+def test_derived_intermediate_sizes():
+    c = MuseSpark1xTextConfig(**TEXT)
+    assert c.intermediate_size_mlp == int(1.5 * 5120)
+    assert c.intermediate_size_shared_experts == int(1.5 * 5120)
+    assert c.intermediate_size_routed_experts == 1408
+
+
+def test_metap_rejects_unknown_mode():
+    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
+        MuseSpark1xTextConfig(metap={"use_metap": True, "metap_mode": "bogus"})
+
+
+def _dspark_config() -> dict:
+    return {
+        "model_type": "muse_spark_dspark",
+        "num_hidden_layers": 2,
+        "moe": {"is_enabled": False},
+        "global_attn_cfg": [2048],
+        "layer_types": ["sliding_attention"] * 2,
+        "target_layer_ids": [1, 3],
+        "num_target_layers": 2,
+        "markov_rank": 8,
+        "markov_head_type": "vanilla",
+        "dflash_config": {"causal": True, "target_layer_ids": [1, 3]},
+    }
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["rope", "nope"])
+def test_dspark_config_loads(tmp_path, mode):
+    raw = _dspark_config() | {"draft_position_mode": mode}
+    (tmp_path / "config.json").write_text(json.dumps(raw))
+    config = get_config(tmp_path, trust_remote_code=False)
+
+    assert isinstance(config, MuseSparkDSparkConfig)
+    assert config.architectures == ["MuseSparkDSparkModel"]
+    assert config.use_rope == (mode == "rope")
+    assert config.draft_vocab_size == config.vocab_size
+
+
+def test_dspark_speculative_config_preserves_architecture(tmp_path):
+    target_path, draft_path = tmp_path / "target", tmp_path / "draft"
+    target_path.mkdir()
+    draft_path.mkdir()
+    # DSpark reads only sizes from the target, so any registered tiny model works.
+    target = {
+        "model_type": "llama",
+        "architectures": ["LlamaForCausalLM"],
+        "hidden_size": 64,
+        "intermediate_size": 128,
+        "num_hidden_layers": 4,
+        "num_attention_heads": 4,
+        "num_key_value_heads": 4,
+        "vocab_size": 128,
+    }
+    (target_path / "config.json").write_text(json.dumps(target))
+    (draft_path / "config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_dspark_config()))
+
+    config = SpeculativeConfig(
+        model=str(draft_path),
+        method="dspark",
+        num_speculative_tokens=7,
+        target_model_config=ModelConfig(model=str(target_path), tokenizer_mode="skip"),
+        target_parallel_config=ParallelConfig(),

+    assert config.parallel_drafting
+    assert config.draft_model_config.architectures == ["MuseSparkDSparkModel"]
+    assert isinstance(config.draft_model_config.hf_config, MuseSparkDSparkConfig)
+
+
+def test_dspark_output_logit_transform():
+    model = object.__new__(MuseSparkDSparkForCausalLM)  # type: ignore[type-abstract]
+    nn.Module.__init__(model)
+    model.output_multiplier = 0.5
+    model.output_soft_cap_temp = 2.0
+    logits = torch.tensor([[-4.0, 0.0, 4.0]], dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    expected = 2.0 * torch.tanh(logits.float() * 0.5 / 2.0)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(model.apply_output_logit_transform(logits), expected)

+"""SM100 BF16 GEMM with fused tensor-parallel reduce-scatter/all-reduce."""
+
+# Based on CUTLASS's Blackwell distributed GEMM-RS example at dcf215a.
+# See https://github.com/NVIDIA/cutlass/issues/3117 for memory semantics.
+
+from functools import cache
+
+import cutlass
+import torch
+import torch.distributed._symmetric_memory as symm_mem
+from cuda.bindings.driver import CUstream
+from cutlass import BFloat16, Int32, Int64, Uint16, cute, utils
+from cutlass._mlir import ir
+from cutlass._mlir.dialects import llvm, nvvm, vector
+from cutlass.cute.nvgpu import cpasync, tcgen05
+from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream, make_fake_tensor, make_ptr, nullptr
+from cutlass.cutlass_dsl import dsl_user_op
+from cutlass.utils import get_smem_capacity_in_bytes
+
+from vllm.cute_utils import _tcgen05, mbarrier, simple_tma_copy, to_cta0_smem
+from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def nanosleep(ns: int, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> None:
+    nvvm.nanosleep(Int32(ns).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip), loc=loc, ip=ip)
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def multimem_ld_reduce_16B(x: cute.Tensor, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> cute.Tensor:
+    # The vector instruction assumes x is contiguous and 16-byte aligned.
+    assert x.element_type == BFloat16
+    vec_type = ".v4.bf16x2"
+
+    ptr = x.iterator.toint(loc=loc, ip=ip).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)
+    asm = (
+        "multimem.ld_reduce.relaxed.gpu.global.add.acc::f32"
+        f"{vec_type} {{$0, $1, $2, $3}}, [$4];"
+    )
+    struct = llvm.inline_asm(
+        llvm.StructType.get_literal([Int32.mlir_type] * 4),
+        [ptr],
+        asm,
+        "=r,=r,=r,=r,l",
+        has_side_effects=True,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+    vec = vector.from_elements(
+        ir.VectorType.get([4], Int32.mlir_type, loc=loc),
+        [
+            llvm.extractvalue(Int32.mlir_type, struct, [i], loc=loc, ip=ip)
+            for i in range(4)
+        ],
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+    ssa = cute.TensorSSA(vec, 4, Int32)
+
+    y = cute.make_rmem_tensor(4, Int32)
+    y.store(ssa)
+    return cute.recast_tensor(y, x.element_type)
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def multimem_st_16B(dst: cute.Tensor, value: cute.Tensor, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> None:
+    # Assumes contiguous BF16x8 vectors and a 16-byte aligned dst.
+    assert dst.element_type == BFloat16
+    assert value.element_type == BFloat16
+    ptr = dst.iterator.toint(loc=loc, ip=ip).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)
+    regs = cute.recast_tensor(value, Int32, loc=loc, ip=ip)
+    llvm.inline_asm(
+        None,
+        [ptr] + [regs[i].ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip) for i in range(4)],
+        "multimem.st.relaxed.sys.global.v4.f32 [$0], {$1, $2, $3, $4};",
+        "l,r,r,r,r",
+        has_side_effects=True,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+
+
+class Sm100GemmRsArBF16:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        rank: int,
+        num_ranks: int,
+        BN: int = 128,
+        cta_group: int = 1,
+        all_reduce: bool = False,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.rank = rank
+        self.num_ranks = num_ranks
+        BM, BK = 128, 64
+        self.cta_tile = (BM, BN, BK)
+        self.cta_group = cta_group
+        self.all_reduce = all_reduce

+        smem_bytes = get_smem_capacity_in_bytes()

+        self.num_stages = smem_bytes // self.stage_size

+        layout = cute.make_layout(

+            stride=(BK, 1, BM * BK),
+        )
+        layout = cute.make_composed_layout(swizzle_128b, 0, layout)

+        B: cute.Tensor,
+        partial_uc: cute.Tensor,
+        partial_mc_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        output: cute.Tensor,
+        flags_uc: cute.Tensor,
+        flags_mc_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        peer_flag_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        grid_size: Int32,
+        stream: CUstream,
+    ) -> None:

+        BM, BN, BK = self.cta_tile
+        A_tma = self.prepare_tma(A, BM, BK)
+        B_tma = self.prepare_tma(B, BN // self.cta_group, BK)
+        padded_M = partial_uc.shape[0]
+        partial_mc = cute.make_tensor(
+            partial_mc_ptr,
+            cute.make_layout((padded_M, N), stride=(N, 1)),

+        self.kernel(

+            B_tma,
+            partial_uc,

+            output,

+            peer_flags,
+        ).launch(grid=grid, block=block, cluster=cluster, stream=stream)

+    @cute.kernel

+        BM, BN, BK = self.cta_tile

+                        grid_m,
+                        tile_N,
+                        flags,

+                        gemm_start = gemm_bid_m * tile_M
+                        gemm_end = min(gemm_start + tile_M, logical_M)
+                        local_start = max(gemm_start, rank_start) - rank_start
+                        local_end = min(gemm_end, rank_end) - rank_start
+
+                        first_rs_tile = (
+                            cute.ceil_div((local_start + 1) * grid_m, local_M) - 1
+                        )
+                        last_rs_tile = cute.ceil_div(local_end * grid_m, local_M) - 1
+                        num_consumers = last_rs_tile - first_rs_tile + 1
+
+                        flag_ptr = flags + tile_N * grid_m + gemm_bid_m
+                        old_count = cute.arch.atomic_add(
+                            flag_ptr, Int32(1), sem="relaxed", scope="gpu"
+                        )
+                        if old_count == num_ranks + num_consumers - 1:
+                            cute.arch.store(
+                                flag_ptr, Int32(0), sem="relaxed", scope="gpu"
+                            )
+

+                        release_gemm_tile(

+                            M,

+                            rank_end,
+                            local_M,
+                            grid_m,
+                            bid_n,

+                            local_M,
+                            grid_m,

+                            flags_uc_ptr,
+                            num_ranks,
+                        )
+
+            # Exit barrier. GPU scope is sufficient for RS because the kernel
+            # writes local global memory and only needs to flush it to local L2.
+            # AR uses system scope to flush the multimem stores to remote L2.
+            cute.arch.barrier(barrier_id=BAR_COMM, number_of_threads=128)

+                scope = "sys" if self.all_reduce else "gpu"

+
+            bf16x16_atom = cute.make_copy_atom(

+                num_bits_per_copy=256,
+                l1c_evict_priority=cute.nvgpu.CacheEvictionPriority.NO_ALLOCATE,

+            tmem_stage = 0
+            parity = 0
+
+            if cutlass.const_expr(is_2cta):

+            else:
+                tmem_empty_mbar_ = tmem_empty_mbar
+

+                bid_m = bid % grid_m
+                bid_n = bid // grid_m
+
+                if warp_id_ == 0:
+                    cute.arch.mbarrier_wait(tmem_full_mbar + tmem_stage, parity)

+
+                for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(BN // WIDTH):
+                    tcol = tmem_stage * BN + i * WIDTH
+                    regs = _tcgen05.ld(warp_id_ * 32, tcol, "32x32b", WIDTH)
+                    _tcgen05.wait_ld()
+
+                    if cutlass.const_expr(i == BN // WIDTH - 1):
+                        _tcgen05.fence_before_thread_sync()

+                    tmp.store(regs.to(BFloat16))

+                # partial output only needs to be flushed to local L2.
+                if tid_ == 0 and bid_m * BM < M:

+        padded_M = cute.sym_int()
+        N = cute.sym_int()
+        K = cute.sym_int()
+        local_M = cute.sym_int()
+        num_flags = cute.sym_int()
+

+        B = make_fake_tensor(

+        )

+            BFloat16,
+            (padded_M, N),
+            (cute.sym_int64(divisibility=16), 1),
+            assumed_align=32,
+        )
+        partial_mc_ptr = nullptr(BFloat16, cute.AddressSpace.gmem, assumed_align=32)
+        output = (
+            None

+                (local_M, N),
+                (cute.sym_int64(divisibility=16), 1),
+                assumed_align=32,
+            )
+        )

+        flags_mc_ptr = nullptr(Int32, cute.AddressSpace.gmem, assumed_align=16)
+        peer_flag_ptr = nullptr(Int64, cute.AddressSpace.gmem, assumed_align=8)

+        )

+            A,
+            B,
+            partial,
+            partial_mc_ptr,
+            output,

+            flags_mc_ptr,
+            peer_flag_ptr,
+            128,
+            stream,

+class GemmRsAr:
+    """Own the symmetric workspace for BF16 GEMM-RS or GEMM-AR launches.
+
+    All TP ranks must belong to one NVLink domain for multimem instructions.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, *, max_M: int, N: int, all_reduce: bool = False) -> None:
+        tp_group = get_tp_group()
+        group = tp_group.device_group
+        rank = tp_group.rank_in_group
+        world_size = tp_group.world_size
+        device = torch.device("cuda", torch.accelerator.current_device_index())
+
+        assert 1 < world_size <= 16
+        assert 128 % world_size == 0
+        assert max_M >= 128 and N % 128 == 0
+
+        max_M = (max_M + world_size - 1) // world_size * world_size
+        self.rank = rank
+        self.world_size = world_size
+        self.max_M = max_M
+        self.N = N
+        self.device = device
+        self.all_reduce = all_reduce
+
+        self.partial = symm_mem.empty((max_M, N), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+        self.partial_handle = symm_mem.rendezvous(self.partial, group)
+        if self.partial_handle.multicast_ptr == 0:
+            raise RuntimeError("GEMM-RS/AR requires NVLink multicast memory")
+        self.partial_mc_ptr = make_ptr(
+            BFloat16,
+            self.partial_handle.multicast_ptr,
+            cute.AddressSpace.gmem,
+            assumed_align=32,
+        )
+
+        grid_m = (max_M + 127) // 128
+        cta_group = 2 if max_M >= 1024 or grid_m % 2 == 0 else 1
+        grid_m = (grid_m + cta_group - 1) // cta_group * cta_group
+        self.num_sms = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device).multi_processor_count
+        max_flags = grid_m * (N // 128) + self.num_sms
+        self.flags = symm_mem.empty(max_flags, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        self.flags_handle = symm_mem.rendezvous(self.flags, group)
+        if self.flags_handle.multicast_ptr == 0:
+            raise RuntimeError("GEMM-RS/AR requires NVLink multicast memory")
+        self.flags.zero_()
+        self.flags_mc_ptr = make_ptr(
+            Int32,
+            self.flags_handle.multicast_ptr,
+            cute.AddressSpace.gmem,
+            assumed_align=16,
+        )
+        self.peer_flag_ptr = make_ptr(
+            Int64,
+            self.flags_handle.buffer_ptrs_dev,
+            cute.AddressSpace.gmem,
+            assumed_align=8,
+        )
+
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize(device)
+        tp_group.barrier()
+
+    def __call__(self, x: torch.Tensor, w: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        assert x.ndim == 2
+        M, K = x.shape
+        assert 0 < M <= self.max_M
+        assert w.shape == (self.N, K) and K % 64 == 0
+        assert w.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        assert w.device == self.device
+        assert w.is_contiguous()
+        assert x.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        assert x.device == self.device
+        assert x.is_contiguous()
+        N = w.shape[0]
+        padded_M = (M + self.world_size - 1) // self.world_size
+        padded_M *= self.world_size
+        local_M = padded_M // self.world_size
+
+        grid_m = (M + 127) // 128
+        # Avoid padding small odd grids; 2-CTA wins consistently for M >= 1024.
+        cta_group = 2 if M >= 1024 or grid_m % 2 == 0 else 1
+        grid_m = (grid_m + cta_group - 1) // cta_group * cta_group
+        BN = 256 if M * K >= 24 * 1024 * 1024 else 128
+        assert N % BN == 0
+
+        num_tiles = grid_m * (N // BN)
+        num_ctas = min(num_tiles, self.num_sms)
+        num_ctas = num_ctas // cta_group * cta_group
+        assert self.flags.numel() >= num_tiles + num_ctas
+
+        output = None
+        if not self.all_reduce:
+            output = torch.empty((local_M, N), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=self.device)
+        compiled = Sm100GemmRsArBF16.compile(
+            self.rank,
+            self.world_size,
+            BN,
+            cta_group,
+            self.all_reduce,
+        )
+        compiled(
+            x,
+            w,
+            self.partial[:padded_M],
+            self.partial_mc_ptr,
+            output,
+            self.flags,
+            self.flags_mc_ptr,
+            self.peer_flag_ptr,
+            num_ctas,
+        )
+        if self.all_reduce:
+            # AttnRes may retain output past the next workspace reuse.
+            return self.partial[:M].clone()
+        assert output is not None
+        return output

+    x: MuseSpark1xResidualStream,
+    pre_norm: MuseSpark1xRMSNorm,
+    *,
+    out_dtype: torch.dtype,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Post-norm, blend and pre-norm in one kernel; returns ``(out, new_stream)``."""
+    post_norm, connection = x.post_norm, x.connection
+    branch, stream = x.branch, x.stream
+    if (
+        isinstance(connection, MuseSpark1xNormPreservingResidualConnection)
+        and getattr(connection, "_coefficients_ready", False)
+        and post_norm.supports_fused_kernel(branch)
+        and pre_norm.supports_fused_kernel(stream)
+        and supports_norm_residual_norm(branch, stream)
+    ):
+        return fused_norm_residual_norm_fwd(
+            branch,
+            stream,
+            post_norm.weight if post_norm.has_weight else None,
+            pre_norm.weight,
+            post_norm.variance_epsilon,
+            pre_norm.variance_epsilon,
+            alpha=connection.alpha,
+            beta=connection.beta,
+            post_gain_center=post_norm.fused_gain_center,
+            pre_gain_center=pre_norm.fused_gain_center,
+            post_input_scale=(
+                post_norm.applies_weight_before_norm and post_norm.has_weight
+            ),
+            pre_input_scale=(
+                pre_norm.applies_weight_before_norm and pre_norm.has_weight
+            ),
+            out_dtype=out_dtype,
