+            router_score_normalization="sigmoid",
+            router_score_division_eps=1e-15,
+        )
+
+        hidden_size = config.moe_hidden_size
+        # Plain F.linear: AITER's gfx950 tuned-GEMM table picks lossy split-K
+        # BF16-accumulating kernels for these shapes.
+        self.pooler: ReplicatedLinear | None = ReplicatedLinear(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=None,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.pooler",
+        )
+        self.pooler.quant_method = MuseSparkTorchLinearMethod()
+        self.unpooler: ReplicatedLinear | None = ReplicatedLinear(
+            hidden_size,
+            config.hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=None,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.unpooler",
+        )
+        self.unpooler.quant_method = MuseSparkTorchLinearMethod()
+
+        if self.pooler is not None:
+            self.pre_expert_norm: MuseSpark1xRMSNorm | None = MuseSpark1xRMSNorm(
+                hidden_size=hidden_size,
+                eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+                has_weight=True,
+                is_post_norm=False,
+                zero_centered_gamma=True,
+                post_norm_gain_center_type="one",
+                residual_id=2 * layer_idx + 2,
+                output_norm_gain_center_type="zero",
+            )
+        else:
+            self.pre_expert_norm = None
+
+        self.intermediate_size = config.moe_intermediate_size
+
+        self.post_expert_norm: MuseSpark1xRMSNorm | None = (
+            MuseSpark1xRMSNormWithInputScale(
+                hidden_size=hidden_size,
+                eps=config.post_norm_eps,
+                has_weight=True,
+                is_post_norm=True,
+                zero_centered_gamma=True,
+                post_norm_gain_center_type="one",
+                residual_id=None,
+                output_norm_gain_center_type="zero",
+            )
+        )
+        self.experts: nn.Module = FusedMoEFactory(
+            num_experts=config.num_local_experts,
+            top_k=config.num_experts_per_tok,
+            hidden_size=hidden_size,
+            intermediate_size=self.intermediate_size,
+            renormalize=True,
+            router=self.moe_router,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.experts",
+            is_sequence_parallel=self.is_sequence_parallel,
+            router_logits_dtype=self.router_dtype,
+            scoring_func="sigmoid",
+            e_score_correction_bias=self.expert_bias,
+            routed_scaling_factor=self.route_scale,
+            routed_experts_cls=self.post_norm_routed_experts_cls,
+            runner_cls=self.post_norm_runner_cls,
+            runner_args={"post_expert_norm": self.post_expert_norm},
+            moe_config_cls=MuseSparkMoEConfig,
+        )
+
+    def fold_router_output_multiplier(self) -> None:
+        """Fold the router output multiplier and split the bf16x3 planes."""
+        if self.router_output_multiplier is not None:
+            with torch.no_grad():
+                self.router.weight.mul_(self.router_output_multiplier)
+            self.router_output_multiplier = None
+            self.moe_router.router_output_multiplier = None
+        weight = self.router.weight.data
+        # Configs are tuned and validated on gfx950 only.
+        if (
+            on_gfx950()
+            and weight.dtype == torch.float32
+            and supports_router_bf16x3(*weight.shape)
+        ):
+            self._router_planes = split_fp32_to_bf16x3(weight)
+
+    def _router_logits(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        planes = getattr(self, "_router_planes", None)
+        if (
+            planes is not None
+            and hidden_states.shape[0] >= _ROUTER_BF16X3_MIN_TOKENS
+            and hidden_states.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and hidden_states.is_contiguous()
+        ):
+            return router_bf16x3_gemm(hidden_states, planes)
+        router_logits, _ = self.router(hidden_states)
+        return router_logits
+
+    @functools.cached_property
+    def _experts_take_expanded_input(self) -> bool:
+        """Whether the experts consume one input row per route (AITER MXFP4)."""
+        norm = self.pre_expert_norm
+        return (
+            norm is not None
+            and norm.variance_size_override is None
+            and isinstance(
+                self.experts.routed_experts.quant_method, MuseSparkQuarkOCPMXFusedMoE
+            )
+        )
+
+    def _pool(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if self.pooler is None:
+            return hidden_states
+        hidden_states, _ = self.pooler(hidden_states)
+        norm = self.pre_expert_norm
+        if norm is None:
+            return hidden_states
+        if self._experts_take_expanded_input and hidden_states.is_contiguous():
+            return fused_rmsnorm_expand(
+                hidden_states,
+                norm.weight if norm.has_weight else None,
+                norm.variance_epsilon,
+                norm.fused_gain_center,
+                norm.applies_weight_before_norm and norm.has_weight,
+                self.top_k,
+            )
+        return norm(hidden_states)
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        num_tokens = hidden_states.shape[0]
+        if self.is_sequence_parallel:
+            hidden_states = sequence_parallel_chunk(hidden_states)
+
+        router_logits = self._router_logits(hidden_states)
+        hidden_states = self._pool(hidden_states)
+
+        experts_out = self.experts(
+            hidden_states=hidden_states,
+            router_logits=router_logits,
+        )
+
+        if self.unpooler is not None:
+            experts_out, _ = self.unpooler(experts_out)
+
+        if self.is_sequence_parallel:
+            experts_out = tensor_model_parallel_all_gather(experts_out, 0)
+            experts_out = experts_out[:num_tokens]
+
+        return experts_out
+

+class MuseSpark1xAttention(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: MuseSparkTextConfig | MuseSparkDSparkConfig,
+        max_position_embeddings: int,
+        cache_config: CacheConfig | None = None,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.layer_idx = extract_layer_index(prefix)
+        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
+        is_draft = isinstance(config, MuseSparkDSparkConfig)
+        if is_draft:
+            self.use_rope = config.use_rope
+            self.count_backward_layer_id = self.layer_idx
+            if config.every_n_layers_nope is not None:
+                self.count_backward_layer_id += (
+                    config.every_n_layers_nope
+                    - config.num_hidden_layers % config.every_n_layers_nope
+                )
+                self.use_rope = self.use_rope and (
+                    (config.num_hidden_layers - self.layer_idx - 1)
+                    % config.every_n_layers_nope
+                    != 0
+                )
+            rope_theta = config.rope_theta
+        else:
+            rope_theta = config.layer_rope_theta[self.layer_idx]
+            self.use_rope = rope_theta > 0
+        self.use_qk_norm = config.use_qk_norm if is_draft else True
+        self.use_o_norm = config.use_attn_o_norm if is_draft else True
+        self.use_o_gate = config.use_attn_o_gate if is_draft else True
+        norm_affine = config.norm_affine if is_draft else True
+        zero_centered_gamma = config.norm_zero_centered_gamma if is_draft else True
+        gain_center_type = config.post_norm_gain_center_type if is_draft else "one"
+
+        tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+        self.total_num_heads = config.num_attention_heads
+        assert self.total_num_heads % tp_size == 0
+        self.num_heads = self.total_num_heads // tp_size
+        self.total_num_kv_heads = config.num_key_value_heads
+        if self.total_num_kv_heads >= tp_size:
+            assert self.total_num_kv_heads % tp_size == 0
+        else:
+            assert tp_size % self.total_num_kv_heads == 0
+        self.num_kv_heads = max(1, self.total_num_kv_heads // tp_size)
+        self.head_dim = config.head_dim
+        self.q_size = self.num_heads * self.head_dim
+        self.kv_size = self.num_kv_heads * self.head_dim
+        self.scaling = self.head_dim**-0.5
+
+        self.qk_norm = (
+            MuseSpark1xRMSNorm(
+                hidden_size=self.head_dim,
+                eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+                has_weight=False,  # matches the training side
+                is_post_norm=False,
+                zero_centered_gamma=False,  # matches the training side
+                post_norm_gain_center_type=gain_center_type,
+            )
+            if self.use_qk_norm
+            else None
+        )
+        self.default_dtype = torch.get_default_dtype()
+        self.o_norm = (
+            MuseSpark1xRMSNorm(
+                hidden_size=self.head_dim,
+                eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+                has_weight=False,
+                is_post_norm=False,
+                zero_centered_gamma=False,
+                post_norm_gain_center_type=gain_center_type,
+            )
+            if self.use_o_norm
+            else None
+        )
+        self.fuse_o_norm_gate = self.use_o_norm and self.use_o_gate
+        self.rms_norm_eps = config.rms_norm_eps
+
+        self.scale_query_by = (
+            (
+                3.87
+                if config.use_sqrt_attn_scaling
+                else 43.7840518911 / math.sqrt(self.head_dim)
+            )
+            if is_draft
+            else config.qk_scale_factor
+        )
+        if self.use_qk_norm:
+            # Exact since RoPE is a rotation; keeps the QK-norm weightless.
+            self.scaling *= self.scale_query_by
+
+        self.pre_qkv_proj_norm = MuseSpark1xRMSNorm(
+            hidden_size=self.hidden_size,
+            eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+            has_weight=norm_affine,
+            is_post_norm=False,
+            zero_centered_gamma=zero_centered_gamma,
+            post_norm_gain_center_type=gain_center_type,
+            residual_id=2 * self.layer_idx + 1,  # matches the reference indexing
+        )
+
+        if not self.use_o_gate:
+            self.qkv_proj = QKVParallelLinear(
+                hidden_size=self.hidden_size,
+                head_size=self.head_dim,
+                total_num_heads=self.total_num_heads,
+                total_num_kv_heads=self.total_num_kv_heads,
+                bias=False,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.qkv_proj",
+            )
+        else:
+            self.qkv_proj = MuseSpark1xQKVOGateParallelLinear(
+                hidden_size=self.hidden_size,
+                head_size=self.head_dim,
+                total_num_heads=self.total_num_heads,
+                total_num_kv_heads=self.total_num_kv_heads,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.qkv_proj",
+            )
+        self.o_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            input_size=self.total_num_heads * self.head_dim,
+            output_size=self.hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.o_proj",
+        )
+
+        # GPT-J style: rotates interleaved adjacent channel pairs.
+        self.rotary_emb = (
+            RotaryEmbedding(
+                head_size=self.head_dim,
+                rotary_dim=self.head_dim,
+                max_position_embeddings=max_position_embeddings,
+                base=rope_theta,
+                is_neox_style=False,
+                dtype=(
+                    torch.float
+                    if not is_draft or config.rope_use_fp32_in_outer_product
+                    else self.default_dtype
+                ),
+            )
+            if self.use_rope
+            else None
+        )
+
+        sliding_window = None
+        if is_draft:
+            if global_attn_cfg := config.global_attn_cfg:
+                sw_entry = global_attn_cfg[
+                    self.count_backward_layer_id % len(global_attn_cfg)
+                ]
+                if isinstance(sw_entry, int) and sw_entry > 0:
+                    sliding_window = sw_entry
+        elif config.layer_types[self.layer_idx] == "sliding_attention":
+            sliding_window = config.sliding_window
+
+        self.use_attn_temperature_tuning = (
+            is_draft
+            and config.attn_temperature_tuning_floor_scale is not None
+            and config.attn_temperature_tuning_q_scale_constant is not None
+            and config.attn_temperature_tuning_layers == "global"
+            and sliding_window is None
+        )
+        if self.use_attn_temperature_tuning:
+            self.attn_temperature_tuning_floor_scale = (
+                config.attn_temperature_tuning_floor_scale
+            )
+            self.attn_temperature_tuning_q_scale = (
+                config.attn_temperature_tuning_q_scale_constant
+            )
+
+        self.attn = Attention(
+            self.num_heads,
+            self.head_dim,
+            self.scaling,
+            num_kv_heads=self.num_kv_heads,
+            cache_config=cache_config,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            per_layer_sliding_window=sliding_window,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.attn",
+        )
+
+        # Needs a model-written KV cache (ROCM_AITER_FA without shuffle layout).
+        self.fused_qk_norm_rope_kv_insert = (
+            self.use_qk_norm
+            and self.qk_norm is not None
+            and not self.qk_norm.has_weight
+            and not self.use_attn_temperature_tuning
+            and self.head_dim in (64, 128, 256)
+            and self.default_dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16)
+            and supports_fused_kv_insert(self.attn)
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def compute_attn_temperature_scale(
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        floor_scale: float,
+        q_scale: float,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Query scale: 1.0 up to ``floor_scale``, logarithmic above it."""
+        scaling = torch.log((positions.float() + 1.0) / floor_scale) * q_scale + 1.0
+        return scaling.clamp_min(1.0).unsqueeze(-1)
+
+    def _get_attn_temperature_scale(self, positions: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        assert self.attn_temperature_tuning_floor_scale is not None
+        assert self.attn_temperature_tuning_q_scale is not None
+        return self.compute_attn_temperature_scale(
+            positions,
+            self.attn_temperature_tuning_floor_scale,
+            self.attn_temperature_tuning_q_scale,
+        )
+
+    def _qk_norm_rope_kv_insert(
+        self, qkv: torch.Tensor, positions: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
+        """QK-norm, temperature scale and RoPE; returns ``(q, k, v, o_gate)``."""
+        cos_sin_cache = None
+        rotary_dim = 0
+        if self.use_rope:
+            assert self.rotary_emb is not None
+            cos_sin_cache = self.rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache
+            rotary_dim = self.rotary_emb.rotary_dim
+
+        if self.fused_qk_norm_rope_kv_insert:
+            rocm_fused_qk_norm_rope_kv_insert(
+                qkv,
+                positions,
+                cos_sin_cache,
+                self.attn.layer_name,
+                self.num_heads,
+                self.num_kv_heads,
+                self.head_dim,
+                rotary_dim,
+                self.rms_norm_eps,
+            )
+
+        if self.use_o_gate:
+            q, k, v, og = qkv.split(
+                [self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size, self.q_size], dim=-1
+            )
+        else:
+            q, k, v = qkv.split([self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1)
+            og = None
+        if self.fused_qk_norm_rope_kv_insert:
+            return q, k, v, og
+
+        if self.qk_norm is not None:
+            q = self.qk_norm(
+                q.reshape(-1, self.head_dim), out_dtype=torch.float32
+            ).reshape(-1, self.q_size)
+            k = self.qk_norm(
+                k.reshape(-1, self.head_dim), out_dtype=torch.float32
+            ).reshape(-1, self.kv_size)
+            q = q.to(v.dtype)
+            k = k.to(v.dtype)
+
+        if self.use_attn_temperature_tuning:
+            q = (q * self._get_attn_temperature_scale(positions)).to(q.dtype)
+
+        if self.rotary_emb is not None:
+            # forward_cuda takes the flat layout and rotates in place.
+            q, k = self.rotary_emb.forward_cuda(positions, q, k)
+        return q, k, v, og
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Attention over an input the caller has already normalized."""
+        qkv, _ = self.qkv_proj(hidden_states)
+
+        q, k, v, og = self._qk_norm_rope_kv_insert(qkv, positions)
+
+        # Withhold k/v so the attention layer does not rewrite the KV cache.
+        if self.fused_qk_norm_rope_kv_insert:
+            attn_output = self.attn(q, None, None)
+        else:
+            attn_output = self.attn(q, k, v)
+
+        if self.fuse_o_norm_gate:
+            assert og is not None
+            attn_output = attn_output.reshape(-1, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
+            og = og.reshape(-1, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
+            attn_output = rms_norm_gated(
+                attn_output,
+                og,
+                None,
+                None,
+                "sigmoid",
+                eps=self.rms_norm_eps,
+            )
+        else:
+            if self.use_o_norm:
+                assert self.o_norm is not None
+                attn_output = self.o_norm(attn_output.reshape(-1, self.head_dim))
+                attn_output = attn_output.reshape(-1, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
+            if self.use_o_gate:
+                assert og is not None
+                og = og.view(-1, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
+                if attn_output.dim() == 2:
+                    attn_output = attn_output.view(-1, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
+                attn_output = og.sigmoid() * attn_output
+
+        attn_output = attn_output.view(-1, self.num_heads * self.head_dim)
+        output, _ = self.o_proj(attn_output)
+        return output
+

+        self.residual_dtype = config.residual_dtype if is_draft else torch.float32
+        self.default_dtype = torch.get_default_dtype()

+        if not is_draft or config.use_residual_gate:

+                temperature=0.3 if is_draft else config.residual_gate_temperature,
+                use_stream_gate=True,
+                channel_wise=True,
+            )
+        else:
+            self.add_attn = MuseSpark1xResidualConnection()
+            self.add_ffn = MuseSpark1xResidualConnection()
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        x: MuseSpark1xResidualStream | torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> MuseSpark1xResidualStream:
+        """Run attention and FFN; the FFN boundary is returned unblended."""
+        if isinstance(x, torch.Tensor):
+            stream = x
+            attn_input = self.self_attn.pre_qkv_proj_norm(
+                stream, out_dtype=self.default_dtype
+            )
+        else:
+            attn_input, stream = norm_residual_then_norm(
+                x, self.self_attn.pre_qkv_proj_norm, out_dtype=self.default_dtype
+            )
+        assert stream.dtype == self.residual_dtype
+
+        attn_out = self.self_attn(positions=positions, hidden_states=attn_input)
+        ffn_in, stream = norm_residual_then_norm(
+            MuseSpark1xResidualStream(
+                stream=stream,
+                branch=attn_out,
+                post_norm=self.post_attn_norm,
+                connection=self.add_attn,
+            ),
+            self.pre_ffn_norm,
+            out_dtype=self.default_dtype,
+        )
+        branch = self.feed_forward(ffn_in)
+        return MuseSpark1xResidualStream(
+            stream=stream,
+            branch=branch,
+            post_norm=self.post_ffn_norm,
+            connection=self.add_ffn,
+        )
+
+
+def _drop_gate_up_stacking(base: WeightsMapper) -> WeightsMapper:
+    """Keep Quark's per-expert gate/up names unstacked for ``RoutedExperts``."""
+    return WeightsMapper(
+        orig_to_new_renaming=base.orig_to_new_renaming,
+        orig_to_new_regex=base.orig_to_new_regex,
+        orig_to_new_substr=base.orig_to_new_substr,
+        orig_to_new_stacked={
+            source: target
+            for source, target in base.orig_to_new_stacked.items()
+            if source not in (".gate_proj", ".up_proj")
+        },
+        orig_to_new_prefix=base.orig_to_new_prefix,
+        orig_to_new_suffix=base.orig_to_new_suffix,
+    )
+
+
+# Runs uncompiled under breakable cudagraphs; drop LlamaModel's torch.compile.
+@ignore_torch_compile
+class MuseSpark1xModel(LlamaModel):
+    hf_to_vllm_mapper = _drop_gate_up_stacking(LlamaModel.hf_to_vllm_mapper)
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        prefix: str = "",
+        layer_type: type[MuseSpark1xDecoderLayer] = MuseSpark1xDecoderLayer,
+    ):
+        super().__init__(vllm_config=vllm_config, prefix=prefix, layer_type=layer_type)
+
+        config = self.config
+        if get_pp_group().is_last_rank:
+            self.norm = MuseSpark1xRMSNorm(
+                config.hidden_size,
+                eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+                is_post_norm=False,
+                has_weight=True,
+                zero_centered_gamma=True,
+                post_norm_gain_center_type="one",
+                residual_id=-1,
+            )
+        else:
+            self.norm = PPMissingLayer()
+
+        self.tok_embeddings_norm = MuseSpark1xRMSNorm(
+            config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps, has_weight=False
+        )
+
+        self.default_dtype = torch.get_default_dtype()
+        self.residual_dtype = torch.float32
+
+        self.fuse_across_layers = get_pp_group().world_size == 1
+        self.make_empty_intermediate_tensors = self._make_empty_intermediate_tensors
+
+    def _make_empty_intermediate_tensors(
+        self, batch_size: int, dtype: torch.dtype, device: torch.device
+    ) -> IntermediateTensors:
+        return IntermediateTensors(
+            {
+                "hidden_states": torch.zeros(
+                    (batch_size, self.config.hidden_size),
+                    dtype=self.residual_dtype,
+                    device=device,
+                ),
+            }
+        )
+
+    def embed_input_ids(self, input_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        hidden_states = self.embed_tokens(input_ids)
+        return self.tok_embeddings_norm(hidden_states, out_dtype=self.residual_dtype)
+
+    def forward(  # type: ignore[override]
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor | None,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_tensors: IntermediateTensors | None,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | IntermediateTensors | tuple[torch.Tensor, list[torch.Tensor]]:
+        if get_pp_group().is_first_rank:
+            if inputs_embeds is not None:
+                hidden_states = inputs_embeds
+            else:
+                hidden_states = self.embed_input_ids(input_ids)
+        else:
+            assert intermediate_tensors is not None
+            hidden_states = intermediate_tensors["hidden_states"]
+
+        x: MuseSpark1xResidualStream | torch.Tensor = hidden_states.to(
+            self.residual_dtype
+        )
+        remote_aux = self.collect_remote_aux_hidden_states(intermediate_tensors)
+        aux_hidden_states: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+        if get_pp_group().is_first_rank:
+            self._maybe_add_hidden_state(aux_hidden_states, self.start_layer, x, None)
+        for idx, layer in enumerate(
+            self.layers[self.start_layer : self.end_layer], start=self.start_layer
+        ):
+            x = layer(positions, x)
+            if not self.fuse_across_layers and isinstance(x, MuseSpark1xResidualStream):
+                x = norm_then_gated_residual(x)
+            if idx + 1 in self.aux_hidden_state_layers:
+                state = (
+                    norm_then_gated_residual(x)
+                    if isinstance(x, MuseSpark1xResidualStream)
+                    else x
+                )
+                aux_hidden_states.append(state)
+
+        if not get_pp_group().is_last_rank:
+            assert isinstance(x, torch.Tensor)  # fuse_across_layers is off here
+            return IntermediateTensors(
+                {
+                    "hidden_states": x,
+                    **self.pack_local_aux_hidden_states(aux_hidden_states),
+                }
+            )
+
+        if isinstance(x, torch.Tensor):
+            output = self.norm(x, out_dtype=self.default_dtype)
+        else:
+            output, _ = norm_residual_then_norm(
+                x, self.norm, out_dtype=self.default_dtype
+            )
+        aux_hidden_states = remote_aux + aux_hidden_states
+        if aux_hidden_states:
+            return output, aux_hidden_states
+        return output
+
+
+class MuseSpark1xForCausalLM(LlamaForCausalLM, SupportsLoRA, MixtureOfExperts):
+    model_cls = MuseSpark1xModel

+        QuarkConfig,

+    packed_modules_mapping = {
+        "qkv_proj": ["q_proj", "k_proj", "v_proj"],
+        "gate_up_proj": ["gate_proj", "up_proj"],

+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,

+                "native vLLM text stack."

+                "MuseSpark1x on ROCm only supports "
+                f"{self.supported_quantization_description} quantized checkpoints; "
+                "got quantization "
+                f"{vllm_config.quant_config.get_name()!r}."
+            )
+        if layer_type is None:
+            layer_type = self.decoder_layer_cls
+
+        super().__init__(vllm_config=vllm_config, prefix=prefix, layer_type=layer_type)
+
+        # qkv_proj fuses Q+K+V+OG, so LoRA must treat it as one module.
+        self.packed_modules_mapping = {  # type: ignore[misc]
+            k: v for k, v in self.packed_modules_mapping.items() if k != "qkv_proj"
+        }
+
+        self.metap_output_multiplier = config.output_multiplier
+        self.output_soft_cap_temp = config.final_logit_softcapping
+
+        self.mul_tanh_soft_cap = (
+            MulTanhSoftCap(
+                multiplier=self.metap_output_multiplier,
+                soft_cap_temp=self.output_soft_cap_temp,
+            )
+            if (
+                self.metap_output_multiplier != 1.0
+                and self.output_soft_cap_temp is not None
+            )
+            else None
+        )
+
+        if get_pp_group().is_last_rank:
+            self.logits_processor.scale = 1.0
+
+        self.set_moe_parameters()
+
+    def _init_model(
+        self,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        prefix: str = "",
+        layer_type: type[MuseSpark1xDecoderLayer] = MuseSpark1xDecoderLayer,
+    ):
+        return self.model_cls(
+            vllm_config=vllm_config, prefix=prefix, layer_type=layer_type
+        )
+
+    def set_moe_parameters(self):
+        self.moe_layers: list[nn.Module] = []
+        example_moe = None
+        for layer in self.model.layers:
+            if isinstance(layer, PPMissingLayer):
+                continue
+
+            assert isinstance(layer, MuseSpark1xDecoderLayer)
+            if isinstance(layer.feed_forward, MuseSpark1xMoE):
+                example_moe = layer.feed_forward
+                self.moe_layers.append(layer.feed_forward.experts)
+
+        if example_moe is None:
+            self.num_moe_layers = 0
+            self.num_expert_groups = 0
+            self.num_logical_experts = 0
+            self.num_physical_experts = 0
+            self.num_local_physical_experts = 0
+            self.num_routed_experts = 0
+            self.num_shared_experts = 0
+            self.num_redundant_experts = 0
+            logger.warning("No MuseSpark1xMoE layer found in model.layers.")
+        else:
+            self.num_moe_layers = len(self.moe_layers)
+            self.num_expert_groups = 1
+            self.num_logical_experts = example_moe.n_logical_experts
+            self.num_physical_experts = example_moe.n_physical_experts
+            self.num_local_physical_experts = example_moe.n_local_physical_experts
+            self.num_routed_experts = example_moe.n_routed_experts
+            self.num_shared_experts = example_moe.n_shared_experts
+            self.num_redundant_experts = example_moe.n_redundant_experts
+
+    def update_physical_experts_metadata(
+        self,
+        num_physical_experts: int,
+        num_local_physical_experts: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        assert self.num_local_physical_experts == num_local_physical_experts
+        self.num_physical_experts = num_physical_experts
+        self.num_local_physical_experts = num_local_physical_experts
+        self.num_redundant_experts = num_physical_experts - self.num_logical_experts
+        for layer in self.model.layers:
+            if isinstance(layer, PPMissingLayer):
+                continue
+
+            if isinstance(layer.feed_forward, MuseSpark1xMoE):
+                moe = layer.feed_forward
+                moe.n_local_physical_experts = num_local_physical_experts
+                moe.n_physical_experts = num_physical_experts
+                moe.n_redundant_experts = self.num_redundant_experts
+                moe.experts.update_expert_map()
+
+    def compute_logits(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        hidden_states = hidden_states.to(self.lm_head.weight.dtype)
+        logits = self.logits_processor(self.lm_head, hidden_states)
+        if logits is None:
+            return None
+        if logits.dtype != torch.float32:
+            logits = logits.to(torch.float32)
+        if self.mul_tanh_soft_cap is not None:
+            return self.mul_tanh_soft_cap(logits)
+        if self.metap_output_multiplier != 1.0:
+            logits = logits * self.metap_output_multiplier
+        if self.output_soft_cap_temp is not None:
+            logits = self.output_soft_cap_temp * torch.tanh(
+                logits / self.output_soft_cap_temp
+            )
+        return logits
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        def interleaved_weights() -> Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+            config = self.model.config
+            qk_rows = (
+                config.num_attention_heads * config.head_dim,
+                config.num_key_value_heads * config.head_dim,
+            )
+            for name, weight in weights:
+                if (
+                    name.startswith(
+                        ("model.language_model.layers.", "model.layers.", "layers.")
+                    )
+                    and (".self_attn.q_proj." in name or ".self_attn.k_proj." in name)
+                    and name.rsplit(".", 1)[-1].startswith("weight")
+                    and weight.dim() >= 1
+                    and weight.shape[0] in qk_rows
+                ):
+                    # HF stores Q/K rows as [even | odd] per head (NoPE too);
+                    # restore interleaved pairs before TP slicing. Per-row
+                    # scales move with their rows; 0-d scales stay.
+                    shape = weight.shape
+                    weight = (
+                        weight.reshape(-1, 2, config.head_dim // 2, *shape[1:])
+                        .transpose(1, 2)
+                        .reshape(shape)
+                    )
+                yield name, weight
+
+        loader = AutoWeightsLoader(self)
+        loaded = loader.load_weights(
+            interleaved_weights(), mapper=self.hf_to_vllm_mapper
+        )
+        n_gates = materialize_residual_path_constants(self)
+        logger.info(
+            "Materialized residual-path constants for %d gated residual connections",
+            n_gates,
+        )
+        return loaded
+
+

+    "MuseSpark1xMoE",
+    "MuseSpark1xModel",
+    "MuseSparkTorchLinearMethod",
+    "norm_residual_then_norm",
+]

+        self,
+        output: torch.Tensor | None,
+        fused_expert_output: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_weights: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        apply_router_weight_on_input: bool,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if apply_router_weight_on_input:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "MuseSpark1x requires router weights after the post-expert norm."
+            )
+
+        if self.take_route_output is not None:
+            route_output = self.take_route_output()
+            if route_output is not None:
+                fused_expert_output = route_output
+        expert_map = (
+            self.take_route_expert_map()
+            if self.take_route_expert_map is not None
+            else None
+        )
+        num_tokens, top_k = topk_ids.shape
+        hidden_dim = fused_expert_output.shape[-1]
+        routed = fused_expert_output.view(num_tokens, top_k, hidden_dim)
+
+        if output is None:
+            output = torch.empty(
+                (num_tokens, hidden_dim),
+                dtype=routed.dtype,
+                device=routed.device,
+            )
+        if output.shape != (num_tokens, hidden_dim):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "MuseSpark1x MoE output has shape "
+                f"{tuple(output.shape)}, expected {(num_tokens, hidden_dim)}."
+            )
+        if expert_map is not None and (
+            self.pre_norm_all_reduce or self.fused_norm is None
+        ):
+            # Only the fused finalize masks unwritten non-local routes itself.
+            routed.masked_fill_((expert_map[topk_ids.long()] < 0).unsqueeze(-1), 0)
+            expert_map = None
+
+        chunk_size = self._chunk_size(top_k, hidden_dim)
+        for start in range(0, num_tokens, chunk_size):
+            end = min(start + chunk_size, num_tokens)
+            rows = routed[start:end]
+            if (
+                self.pre_norm_all_reduce
+                and self.fused_norm is not None
+                and rows.shape[0] >= self.rs_min_tokens
+                and (tp_size := get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()) > 1
+            ):
+                self._token_sharded_finalize(
+                    rows.to(self.reduce_dtype),
+                    topk_weights[start:end],
+                    output[start:end],
+                    tp_size,
+                )
+                continue
+            if self.pre_norm_all_reduce:
+                rows = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(rows.to(self.reduce_dtype))
+
+            if self.fused_norm is not None:
+                fused_post_expert_finalize(
+                    rows,
+                    self.fused_norm.weight if self.fused_norm.has_weight else None,
+                    topk_weights[start:end],
+                    self.fused_norm.variance_epsilon,
+                    self.fused_norm.fused_gain_center,
+                    self.fused_norm.applies_weight_before_norm,
+                    output[start:end],
+                    topk_ids=None if expert_map is None else topk_ids[start:end],
+                    expert_map=expert_map,
+                )
+                continue
+            normalized = self.post_expert_norm_fn(rows, out_dtype=torch.float32)
+            normalized.mul_(topk_weights[start:end].float().unsqueeze(-1))
+            output[start:end].copy_(normalized.sum(dim=1).to(output.dtype))
+
+        return output
+
+    def _token_sharded_finalize(
+        self,
+        rows: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_weights: torch.Tensor,
+        out: torch.Tensor,
+        tp_size: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        num_tokens, top_k, hidden_dim = rows.shape
+        pad = (-num_tokens) % tp_size
+        if pad:
+            rows = torch.cat([rows, rows.new_zeros((pad, top_k, hidden_dim))])
+            topk_weights = torch.cat(
+                [topk_weights, topk_weights.new_zeros((pad, top_k))]
+            )
+        local = tensor_model_parallel_reduce_scatter(rows, dim=0)
+        per_rank = local.shape[0]
+        rank = get_tensor_model_parallel_rank()
+        tw_local = topk_weights[rank * per_rank : (rank + 1) * per_rank]
+        out_local = torch.empty(
+            (per_rank, hidden_dim), dtype=out.dtype, device=out.device
+        )
+        norm = self.fused_norm
+        assert norm is not None
+        fused_post_expert_finalize(
+            local,
+            norm.weight if norm.has_weight else None,
+            tw_local,
+            norm.variance_epsilon,
+            norm.fused_gain_center,
+            norm.applies_weight_before_norm,
+            out_local,
+        )
+        gathered = tensor_model_parallel_all_gather(out_local, dim=0)
+        out.copy_(gathered[:num_tokens])
+

+class MuseSparkAiterExperts(_RouteOutputHandoff, AiterMxfp4Experts):
+    """AITER experts that return one unweighted output per selected route."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        moe_config: FusedMoEConfig,
+        quant_config: FusedMoEQuantConfig,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(moe_config, quant_config)
+        if not isinstance(quant_config, MuseSparkQuarkOCPMXMoEQuantConfig):
+            raise TypeError(
+                "MuseSparkAiterExperts requires MuseSparkQuarkOCPMXMoEQuantConfig."
+            )
+        if quant_config.post_expert_norm_fn is None:
+            raise ValueError("MuseSpark1x post-expert norm is not configured.")
+        self._unit_weights_bufs: dict[int, torch.Tensor] = {}
+
+    def _unit_weights(
+        self, num_routes: int, width: int, device: torch.device
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """A cached ``[num_routes, width]`` fp32 ones buffer (grown on demand)."""
+        buf = self._unit_weights_bufs.get(width)
+        if buf is None or buf.shape[0] < num_routes or buf.device != device:
+            buf = torch.ones(
+                (max(num_routes, 1), width), dtype=torch.float32, device=device
+            )
+            self._unit_weights_bufs[width] = buf
+        return buf[:num_routes]
+
+    def workspace_shapes(
+        self,
+        M: int,
+        N: int,
+        K: int,
+        topk: int,
+        global_num_experts: int,
+        local_num_experts: int,
+        expert_tokens_meta: mk.ExpertTokensMetadata | None,
+        activation: MoEActivation,
+    ) -> tuple[tuple[int, ...], tuple[int, ...], tuple[int, ...]]:
+        workspace13, workspace2, _ = super().workspace_shapes(
+            M,
+            N,
+            K,
+            topk,
+            global_num_experts,
+            local_num_experts,
+            expert_tokens_meta,
+            activation,
+        )
+        return workspace13, workspace2, (M, topk, K)
+
+    def apply(
+        self,
+        output: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        w1: torch.Tensor,
+        w2: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_weights: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        activation: MoEActivation,
+        global_num_experts: int,
+        expert_map: torch.Tensor | None,
+        a1q_scale: torch.Tensor | None,
+        a2_scale: torch.Tensor | None,
+        workspace13: torch.Tensor,
+        workspace2: torch.Tensor,
+        expert_tokens_meta: mk.ExpertTokensMetadata | None,
+        apply_router_weight_on_input: bool,
+    ) -> None:
+        if apply_router_weight_on_input:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "MuseSpark1x requires router weights after the post-expert norm."
+            )
+
+        num_tokens, top_k = topk_ids.shape
+        hidden_dim = hidden_states.shape[-1]
+        expected_output_shape = (num_tokens, top_k, hidden_dim)
+        if output.shape != expected_output_shape:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "MuseSpark1x AITER output has shape "
+                f"{tuple(output.shape)}, expected {expected_output_shape}."
+            )
+
+        expanded_hidden_states = take_expanded(hidden_states, top_k)
+        if expanded_hidden_states is None:
+            expanded_hidden_states = (
+                hidden_states[:, None, :]
+                .expand(num_tokens, top_k, hidden_dim)
+                .reshape(num_tokens * top_k, hidden_dim)
+                .contiguous()
+            )
+        # Only the shape of topk_ids is read after the experts.
+        num_routes = num_tokens * top_k
+        flat_topk_ids = topk_ids.view(num_routes, 1)
+        if expert_map is not None:
+            # AITER's EP convention: one extra route per row on the always-masked
+            # last expert_mask slot; its tuned-config lookup subtracts it.
+            masked_slot = flat_topk_ids.new_full(
+                (num_routes, 1), expert_map.shape[0] - 1
+            )
+            flat_topk_ids = torch.cat((flat_topk_ids, masked_slot), dim=1)
+        unit_topk_weights = self._unit_weights(
+            num_routes, flat_topk_ids.shape[1], topk_ids.device
+        )
+
+        if expert_tokens_meta is not None:
+            num_local_tokens = expert_tokens_meta.expert_num_tokens
+        else:
+            num_local_tokens = None
+
+        route_output = rocm_aiter_fused_experts(
+            hidden_states=expanded_hidden_states,
+            w1=w1,
+            w2=w2,
+            topk_weights=unit_topk_weights,
+            topk_ids=flat_topk_ids,
+            activation=activation,
+            expert_mask=expert_map,
+            quant_config=self.quant_config,
+            moe_config=self.moe_config,
+            a1q_scale=a1q_scale,
+            num_local_tokens=num_local_tokens,
+            output_dtype=output.dtype,
+            moe_sorting_dispatch_policy=rocm_aiter_ops.get_moe_dispatch_policy(),
+            apply_router_weight_on_input=False,
+        )
+        self._park_route_output(route_output.view_as(output))
+
+    def finalize_weight_and_reduce_impl(self) -> mk.TopKWeightAndReduce:
+        quant_config = self.quant_config
+        assert isinstance(quant_config, MuseSparkQuarkOCPMXMoEQuantConfig)
+        assert quant_config.post_expert_norm_fn is not None
+        return MuseSparkTopKWeightAndReduce(
+            quant_config.post_expert_norm_fn,
+            pre_norm_all_reduce=self.moe_config.moe_parallel_config.tp_size > 1,
+            take_route_output=self._take_route_output,
+        )

+def _quantize_experts_to_mxfp4(
+    weight: torch.Tensor, experts_per_chunk: int = 32
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Round ``[experts, rows, cols]`` weights to packed OCP MXFP4."""
+    from aiter.ops.triton.quant import dynamic_mxfp4_quant
+
+    num_experts, rows, cols = weight.shape
+    packed = torch.empty(
+        (num_experts, rows, cols // 2), dtype=torch.uint8, device=weight.device
+    )
+    scales = torch.empty(
+        (num_experts, rows, cols // OCP_MX_BLOCK_SIZE),
+        dtype=torch.uint8,
+        device=weight.device,
+    )
+    for start in range(0, num_experts, experts_per_chunk):
+        chunk = weight[start : start + experts_per_chunk]
+        chunk_packed, chunk_scales = dynamic_mxfp4_quant(chunk.reshape(-1, cols))
+        packed[start : start + chunk.shape[0]] = chunk_packed.view(
+            chunk.shape[0], rows, -1
+        )
+        scales[start : start + chunk.shape[0]] = chunk_scales.view(torch.uint8).view(
+            chunk.shape[0], rows, -1
+        )[..., : cols // OCP_MX_BLOCK_SIZE]
+    return packed, scales
+

+class MuseSparkOnlineMXFP4FusedMoE(MuseSparkQuarkOCPMXFusedMoE):
+    """Unquantized routed experts rounded to OCP MXFP4 (W4A4) after loading."""
+
+    def __init__(self, moe: FusedMoEConfig) -> None:
+        super().__init__(
+            moe, _WEIGHT_QUANT_KEY_MAP["mxfp4"], _ACTIVATION_QUANT_KEY_MAP["mxfp4"]
+        )
+
+    def create_weights(
+        self,
+        layer: RoutedExperts,
+        num_experts: int,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        intermediate_size_per_partition: int,
+        params_dtype: torch.dtype,
+        **extra_weight_attrs,
+    ) -> None:
+        for name, shape in (
+            (
+                "w13_weight",
+                (
+                    num_experts,
+                    self.moe.w13_num_shards * intermediate_size_per_partition,
+                    hidden_size,
+                ),
+            ),
+            ("w2_weight", (num_experts, hidden_size, intermediate_size_per_partition)),
+        ):
+            param = torch.nn.Parameter(
+                torch.empty(shape, dtype=params_dtype), requires_grad=False
+            )
+            layer.register_parameter(name, param)
+            set_weight_attrs(param, extra_weight_attrs)
+        layer.w13_bias, layer.w2_bias = None, None
+        layer.w13_input_scale, layer.w2_input_scale = None, None
+
+    def process_weights_after_loading(self, layer: RoutedExperts) -> None:
+        for name in ("w13_weight", "w2_weight"):
+            packed, scales = _quantize_experts_to_mxfp4(getattr(layer, name).data)
+            delattr(layer, name)
+            layer.register_parameter(
+                name, torch.nn.Parameter(packed, requires_grad=False)
+            )
+            layer.register_parameter(
+                f"{name}_scale", torch.nn.Parameter(scales, requires_grad=False)
+            )
+        torch.accelerator.empty_cache()
+        super().process_weights_after_loading(layer)

+def _online_mxfp4_applies(prefix: str) -> bool:
+    """Whether this layer's unquantized experts are rounded to MXFP4 on load.
+
+    The first and last decoder layers stay BF16, as in the Quark MXFP4 export.
+    """
+    if envs.VLLM_ROCM_MUSE_MOE_ONLINE_QUANT != "mxfp4":
+        return False
+    num_layers = get_current_vllm_config().model_config.hf_text_config.num_hidden_layers
+    return extract_layer_index(prefix) not in (0, num_layers - 1)

+_QUARK_EXPERT_PROJECTIONS = {
+    "gate_proj": ("w13_weight", "w1"),
+    "up_proj": ("w13_weight", "w3"),
+    "down_proj": ("w2_weight", "w2"),
+}

+def _quark_expert_weight_slot(name: str) -> tuple[str, str, int] | None:
+    parts = name.split(".")
+    if len(parts) != 3 or not parts[0].isdigit():
+        return None
+    projection = _QUARK_EXPERT_PROJECTIONS.get(parts[1])
+    if projection is None or parts[2] not in ("weight", "weight_scale"):
+        return None
+    param_name, shard_id = projection
+    if parts[2] == "weight_scale":
+        param_name += "_scale"
+    return param_name, shard_id, int(parts[0])

+def _expected_quark_expert_weight_slots(
+    num_experts: int,
+) -> set[tuple[str, str, int]]:
+    return {
+        (param_name, shard_id, expert_id)
+        for expert_id in range(num_experts)
+        for param_name, shard_id in (
+            ("w13_weight", "w1"),
+            ("w13_weight", "w3"),
+            ("w2_weight", "w2"),
+            ("w13_weight_scale", "w1"),
+            ("w13_weight_scale", "w3"),
+            ("w2_weight_scale", "w2"),
+        )
+    }
+
+
+def _track_quark_expert_weights(
+    weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]],
+    loaded: set[tuple[str, str, int]],
+) -> Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+    """Track expert tensors across the loader's independently grouped calls."""
+    for name, tensor in weights:
+        slot = _quark_expert_weight_slot(name)
+        if slot is not None:
+            if slot in loaded:
+                raise ValueError(f"Duplicate MuseSpark1x expert tensor {name!r}.")
+            loaded.add(slot)
+        yield name, tensor
+
+
+def _validate_quark_expert_weights(
+    loaded: set[tuple[str, str, int]],
+    num_experts: int,
+) -> None:
+    expected = _expected_quark_expert_weight_slots(num_experts)
+    missing = expected - loaded
+    if missing:
+        loaded_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
+        for param_name, shard_id, _ in loaded:
+            key = f"{param_name}:{shard_id}"
+            loaded_counts[key] = loaded_counts.get(key, 0) + 1
+        preview = ", ".join(
+            f"{param_name}:{shard_id}:expert{expert_id}"
+            for param_name, shard_id, expert_id in sorted(missing)[:8]
+        )
+        if len(missing) > 8:
+            preview += f", ... ({len(missing)} total)"
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Missing MuseSpark1x Quark expert tensors: "
+            f"{preview}; loaded slot counts: {loaded_counts}"
+        )
+
+    unexpected = loaded - expected
+    if unexpected:
+        preview = ", ".join(
+            f"{param_name}:{shard_id}:expert{expert_id}"
+            for param_name, shard_id, expert_id in sorted(unexpected)[:8]
+        )
+        if len(unexpected) > 8:
+            preview += f", ... ({len(unexpected)} total)"
+        raise ValueError(f"Unexpected MuseSpark1x Quark expert tensors: {preview}")
+
+
+class MuseSparkRoutedExperts(MuseSparkConsolidatedRoutedExperts):
+    """MuseSpark routed experts using ROCm BF16, FP8, or MXFP4 methods."""
+
+    def _get_quant_method(
+        self,
+        prefix: str,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None,
+        moe_config: FusedMoEConfig,
+    ) -> FusedMoEMethodBase:
+        if quant_config is None:
+            if _online_mxfp4_applies(prefix):
+                return MuseSparkOnlineMXFP4FusedMoE(moe_config)
+            return MuseSparkUnquantizedFusedMoE(moe_config)
+        if not isinstance(quant_config, QuarkConfig):
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "MuseSpark1x on ROCm supports BF16, Quark FP8, or Quark OCP-MXFP4 "
+                f"checkpoints; got {quant_config.get_name()!r}."
+            )
+
+        quant_method = quant_config.get_quant_method(self, prefix)
+        if isinstance(quant_method, UnquantizedFusedMoEMethod):
+            return MuseSparkUnquantizedFusedMoE(moe_config)
+        if isinstance(quant_method, QuarkW8A8Fp8MoEMethod):
+            return MuseSparkQuarkW8A8Fp8FusedMoE(
+                moe_config,
+                quant_method.weight_quant_key,
+                quant_method.activation_quant_key,
+            )
+        if not isinstance(quant_method, QuarkOCP_MX_MoEMethod):
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "MuseSpark1x on ROCm requires Quark W8A8 FP8 or OCP-MXFP4 for routed "
+                f"experts; got {type(quant_method).__name__}."
+            )
+        return MuseSparkQuarkOCPMXFusedMoE(
+            moe_config,
+            quant_method.weight_quant_key,
+            quant_method.activation_quant_key,
+        )
+
+    def load_weights(
+        self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]
+    ) -> Iterable[str]:
+        if isinstance(
+            self.quant_method, MuseSparkOnlineMXFP4FusedMoE
+        ) or not isinstance(
+            self.quant_method,
+            (MuseSparkQuarkW8A8Fp8FusedMoE, MuseSparkQuarkOCPMXFusedMoE),
+        ):
+            # Quark's unquantized layers (0 and 61) store per-expert tensors.
+            consolidated: list[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]] = []
+            per_expert: list[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]] = []
+            for name, tensor in weights:
+                if _quark_expert_weight_slot(name) is None:
+                    consolidated.append((name, tensor))
+                else:
+                    per_expert.append((name, tensor))
+            if consolidated:
+                yield from super().load_weights(consolidated)
+            if per_expert:
+                yield from RoutedExperts.load_weights(self, per_expert)
+            return
+
+        loaded_slots = getattr(self, "_quark_expert_loaded_slots", None)
+        if loaded_slots is None:
+            loaded_slots = set()
+            self._quark_expert_loaded_slots = loaded_slots
+        tracked_weights = _track_quark_expert_weights(weights, loaded_slots)
+        yield from RoutedExperts.load_weights(self, tracked_weights)
+
+
+class MuseMoERunner(MoERunner):
+    """MoE runner whose custom reducer owns the TP reduction."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *args,
+        post_expert_norm: torch.nn.Module,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+        if not isinstance(self.routed_experts, MuseSparkRoutedExperts):
+            raise TypeError(
+                "MuseMoERunner requires routed_experts_cls=MuseSparkRoutedExperts."
+            )
+        self.routed_experts.post_expert_norm_fn = post_expert_norm.forward
+
+    @property
+    def _fused_output_is_reduced(self) -> bool:
+        return needs_pre_norm_all_reduce(self.moe_config)
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "MuseMoERunner",
+    "MuseSpark1xRouter",
+    "MuseSparkAiterExperts",
+    "MuseSparkQuarkFp8MoEQuantConfig",
+    "MuseSparkQuarkOCPMXFusedMoE",
+    "MuseSparkQuarkW8A8Fp8FusedMoE",
+    "MuseSparkRoutedExperts",
+    "MuseSparkTopKWeightAndReduce",
+    "MuseSparkTritonExperts",
+    "validate_bf16_deployment",
+    "validate_fp8_deployment",
+    "validate_mxfp4_deployment",
+]

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Pre-expert RMSNorm written once per route, in the ``[T * top_k, H]`` layout
+the ROCm MXFP4 (AITER top-1 per route) experts take."""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+# Set on the returned first-route view; holds the full expanded buffer.
+_EXPANDED_ATTR = "_muse_route_expanded"
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _rmsnorm_expand_kernel(
+    x_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    D: tl.constexpr,
+    eps,
+    gain_center,
+    REPEATS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_D: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    INPUT_SCALE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    t = tl.program_id(0)
+    d = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_D)
+    dm = d < D
+    x = tl.load(x_ptr + t * D + d, mask=dm, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+    if HAS_WEIGHT:
+        w = tl.load(w_ptr + d, mask=dm, other=0.0).to(tl.float32) + gain_center
+        if INPUT_SCALE:
+            x = x * w
+    y = x * tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(x * x, axis=0) * (1.0 / D) + eps)
+    if HAS_WEIGHT and not INPUT_SCALE:
+        y = y * w
+    y = y.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty)
+    for r in tl.static_range(REPEATS):
+        tl.store(out_ptr + (t * REPEATS + r) * D + d, y, mask=dm)
+
+
+def fused_rmsnorm_expand(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+    eps: float,
+    gain_center: float,
+    input_scale: bool,
+    repeats: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """RMSNorm of ``x`` written ``repeats`` times per row."""
+    assert x.dim() == 2 and x.is_contiguous()
+    T, D = x.shape
+    out = torch.empty((T, repeats, D), dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)
+    if T > 0:
+        block_d = triton.next_power_of_2(D)
+        _rmsnorm_expand_kernel[(T,)](
+            x,
+            weight if weight is not None else x,
+            out,
+            D=D,
+            eps=eps,
+            gain_center=gain_center,
+            REPEATS=repeats,
+            BLOCK_D=block_d,
+            HAS_WEIGHT=weight is not None,
+            INPUT_SCALE=input_scale and weight is not None,
+            num_warps=8 if block_d >= 4096 else 4,
+        )
+    first = out[:, 0]
+    setattr(first, _EXPANDED_ATTR, out)
+    return first
+
+
+def take_expanded(hidden_states: torch.Tensor, repeats: int) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+    """The ``[T * repeats, D]`` buffer behind a :func:`fused_rmsnorm_expand`
+    result, or ``None`` if ``hidden_states`` is not one."""
+    out = getattr(hidden_states, _EXPANDED_ATTR, None)
+    if (
+        out is None
+        or out.data_ptr() != hidden_states.data_ptr()
+        or out.shape != (hidden_states.shape[0], repeats, hidden_states.shape[1])
+        or hidden_states.stride() != (repeats * hidden_states.shape[1], 1)
+    ):
+        return None
+    return out.view(-1, hidden_states.shape[1])

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""FP32-exact router GEMM on bf16 matrix cores.
+
+Three bf16 planes sum exactly to the fp32 weight; split-K sums in fixed order.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+# (max tokens, BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N, BLOCK_K, splits, num_warps), tuned on MI350X
+# for the Muse router shape (N=256, K=8192).
+_CONFIGS = (
+    (16, 16, 32, 128, 32, 2),
+    (64, 64, 32, 128, 32, 2),
+    (128, 64, 32, 128, 16, 2),
+    (256, 64, 64, 128, 16, 4),
+    (1024, 128, 64, 128, 16, 8),
+    (4096, 128, 128, 64, 8, 8),
+    (None, 128, 128, 64, 4, 8),
+)
+
+
+def _config(num_tokens: int) -> tuple[int, int, int, int, int]:
+    for max_tokens, *cfg in _CONFIGS:
+        if max_tokens is None or num_tokens <= max_tokens:
+            return tuple(cfg)  # type: ignore[return-value]
+    raise AssertionError("unreachable")
+
+
+def supports_router_bf16x3(num_experts: int, hidden_size: int) -> bool:
+    return all(
+        num_experts % bn == 0 and hidden_size % (splits * bk) == 0
+        for _, _, bn, bk, splits, _ in _CONFIGS
+    )
+
+
+def split_fp32_to_bf16x3(weight: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``[3, N, K]`` bf16 planes whose sum is ``weight`` (fp32) exactly."""
+    assert weight.dtype == torch.float32
+    hi = weight.to(torch.bfloat16)
+    rest = weight - hi.float()
+    mid = rest.to(torch.bfloat16)
+    lo = (rest - mid.float()).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    return torch.stack([hi, mid, lo]).contiguous()
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _router_bf16x3_kernel(
+    x_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    part_ptr,
+    M,
+    N: tl.constexpr,
+    K: tl.constexpr,
+    K_PER_SPLIT: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    pid_n = tl.program_id(0)
+    pid_k = tl.program_id(1)
+    pid_m = tl.program_id(2)
+    offs_m = pid_m * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)
+    offs_n = pid_n * BLOCK_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
+    m_mask = offs_m < M
+    acc = tl.zeros([BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N], dtype=tl.float32)
+    for kk in range(0, K_PER_SPLIT, BLOCK_K):
+        offs_k = pid_k * K_PER_SPLIT + kk + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+        a = tl.load(
+            x_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * K + offs_k[None, :],
+            mask=m_mask[:, None],
+            other=0.0,
+        )
+        w_tile = w_ptr + offs_n[None, :] * K + offs_k[:, None]
+        for p in tl.static_range(3):
+            acc = tl.dot(a, tl.load(w_tile + p * N * K), acc)
+    tl.store(
+        part_ptr + (pid_k * M + offs_m[:, None]) * N + offs_n[None, :],
+        acc,
+        mask=m_mask[:, None],
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _reduce_splits_kernel(
+    part_ptr, out_ptr, MN, SPLITS: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr
+):
+    offs = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = offs < MN
+    acc = tl.load(part_ptr + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+    for s in tl.static_range(1, SPLITS):
+        acc += tl.load(part_ptr + s * MN + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+    tl.store(out_ptr + offs, acc, mask=mask)
+
+
+def router_bf16x3_gemm(x: torch.Tensor, planes: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``x @ (planes[0] + planes[1] + planes[2]).T`` in fp32."""
+    assert x.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and x.is_contiguous()
+    m, k = x.shape
+    n = planes.shape[1]
+    assert planes.shape == (3, n, k)
+    out = torch.empty((m, n), dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device)
+    if m == 0:
+        return out
+    block_m, block_n, block_k, splits, num_warps = _config(m)
+    part = torch.empty((splits, m, n), dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device)
+    _router_bf16x3_kernel[(n // block_n, splits, triton.cdiv(m, block_m))](
+        x,
+        planes,
+        part,
+        m,
+        N=n,
+        K=k,
+        K_PER_SPLIT=k // splits,
+        BLOCK_M=block_m,
+        BLOCK_N=block_n,
+        BLOCK_K=block_k,
+        num_warps=num_warps,
+    )
+    block = 1024
+    _reduce_splits_kernel[(triton.cdiv(m * n, block),)](
+        part, out, m * n, SPLITS=splits, BLOCK=block, num_warps=4
+    )
+    return out

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Waveform AutoEncoder for MuseSpark raw audio input.
+
+Each patch of 1920 samples (80 ms @ 24 kHz) yields one latent token.
+"""
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.layernorm import RMSNorm
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import (
+    ColumnParallelLinear,
+    RowParallelLinear,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import maybe_prefix
+
+
+def patchify(x: torch.Tensor, patch_size: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Group consecutive timesteps: [B, T, D] -> [B, T // p, p * D]."""
+    b, t, d = x.shape
+    assert t % patch_size == 0, f"t={t} is not divisible by patch_size={patch_size}"
+    return x.reshape(b, t // patch_size, patch_size * d)
+
+
+class Patchifier(nn.Module):
+    """Patchify -> Linear -> RMSNorm."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        patch_size: int,
+        d_input: int,
+        d_output: int,
+        prefix: str = "",
+        disable_tp: bool = True,
+        norm_eps: float = 1e-6,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.patch_size = patch_size
+        self.linear = ColumnParallelLinear(
+            input_size=d_input * patch_size,
+            output_size=d_output,
+            bias=True,
+            gather_output=True,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "linear"),
+            disable_tp=disable_tp,
+        )
+        self.norm = RMSNorm(d_output, eps=norm_eps)
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        x = patchify(x, self.patch_size)
+        x, _ = self.linear(x)
+        return self.norm(x)
+
+
+class DepthwiseCausalConv(nn.Module):
+    """Depthwise causal 1-D convolution with optional streaming cache."""
+
+    def __init__(self, d_model: int, kernel_size: int) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self._kernel_size = kernel_size
+        self.conv = nn.Conv1d(
+            in_channels=d_model,
+            out_channels=d_model,
+            kernel_size=kernel_size,
+            stride=1,
+            padding=0,
+            bias=True,
+            groups=d_model,
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        cache: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
+        """[B, T, D] -> [B, T, D]; ``cache`` is [B, D, kernel_size - 1] or None."""
+        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)  # [B, D, T]
+
+        if cache is None:
+            x = F.pad(x, (self._kernel_size - 1, 0))
+            x = self.conv(x)
+            new_cache = None
+        else:
+            x = torch.cat((cache, x), dim=-1)
+            if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+                # CUDA-graph safe: in-place update.
+                cache.copy_(x[:, :, -self._kernel_size + 1 :])
+                new_cache = cache
+            else:
+                new_cache = x[:, :, -self._kernel_size + 1 :]
+            x = self.conv(x)
+
+        # The downstream fused RMSNorm kernel requires a contiguous buffer.
+        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1).contiguous()  # [B, T, D]
+        return x, new_cache
+
+
+class Block(nn.Module):
+    """DepthwiseCausalConv -> RMSNorm -> FFN (GELU) with a residual."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        d_model: int,
+        d_hidden: int,
+        kernel_size: int,
+        prefix: str = "",
+        disable_tp: bool = True,
+        norm_eps: float = 1e-6,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self._d_model = d_model
+        self._kernel_size = kernel_size
+        self.conv = DepthwiseCausalConv(d_model, kernel_size)
+        self.norm = RMSNorm(d_model, eps=norm_eps)
+        self.linear1 = ColumnParallelLinear(
+            input_size=d_model,
+            output_size=d_hidden,
+            bias=True,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "linear1"),
+            disable_tp=disable_tp,
+        )
+        self.linear2 = RowParallelLinear(
+            input_size=d_hidden,
+            output_size=d_model,
+            bias=True,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "linear2"),
+            disable_tp=disable_tp,
+        )
+        self.activation = nn.GELU()
+
+    @property
+    def d_model(self) -> int:
+        return self._d_model
+
+    @property
+    def kernel_size(self) -> int:
+        return self._kernel_size
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        inputs: torch.Tensor,
+        cache: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
+        x = inputs
+        x, cache = self.conv(x, cache)
+        x = self.norm(x)
+        x, _ = self.linear1(x)
+        x = self.activation(x)
+        x, _ = self.linear2(x)
+        return x + inputs, cache
+
+
+class AutoEncoder(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        latent_channels: int,
+        patch_size: int = 1920,
+        kernel_size: int = 7,
+        data_channels: int = 1,
+        patchify_sizes: tuple[int, ...] = (16, 6, 5, 4),
+        d_models: tuple[int, ...] = (256, 512, 1024, 2048),
+        n_layers: tuple[int, ...] = (2, 2, 2, 2),
+        prefix: str = "",
+        disable_tp: bool = True,
+        norm_eps: float = 1e-6,
+        mlp_ratio: float = 4.0,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.latent_channels = latent_channels
+        self.patch_size = patch_size
+        self.kernel_size = kernel_size
+        self.data_channels = data_channels
+
+        d_model_list = [data_channels] + list(d_models)
+        self.stages = nn.Sequential(
+            *[
+                self._make_stage(
+                    d_input=d_model_list[stage_id],
+                    d_model=d_model_list[stage_id + 1],
+                    patch_size=patchify_sizes[stage_id],
+                    n_layers_count=n_layers[stage_id],
+                    s_kernel=kernel_size,
+                    prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, f"stages.{stage_id}"),
+                    disable_tp=disable_tp,
+                    norm_eps=norm_eps,
+                    mlp_ratio=mlp_ratio,
+                )
+                for stage_id in range(len(n_layers))
+            ]
+        )
+
+        self.norm = RMSNorm(d_model_list[-1], eps=norm_eps)
+        self.o_proj = ColumnParallelLinear(
+            input_size=d_model_list[-1],
+            output_size=latent_channels,
+            bias=True,
+            gather_output=True,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "o_proj"),
+            disable_tp=disable_tp,
+        )
+        self.dual_norm = RMSNorm(latent_channels, eps=norm_eps)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _make_stage(
+        d_input: int,
+        d_model: int,
+        patch_size: int,
+        n_layers_count: int,
+        s_kernel: int,
+        prefix: str = "",
+        disable_tp: bool = True,
+        norm_eps: float = 1e-6,
+        mlp_ratio: float = 4.0,
+    ) -> nn.Sequential:
+        layers: list[nn.Module] = [
+            Patchifier(
+                patch_size,
+                d_input,
+                d_model,
+                prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "0"),
+                disable_tp=disable_tp,
+                norm_eps=norm_eps,
+            )
+        ]
+        for i in range(n_layers_count):
+            layers.append(
+                Block(
+                    d_model,
+                    int(d_model * mlp_ratio),
+                    kernel_size=s_kernel,
+                    prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, str(i + 1)),
+                    disable_tp=disable_tp,
+                    norm_eps=norm_eps,
+                )
+            )
+        return nn.Sequential(*layers)
+
+    def _encode_prefill(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Prefill encoding: [B, T, data_channels] -> [B, T', latent_channels]."""
+        for stage in self.stages:
+            for block in stage:
+                if isinstance(block, Patchifier):
+                    x = block(x)
+                elif isinstance(block, Block):
+                    x, _ = block(x, None)
+        x = self.norm(x)
+        x, _ = self.o_proj(x)
+        x = self.dual_norm(x)
+        return x
+
+    def forward(self, wavs: list[torch.Tensor]) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+        """Encode raw waveforms into [num_tokens, latent_channels] embeddings."""
+        if not wavs:
+            return []
+
+        def _pad(wav: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+            wav = wav.reshape(-1, self.data_channels)
+            pad_size = (self.patch_size - wav.shape[0]) % self.patch_size
+            return F.pad(wav, (0, 0, 0, pad_size))
+
+        embeds: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+        for wav in wavs:
+            wav_batch = _pad(wav).unsqueeze(0)  # [1, T, C]
+            embed = self._encode_prefill(wav_batch)
+            embeds.append(embed.squeeze(0))  # [num_tokens, latent_channels]
+        return embeds

+
+class MuseSparkDSparkDecoderLayer(MuseSpark1xDecoderLayer):
+    """Dense Muse layer with the draft's materialized, gated FP32 residual."""
+
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = "") -> None:
+        super().__init__(vllm_config, prefix)
+        # The draft stream stays replicated even when the target runs SP.
+        if getattr(self, "is_sequence_parallel", False):
+            self.is_sequence_parallel = False
+            self.is_sequence_parallel_input = False
+            self.self_attn.is_sequence_parallel_output = False
+            self.self_attn.o_proj.reduce_results = True
+        config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+        self.self_attn.causal = True
+        if (self.self_attn.rotary_emb is not None) != config.use_rope:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Muse Spark DSpark layers must share their positional mode"
+            )
+
+    def forward(  # type: ignore[override]
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, None]:
+        stream = hidden_states.to(self.residual_dtype)
+        attn_out = self.self_attn(
+            positions=positions,
+            # Round to the draft compute dtype before each trained input norm.
+            hidden_states=self.self_attn.pre_qkv_proj_norm(
+                stream.to(self.default_dtype), out_dtype=self.default_dtype
+            ),
+        )
+        stream = self.add_attn(stream=stream, branch=self.post_attn_norm(attn_out))
+        ffn_out = self.feed_forward(self.pre_ffn_norm(stream.to(self.default_dtype)))
+        stream = self.add_ffn(stream=stream, branch=self.post_ffn_norm(ffn_out))
+        return stream, None
+
+
+@support_torch_compile
+class MuseSparkDSparkModel(DFlashQwen3Model):
+    """Muse draft backbone with independently cached context K/V."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        start_layer_id: int = 0,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        nn.Module.__init__(self)
+        assert vllm_config.speculative_config is not None
+        config = vllm_config.speculative_config.draft_model_config.hf_config

+            raise TypeError("MuseSparkDSparkModel requires MuseSparkDSparkConfig")

+        self.default_dtype = torch.get_default_dtype()

+        draft_config.model_config = vllm_config.speculative_config.draft_model_config
+        draft_config.quant_config = self.quant_config
+
+        self.embed_tokens = VocabParallelEmbedding(
+            config.vocab_size,
+            config.hidden_size,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "embed_tokens"),
+        )
+        self.mask_token_id = config.mask_token_id
+        self.register_buffer(
+            "mask_embedding",
+            torch.zeros(config.hidden_size, dtype=vllm_config.model_config.dtype),
+            persistent=False,
+        )
+        self.has_separate_mask_embedding = False

+            input_size=config.target_hidden_size * len(self.target_layer_ids),
+            output_size=config.hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            params_dtype=vllm_config.model_config.dtype,
+            quant_config=self.quant_config,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "fc"),
+            return_bias=False,
+        )

+            config.hidden_size,
+            eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+            has_weight=config.norm_affine,
+            zero_centered_gamma=config.norm_zero_centered_gamma,
+        )
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
+            MuseSparkDSparkDecoderLayer(
+                draft_config,
+                prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, f"layers.{layer_idx + start_layer_id}"),
+            )
+            for layer_idx in range(config.num_hidden_layers)
+        )
+        self.norm = MuseSpark1xRMSNorm(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+            has_weight=config.norm_affine,
+            zero_centered_gamma=config.norm_zero_centered_gamma,
+        )
+        self.markov_head = DSparkMarkovHead(
+            config.vocab_size,
+            config.draft_vocab_size,
+            config.markov_rank,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "markov_head"),
+            quant_config=self.quant_config,
+        )
+        self.confidence_head: DSparkConfidenceHead | None = None
+        if config.enable_confidence_head:
+            confidence_width = config.hidden_size + (
+                config.markov_rank if config.confidence_head_with_markov else 0
+            )
+            self.confidence_head = DSparkConfidenceHead(
+                confidence_width,
+                prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "confidence_head"),
+                bias=True,
+                with_markov=config.confidence_head_with_markov,
+            )
+
+    def _build_fused_kv_buffers(self) -> None:
+        layers_attn = [layer.self_attn for layer in self.layers]
+        attn0 = layers_attn[0]
+        self._context_pre_norms = tuple(attn.pre_qkv_proj_norm for attn in layers_attn)
+        self._stacked_kv_weight = torch.stack(
+            [
+                attn.qkv_proj.weight[attn.q_size : attn.q_size + 2 * attn.kv_size]
+                for attn in layers_attn
+            ],
+            dim=0,
+        )
+        self._num_attn_layers = len(layers_attn)
+        self._kv_size = attn0.kv_size
+        self._head_dim = attn0.head_dim
+        self._num_kv_heads = attn0.num_kv_heads
+        self._rms_norm_eps = attn0.qk_norm.variance_epsilon
+        self._rotary_emb = attn0.rotary_emb
+        self._attn_layers = [attn.attn for attn in layers_attn]
+        for attn in layers_attn[1:]:
+            if (
+                attn.kv_size != self._kv_size
+                or attn.head_dim != self._head_dim
+                or attn.num_kv_heads != self._num_kv_heads
+                or attn.qk_norm.variance_epsilon != self._rms_norm_eps
+            ):
+                raise ValueError("Muse Spark DSpark layers must share KV geometry")
+
+    def _project_muse_context_kv(self, context_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Apply the two trained Muse input norms, then each layer's K/V map."""
+        fc_output = self.hidden_norm(context_states)
+        per_layer_context = torch.stack(
+            [norm(fc_output) for norm in self._context_pre_norms], dim=0
+        )
+        return torch.bmm(per_layer_context, self._stacked_kv_weight.transpose(1, 2))
+
+    def precompute_and_store_context_kv(
+        self,
+        context_states: torch.Tensor,
+        context_positions: torch.Tensor,
+        context_slot_mapping: torch.Tensor | list[torch.Tensor | None] | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not hasattr(self, "_num_attn_layers"):
+            self._build_fused_kv_buffers()
+        num_ctx = context_states.shape[0]
+        num_layers = self._num_attn_layers
+        all_kv_flat = self._project_muse_context_kv(context_states)
+        all_kv = (
+            all_kv_flat.view(
+                num_layers,
+                num_ctx,
+                2,
+                self._num_kv_heads,
+                self._head_dim,
+            )
+            .permute(2, 0, 1, 3, 4)
+            .contiguous()
+        )
+        all_k = all_kv[0]
+        all_v = all_kv[1]
+        k_fp32 = all_k.float()
+        variance = k_fp32.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
+        all_k = (k_fp32 * torch.rsqrt(variance + self._rms_norm_eps)).to(all_k.dtype)
+        all_k_flat = all_k.view(
+            num_layers * num_ctx, self._num_kv_heads, self._head_dim
+        )
+        if self._rotary_emb is not None:
+            positions = context_positions.repeat(num_layers)
+            all_k_flat, _ = self._rotary_emb(
+                positions,
+                all_k_flat,
+                # CUDA RoPE updates both operands in place. Aliasing the same
+                # context-key tensor as Q and K rotates it twice.
+                None,
+            )
+        if context_slot_mapping is None:
+            return
+        all_k = all_k_flat.view(num_layers, num_ctx, self._num_kv_heads, self._head_dim)
+        per_layer = isinstance(context_slot_mapping, (list, tuple))
+        for layer_idx, attn in enumerate(self._attn_layers):
+            slot_mapping = (
+                context_slot_mapping[layer_idx] if per_layer else context_slot_mapping
+            )
+            if slot_mapping is None:
+                continue
+            attn.impl.do_kv_cache_update(
+                attn,
+                all_k[layer_idx],
+                all_v[layer_idx],
+                attn.kv_cache,
+                slot_mapping,
+            )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        input_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        hidden_states = (
+            self.embed_input_ids(input_ids) if input_embeds is None else input_embeds
+        )
+        hidden_states = hidden_states.to(self.config.residual_dtype)
+        for layer in self.layers:
+            hidden_states, _ = layer(positions, hidden_states, None)
+        return self.norm(hidden_states.to(self.default_dtype))
+
+
+class MuseSparkDSparkForCausalLM(Qwen3DSparkForCausalLM):
+    """Muse DSpark head with the target's output-distribution transform."""
+
+    has_own_lm_head = True
+
+    hf_to_vllm_mapper = WeightsMapper(
+        orig_to_new_stacked={
+            ".self_attn.q_proj.": (".self_attn.qkv_proj.", "q"),
+            ".self_attn.k_proj.": (".self_attn.qkv_proj.", "k"),
+            ".self_attn.v_proj.": (".self_attn.qkv_proj.", "v"),
+            ".self_attn.o_gate_proj.": (".self_attn.qkv_proj.", "o_gate"),
+            ".feed_forward.gate_proj.": (".feed_forward.gate_up_proj.", 0),
+            ".feed_forward.up_proj.": (".feed_forward.gate_up_proj.", 1),

+    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = "") -> None:
