+        assert vllm_config.speculative_config is not None
+        self.draft_model_config = vllm_config.speculative_config.draft_model_config
+        self.config = self.draft_model_config.hf_config
+        target_layer_num = vllm_config.model_config.get_total_num_hidden_layers()
+        self.model = MuseSparkDSparkModel(
+            vllm_config=vllm_config,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "model"),
+            start_layer_id=target_layer_num,
+        )
+        self.lm_head = ParallelLMHead(
+            self.config.draft_vocab_size,
+            self.config.hidden_size,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "lm_head"),
+        )
+        self.logits_processor = LogitsProcessor(self.config.draft_vocab_size)
+        self.target_vocab_size = vllm_config.model_config.get_vocab_size()
+        self.draft_id_to_target_id = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.zeros(self.config.draft_vocab_size, dtype=torch.long),
+            requires_grad=False,
+        )
+        metap = self.config.metap
+        if metap.use_metap and metap.router_has_one_inf_dim:
+            width_mult = self.config.hidden_size / metap.base_width
+            if metap.metap_mode == "mup":
+                self.output_multiplier = width_mult**-1
+            elif metap.metap_mode == "sp":
+                self.output_multiplier = width_mult**-0.5
+            else:
+                raise ValueError(f"Unknown Metap mode {metap.metap_mode!r}")
+        else:
+            self.output_multiplier = 1.0
+        self.output_soft_cap_temp = self.config.output_soft_cap_temp
+
+    def apply_output_logit_transform(self, logits: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        logits = logits.float() * self.output_multiplier
+        if self.output_soft_cap_temp is not None:
+            logits = self.output_soft_cap_temp * torch.tanh(
+                logits / self.output_soft_cap_temp
+            )
+        return logits
+
+    def compute_draft_logits(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        # Identical full-vocabulary heads may be shared with an FP32 target head.
+        return self.logits_processor(
+            self.lm_head, hidden_states.to(self.lm_head.weight.dtype)
+        )
+
+    def combine_hidden_states(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        # Target residuals are FP32; the training collator casts features before FC.
+        return super().combine_hidden_states(
+            hidden_states.to(self.model.fc.weight.dtype)
+        )
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        model_weights = {}
+        includes_lm_head = False
+        includes_d2t = False
+        for name, loaded_weight in weights:
+            if name == "t2d":
+                continue
+            if name == "d2t":
+                name = "draft_id_to_target_id"
+                includes_d2t = True
+            elif "lm_head" not in name:
+                name = "model." + name
+            if "lm_head" in name:
+                includes_lm_head = True
+            model_weights[name] = loaded_weight
+        if not includes_lm_head:
+            raise ValueError("Muse Spark DSpark requires its own lm_head")
+        if not includes_d2t:
+            raise ValueError("Muse Spark DSpark requires a d2t vocabulary mapping")
+        mapper = WeightsMapper(
+            orig_to_new_substr={
+                "model.embed_tokens": None,
+                "model.mask_embedding": None,
+            },
+            orig_to_new_stacked=self.hf_to_vllm_mapper.orig_to_new_stacked,
+        )
+        loaded = AutoWeightsLoader(self).load_weights(
+            model_weights.items(), mapper=mapper
+        )
+        self.model._build_fused_kv_buffers()
+        materialize_residual_path_constants(self.model)
+        return loaded
+
+
+EntryClass = MuseSparkDSparkForCausalLM

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Platform-neutral MuseSpark1x building blocks shared by the NVIDIA and AMD stacks."""
+
+import math
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import ColumnParallelLinear
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization import QuantizationConfig
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.common.ops.fused_rmsnorm import fused_rmsnorm_fwd
+
+
+def calculate_gain_center(
+    gain_center_type: str,
+    residual_id: int,
+    n_layers: int | None = None,
+) -> float:
+    """Gain center for the given type and residual ID (1-based indices)."""
+    if gain_center_type == "one":
+        return 1.0
+    if gain_center_type == "zero":
+        return 0.0
+    if gain_center_type == "inverse_residual_index":
+        return 1.0 / (2 * math.ceil(residual_id / 2))
+    if gain_center_type in (
+        "inverse_residual_index_v2",
+        "inverse_residual_index_p1",
+    ):
+        return 1.0 / (residual_id + 1)
+    if gain_center_type == "inverse_sqrt_residual_index":
+        return 1.0 / math.sqrt(2 * math.ceil(residual_id / 2))
+    if gain_center_type == "inverse_sqrt_layers":
+        assert n_layers is not None, "n_layers must be provided for this option."
+        return 1.0 / math.sqrt(n_layers)
+    raise ValueError(f"Unsupported gain_center_type: {gain_center_type}")
+
+
+class MuseSpark1xRMSNorm(nn.Module):
+    """RMSNorm in fp32, rounded once at the store to ``out_dtype``.
+
+    Deliberately not ``F.rms_norm``: that path can flip greedy token selection.
+    """
+
+    # Which side of the normalization the weight lands on; read by fused kernels.
+    applies_weight_before_norm = False
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        eps: float = 1e-6,
+        var_hidden_size: int | None = None,
+        has_weight: bool = True,
+        is_post_norm: bool = False,
+        zero_centered_gamma: bool = False,
+        post_norm_gain_center_type: str = "one",
+        residual_id: int | None = None,
+        output_norm_gain_center_type: str = "zero",
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+
+        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
+        self.variance_epsilon = eps
+        self.variance_size_override = (
+            None if var_hidden_size == hidden_size else var_hidden_size
+        )
+        self.has_weight = has_weight
+        if self.has_weight:
+            self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(hidden_size), requires_grad=False)
+        else:
+            self.weight = None
+
+        self.zero_centered_gamma = zero_centered_gamma
+        self.gain_center = 1.0
+        if residual_id is not None and is_post_norm:
+            self.gain_center = calculate_gain_center(
+                post_norm_gain_center_type, residual_id
+            )
+        elif residual_id == -1:
+            self.gain_center = calculate_gain_center(
+                output_norm_gain_center_type, residual_id
+            )
+
+    @property
+    def fused_gain_center(self) -> float:
+        """``gain_center`` as the fused kernels take it: 0.0 when unused."""
+        return self.gain_center if self.has_weight and self.zero_centered_gamma else 0.0
+
+    def forward_native(
+        self,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        out_dtype: torch.dtype | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        orig_dtype = x.dtype
+        out_dtype = out_dtype or orig_dtype
+        x = x.to(torch.float32)
+        if residual is not None:
+            x = x + residual.to(torch.float32)
+            residual = x.to(orig_dtype)
+
+        hidden_size = x.shape[-1]
+        if hidden_size != self.hidden_size:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Expected hidden_size to be "
+                f"{self.hidden_size}, but found: {hidden_size}"
+            )
+
+        if self.variance_size_override is None:
+            x_var = x
+        else:
+            if hidden_size < self.variance_size_override:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "Expected hidden_size to be at least "
+                    f"{self.variance_size_override}, but found: {hidden_size}"
+                )
+            x_var = x[..., : self.variance_size_override]
+
+        variance = x_var.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
+
+        x = x * torch.rsqrt(variance + self.variance_epsilon)
+        if self.has_weight:
+            weight = self.weight.float()
+            if self.zero_centered_gamma:
+                weight = weight + self.gain_center
+            x = x * weight
+        x = x.to(out_dtype)
+        if residual is None:
+            return x
+        return x, residual
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        out_dtype: torch.dtype | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        if residual is None and self.supports_fused_kernel(x):
+            return fused_rmsnorm_fwd(
+                x,
+                self.weight if self.has_weight else None,
+                self.variance_epsilon,
+                out_dtype=out_dtype,
+                gain_center=self.fused_gain_center,
+                input_scale=self.applies_weight_before_norm and self.has_weight,
+                # Only matters past one 8192-element tile; a device query here
+                # would break the compiled graph.
+                use_kahan_summation=True,
+            )
+        return self.forward_native(x, residual, out_dtype)
+
+    def supports_fused_kernel(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+        """Whether the Triton kernel can serve this norm for input ``x``."""
+        return (
+            self.variance_size_override is None
+            and x.is_contiguous()
+            and x.shape[-1] == self.hidden_size
+        )
+
+
+class MuseSpark1xRMSNormWithInputScale(MuseSpark1xRMSNorm):
+    """Weight-first RMSNorm variant: ``rms_norm(x * weight)``."""
+
+    applies_weight_before_norm = True
+
+    def forward_native(
+        self,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        out_dtype: torch.dtype | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        orig_dtype = x.dtype
+        out_dtype = out_dtype or orig_dtype
+        x = x.to(torch.float32)
+        if residual is not None:
+            x = x + residual.to(torch.float32)
+            residual = x.to(orig_dtype)
+
+        if self.weight is not None:
+            weight = self.weight.float()
+            if self.zero_centered_gamma:
+                weight = weight + self.gain_center
+            x = x * weight
+        x = F.rms_norm(x, (self.hidden_size,), None, self.variance_epsilon)
+        x = x.to(out_dtype)
+
+        if residual is None:
+            return x
+        return x, residual
+
+
+class MulTanhSoftCap(nn.Module):
+    """Computes ``soft_cap_temp * tanh(x * multiplier / soft_cap_temp)`` in fp32."""
+
+    def __init__(self, multiplier: float, soft_cap_temp: float) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.multiplier = multiplier
+        self.soft_cap_temp = soft_cap_temp
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        assert x.dtype in (torch.float32, torch.float16, torch.bfloat16)
+        if x.is_cuda and x.is_contiguous():
+            if x.dtype != torch.float32:
+                x = x.float()
+            return ops.muse_spark_mul_tanh_soft_cap(
+                x, self.multiplier, self.soft_cap_temp
+            )
+        x = x.float() * self.multiplier
+        return self.soft_cap_temp * torch.tanh(x / self.soft_cap_temp)
+
+
+class MuseSpark1xResidualConnection(nn.Module):
+    """Vanilla residual sum: ``stream + branch``."""
+
+    def forward(self, stream: torch.Tensor, branch: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return stream + branch.to(stream.dtype)
+
+
+class MuseSpark1xNormPreservingResidualConnection(MuseSpark1xResidualConnection):
+    """Gated residual sum with norm-preserving weights: ``alpha*a + beta*b``.
+
+    With ``a`` the stream and ``b`` the branch, and gate parameter ``w``:
+
+        beta = sigmoid(w / temperature)
+        alpha = sqrt(max(eps, sigmoid(-w) * (1 + beta)))   # = sqrt(1 - beta^2)
+
+    The sum is computed in fp32 and cast back to the stream dtype.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        dim: int,
+        activation: str = "sigmoid",
+        temperature: float = 0.3,
+        use_stream_gate: bool = True,
+        channel_wise: bool = True,
+        eps: float = 1e-3,
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.eps = eps
+        self.activation_type = activation
+        self.temperature = temperature
+        self.use_stream_gate = use_stream_gate
+        self.gate = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(dim if channel_wise else 1))
+
+    def coefficients(
+        self, w: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor | float, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Compute post-activation coefficients for the stream and branch."""
+        if self.activation_type != "sigmoid":
+            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported activation: {self.activation_type}")
+        beta = torch.sigmoid(w)
+        if self.use_stream_gate:
+            alpha_sq = torch.sigmoid(-w) * (1.0 + beta)  # = 1 - beta^2 (stable)
+            alpha = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(alpha_sq, min=self.eps))
+        else:
+            alpha = 1.0
+        return alpha, beta
+
+    def materialize_coefficients(self) -> None:
+        """Cache alpha/beta as fp32 buffers. Call once, after weight loading."""
+        w = self.gate.detach().float() / self.temperature
+        alpha, beta = self.coefficients(w)
+        self.register_buffer("beta", beta.contiguous(), persistent=False)
+        if isinstance(alpha, torch.Tensor):
+            self.register_buffer("alpha", alpha.contiguous(), persistent=False)
+        else:
+            self.alpha = alpha
+        self._coefficients_ready = True
+
+    def forward(self, stream: torch.Tensor, branch: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        dtype = stream.dtype
+        branch = branch.to(dtype)
+
+        if getattr(self, "_coefficients_ready", False):
+            alpha, beta = self.alpha, self.beta
+        else:
+            w = self.gate.view(*([1] * (stream.ndim - 1)), -1).float()
+            alpha, beta = self.coefficients(w / self.temperature)
+        out = alpha * stream + beta * branch
+        return out.to(dtype)
+
+
+@dataclass(slots=True)
+class MuseSpark1xResidualStream:
+    """A residual stream whose last blend is deferred to fuse with the next norm."""
+
+    stream: torch.Tensor
+    branch: torch.Tensor
+    post_norm: MuseSpark1xRMSNorm
+    connection: MuseSpark1xResidualConnection
+
+
+def norm_then_gated_residual(x: MuseSpark1xResidualStream) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``alpha * stream + beta * norm(branch)``, in one kernel where possible."""
+    norm, connection = x.post_norm, x.connection
+    branch, stream = x.branch, x.stream
+    if (
+        isinstance(connection, MuseSpark1xNormPreservingResidualConnection)
+        and getattr(connection, "_coefficients_ready", False)
+        and branch.is_cuda
+        and stream.shape == branch.shape
+        and stream.is_contiguous()
+        and norm.supports_fused_kernel(branch)
+    ):
+        return fused_rmsnorm_fwd(
+            branch,
+            norm.weight if norm.has_weight else None,
+            norm.variance_epsilon,
+            gain_center=norm.fused_gain_center,
+            input_scale=norm.applies_weight_before_norm and norm.has_weight,
+            use_kahan_summation=True,
+            residual_stream=stream,
+            alpha=connection.alpha,
+            beta=connection.beta,
+        )
+    return connection(branch=norm(branch), stream=stream)
+
+
+def materialize_residual_path_constants(model: nn.Module) -> int:
+    """Precompute parameter-only constants after weight loading; idempotent."""
+    n_gates = 0
+    for module in model.modules():
+        if isinstance(module, MuseSpark1xNormPreservingResidualConnection):
+            module.materialize_coefficients()
+            n_gates += 1
+        else:
+            fold = getattr(module, "fold_router_output_multiplier", None)
+            if callable(fold):
+                fold()
+    return n_gates
+
+
+class MuseSpark1xQKVOGateParallelLinear(ColumnParallelLinear):
+    """Fused [Q, K, V, O-gate] projection with head-aware TP sharding.
+
+    Per-rank rows are [q, k, v, o_gate], so checkpoint tensors are sliced by
+    head group. KV-head padding is not supported.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        head_size: int,
+        total_num_heads: int,
+        total_num_kv_heads: int,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+        *,
+        tp_rank: int | None = None,
+        tp_size: int | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.head_size = head_size
+        super().__init__(
+            input_size=hidden_size,
+            output_size=2 * (total_num_heads + total_num_kv_heads) * head_size,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=prefix,
+            tp_rank=tp_rank,
+            tp_size=tp_size,
+        )
+        assert total_num_heads % self.tp_size == 0
+        assert total_num_kv_heads % self.tp_size == 0, (
+            "KV-head padding is not supported for the fused QKV+O-gate "
+            f"projection: {total_num_kv_heads=}, tp_size={self.tp_size}."
+        )
+        self.num_heads = total_num_heads // self.tp_size
+        self.num_kv_heads = total_num_kv_heads // self.tp_size
+
+    def weight_loader(
+        self,
+        param: nn.Parameter,
+        loaded_weight: torch.Tensor,
+        loaded_shard_id: str | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        if loaded_shard_id is None:
+            assert param.shape == loaded_weight.shape
+            param.data.copy_(loaded_weight)
+            return
+        q_size = self.num_heads * self.head_size
+        kv_size = self.num_kv_heads * self.head_size
+        if loaded_shard_id == "q":
+            shard_offset, shard_size = 0, q_size
+        elif loaded_shard_id == "k":
+            shard_offset, shard_size = q_size, kv_size
+        elif loaded_shard_id == "v":
+            shard_offset, shard_size = q_size + kv_size, kv_size
+        elif loaded_shard_id == "o_gate":
+            shard_offset, shard_size = q_size + 2 * kv_size, q_size
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{self.prefix}: unknown shard id {loaded_shard_id!r} for the "
+                "fused QKV+O-gate projection."
+            )
+        start_idx = self.tp_rank * shard_size
+        loaded_weight = loaded_weight.narrow(0, start_idx, shard_size)
+        param_shard = param.data.narrow(0, shard_offset, shard_size)
+        assert param_shard.shape == loaded_weight.shape
+        param_shard.copy_(loaded_weight)
+
+    def load_weights(
+        self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]
+    ) -> Iterable[str]:
+        for name, loaded_weight in weights:
+            shard_id = getattr(loaded_weight, "shard_id", None)
+            if name == "bias" and self.bias is None:
+                continue
+            param = getattr(self, name)
+            self.weight_loader(param, loaded_weight, shard_id)
+            yield name
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "MulTanhSoftCap",
+    "MuseSpark1xNormPreservingResidualConnection",
+    "MuseSpark1xQKVOGateParallelLinear",
+    "MuseSpark1xRMSNorm",
+    "MuseSpark1xRMSNormWithInputScale",
+    "MuseSpark1xResidualConnection",
+    "MuseSpark1xResidualStream",
+    "calculate_gain_center",
+    "materialize_residual_path_constants",
+    "norm_then_gated_residual",
+]

+"""Platform-neutral MuseSpark1x MoE pieces: routing, config, expert loading."""
+
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.config import (
+    FusedMoEConfig,
+    RoutingMethodType,
+    get_routing_method_type,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.routed_experts import RoutedExperts
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.router.base_router import BaseRouter
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.common.ops.fused_routing import (
+    fused_musespark1x_routing,
+)
+
+
+class MuseSpark1xRouter(BaseRouter):
+    """MuseSpark1x top-k router.
+
+    Optional metap output multiplier -> sigmoid/softmax -> add expert bias for
+    SELECTION only -> top-k -> gather UNBIASED scores -> divide by
+    (sum + division_eps) -> scale by route_scale.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        top_k: int,
+        num_experts: int,
+        expert_bias: torch.Tensor,
+        route_scale: float,
+        router_output_multiplier: float | None = None,
+        router_score_normalization: str = "sigmoid",
+        router_score_division_eps: float | None = None,
+    ):
+        super().__init__(top_k=top_k, global_num_experts=num_experts)
+        if router_score_normalization not in ("sigmoid", "softmax"):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Invalid router_score_normalization: {router_score_normalization}"
+            )
+        self.expert_bias = expert_bias
+        self.route_scale = route_scale
+        self.router_output_multiplier = router_output_multiplier
+        self.router_score_normalization = router_score_normalization
+        self.router_score_division_eps = router_score_division_eps
+
+    @property
+    def routing_method_type(self) -> RoutingMethodType:
+        """Classify this router in vLLM's routing vocabulary."""
+        return get_routing_method_type(
+            scoring_func=self.router_score_normalization,
+            top_k=self.top_k,
+            renormalize=True,
+            num_expert_group=None,
+            has_e_score_bias=True,
+        )
+
+    def _compute_routing(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        router_logits: torch.Tensor,
+        indices_type: torch.dtype | None,
+        *,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        if not router_logits.is_cuda:
+            return self._compute_routing_native(router_logits, indices_type)
+
+        topk_weights, topk_ids = fused_musespark1x_routing(
+            router_logits,
+            self.expert_bias,
+            self.top_k,
+            self.route_scale,
+            router_output_multiplier=self.router_output_multiplier,
+            router_score_normalization=self.router_score_normalization,
+            router_score_division_eps=self.router_score_division_eps,
+        )
+        if indices_type is not None and indices_type != torch.int32:
+            topk_ids = topk_ids.to(indices_type)
+        return topk_weights, topk_ids
+
+    def _compute_routing_native(
+        self,
+        router_logits: torch.Tensor,
+        indices_type: torch.dtype | None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """The recipe in torch: the kernel's reference, and the CPU path."""
+        gating_output = router_logits
+        if self.router_output_multiplier is not None:
+            gating_output = gating_output * self.router_output_multiplier
+
+        if self.router_score_normalization == "sigmoid":
+            gating_output = torch.sigmoid(gating_output)
+        else:
+            gating_output = torch.softmax(gating_output, dim=-1)
+
+        scores_for_topk = gating_output + self.expert_bias
+        _, topk_ids = torch.topk(scores_for_topk, self.top_k, dim=-1)
+
+        topk_weights = torch.gather(gating_output, dim=1, index=topk_ids)
+        denom = topk_weights.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
+        if self.router_score_division_eps is not None:
+            denom = denom + self.router_score_division_eps
+        topk_weights = topk_weights / denom * self.route_scale
+
+        return topk_weights.to(torch.float32), topk_ids.to(
+            torch.int32 if indices_type is None else indices_type
+        )
+
+
+def needs_pre_norm_all_reduce(moe_config: FusedMoEConfig) -> bool:
+    """Whether the GEMM2 rows must be all-reduced before the norm.
+
+    Under TP the GEMM2 rows are partial sums and RMS is not linear in them.
+    """
+    return moe_config.moe_parallel_config.tp_size > 1
+
+
+class MuseSparkMoEConfig(FusedMoEConfig):
+    """MoE config whose top-k finalize is always deferred (except empty batches).
+
+    MuseSpark1x normalizes every expert's output before the weighted top-k
+    reduction, so the kernel must always stop after GEMM2.
+    """
+
+    def should_defer_moe_finalize(self, num_tokens: int) -> bool:
+        return num_tokens > 0
+
+
+class MuseSparkConsolidatedRoutedExperts(RoutedExperts):
+    """RoutedExperts that load the consolidated (all-experts-stacked) tensors.
+
+    Vendor subclasses supply ``_get_quant_method``.
+    """
+
+    def load_weights(
+        self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]
+    ) -> Iterable[str]:
+        for name, tensor in weights:
+            param = getattr(self, name, None)
+            if param is None:
+                raise AttributeError(
+                    f"{self.layer_name}: unexpected expert weight {name!r}"
+                )
+            if name in ("w13_weight", "w13_weight_scale"):
+                # [E, 2I, ...] -> per-shard (w1/w3) -> per-expert
+                for shard_id, col in (("w1", 0), ("w3", 1)):
+                    shard = tensor.chunk(2, dim=1)[col]
+                    for expert_id, loaded in enumerate(shard.unbind(0)):
+                        param.weight_loader(
+                            param=param,
+                            loaded_weight=loaded,
+                            weight_name=name,
+                            shard_id=shard_id,
+                            expert_id=expert_id,
+                        )
+            elif name in ("w2_weight", "w2_weight_scale"):
+                for expert_id, loaded in enumerate(tensor.unbind(0)):
+                    param.weight_loader(
+                        param=param,
+                        loaded_weight=loaded,
+                        weight_name=name,
+                        shard_id="w2",
+                        expert_id=expert_id,
+                    )
+            elif name in ("w13_weight_scale_2", "w13_input_scale"):
+                # [E, 2] -> per-expert, per-shard scalars
+                for expert_id in range(tensor.shape[0]):
+                    for shard_id, col in (("w1", 0), ("w3", 1)):
+                        param.weight_loader(
+                            param=param,
+                            loaded_weight=tensor[expert_id, col],
+                            weight_name=name,
+                            shard_id=shard_id,
+                            expert_id=expert_id,
+                        )
+            elif name in ("w2_weight_scale_2", "w2_input_scale"):
+                for expert_id in range(tensor.shape[0]):
+                    param.weight_loader(
+                        param=param,
+                        loaded_weight=tensor[expert_id],
+                        weight_name=name,
+                        shard_id="w2",
+                        expert_id=expert_id,
+                    )
+            else:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"{self.layer_name}: unsupported expert weight {name!r}"
+                )
+            yield name
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "MuseSpark1xRouter",
+    "MuseSparkConsolidatedRoutedExperts",
+    "MuseSparkMoEConfig",
+    "needs_pre_norm_all_reduce",
+]

+def register_omni_processor(cls: type) -> type:
+    """Register the Omni multimodal processor for a vendor's Omni class."""
+    return MULTIMODAL_REGISTRY.register_processor(
+        MuseSpark1xOmniMultiModalProcessor,
+        info=MuseSpark1xOmniProcessingInfo,
+        dummy_inputs=MuseSpark1xOmniDummyInputsBuilder,
+    )(cls)
+
+
+class MuseSpark1xOmniMixin:
+    """The Omni towers, their embedding merge and their weight mapping.
+
+    Not a ``Protocol``: it precedes the text stack in the bases so ``__init__``
+    runs after the stack is built, and a Protocol would swallow that chain.
+    """
+
+    supports_encoder_tp_data = True
+    # Provided by the vendor text stack.
+    model: nn.Module
+
+    if TYPE_CHECKING:
+
+        def _mark_tower_model(
+            self,
+            vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+            modalities: set[str] | str,
+            *,
+            targets: type[nn.Module] | tuple[type[nn.Module], ...] | None = None,
+        ): ...
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_placeholder_str(cls, modality: str, i: int) -> str | None:
+        if modality.startswith("image"):
+            return "<|patch|>"
+        for kind in ("video", "audio"):
+            if modality.startswith(kind):
+                return f"<|{kind}|>"
+        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported Muse Spark modality: {modality}")
+
+    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = "") -> None:
+        hf_config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+        text_vllm_config = copy(vllm_config)
+        text_vllm_config.model_config = copy(vllm_config.model_config)
+        text_vllm_config.model_config.hf_config = hf_config.text_config
+        super().__init__(vllm_config=text_vllm_config, prefix=prefix)  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+
+        vision_config = hf_config.vision_config
+        audio_config = hf_config.audio_config
+        self.vllm_config = vllm_config
+        adapter_output_dim = hf_config.projector_hidden_size
+        llm_hidden_size = hf_config.text_config.hidden_size
+
+        with set_current_vllm_config(vllm_config, prefix=prefix):
+            with self._mark_tower_model(vllm_config, {"image", "video"}):
+                with set_model_tag("NaViTEncoder", is_encoder=True):
+                    self.vision_model = NaViT(
+                        vision_config,
+                        projector_hidden_size=hf_config.projector_hidden_size,
+                        prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "vision_model"),
+                    )
+                self.vision_projection = RowParallelLinear(
+                    input_size=adapter_output_dim,
+                    output_size=llm_hidden_size,
+                    bias=False,
+                    input_is_parallel=False,
+                    quant_config=None,
+                    prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "vision_projection"),
+                )
+                self.perception_emb_norm = MuseSpark1xRMSNorm(
+                    llm_hidden_size, eps=1e-5, has_weight=False
+                )
+
+            with self._mark_tower_model(vllm_config, "audio"):
+                with set_model_tag("AutoEncoder", is_encoder=True):
+                    self.audio_encoder = AutoEncoder(
+                        latent_channels=audio_config.out_hidden_size,
+                        patch_size=math.prod(audio_config.patch_sizes),
+                        patchify_sizes=tuple(audio_config.patch_sizes),
+                        d_models=tuple(audio_config.hidden_sizes),
+                        n_layers=tuple(audio_config.depths),
+                        kernel_size=audio_config.conv_kernel_size,
+                        mlp_ratio=audio_config.mlp_ratio,
+                        norm_eps=audio_config.rms_norm_eps,
+                        prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "audio_encoder"),
+                    )
+                if vllm_config.compilation_config.compile_mm_encoder:
+                    self.audio_encoder._encode_prefill = (  # type: ignore[method-assign]
+                        torch.compile(
+                            self.audio_encoder._encode_prefill,
+                            fullgraph=True,
+                            dynamic=True,
+                        )
+                    )
+
+        self._patch_height = vision_config.patch_size
+        self._patch_width = vision_config.patch_size
+        self._patch_temporal = vision_config.patch_temporal
+        self._downsample_factor = vision_config.merge_size
+
+        self._use_vision_dp = is_vit_use_data_parallel()
+        self._adapter_output_dim = adapter_output_dim
+
+        # FlashInfer's cute-dsl GEMM passes operands over DLPack, which refuses
+        # grad-carrying tensors such as the towers' biases.
+        cast(nn.Module, self).requires_grad_(False)
+
+    def get_language_model(self) -> torch.nn.Module:
+        return self
+
+    def _process_image_input(
+        self,
+        images: torch.Tensor | list[torch.Tensor],
+        target_hw: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+        """Convert image inputs to a list of individual image tensors."""
+        if isinstance(images, list):
+            result: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+            for img in images:
+                if img.dim() in (3, 4):  # [C, H, W] or [N, C, H, W]
+                    result.append(img)
+                else:
+                    raise ValueError(f"Unexpected image shape: {img.shape}")
+            return result
+        if images.dim() == 1:
+            # The Rust frontend ships one flat channel-planar buffer per batch.
+            if target_hw is None:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "Flat image pixels require image_target_hw for reshaping"
+                )
+            hw = target_hw.tolist()
+            counts = [3 * h * w for h, w in hw]
+            if sum(counts) != images.shape[0]:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"Flat image pixels {images.shape[0]} do not match "
+                    f"image_target_hw {hw}"
+                )
+            return [
+                item.view(3, h, w) for item, (h, w) in zip(images.split(counts), hw)
+            ]
+        if images.dim() == 4:  # [B, C, H, W]
+            return [images[i] for i in range(images.shape[0])]
+        if images.dim() == 5:  # [B, N, C, H, W]
+            return [images[i] for i in range(images.shape[0])]
+        raise ValueError(f"Unexpected batched image shape: {images.shape}")
+
+    def _process_video_input(
+        self,
+        videos: torch.Tensor | list[torch.Tensor],
+        target_hw: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        frame_counts: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+        """Convert video inputs to a list of individual video tensors."""
+        if isinstance(videos, list):
+            for v in videos:
+                assert v.dim() == 4, (
+                    f"Expected [T, C, H, W] video tensor, got {v.shape}"
+                )
+            return videos
+        if videos.dim() == 1:
+            # The Rust frontend ships one flat buffer per batch.
+            if target_hw is None or frame_counts is None:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "Flat video pixels require video_target_hw and "
+                    "video_frame_counts for reshaping"
+                )
+            hw = target_hw.tolist()
+            counts = [3 * t * h * w for t, (h, w) in zip(frame_counts.tolist(), hw)]
+            if sum(counts) != videos.shape[0]:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"Flat video pixels {videos.shape[0]} do not match "
+                    f"video_target_hw {hw} and frame counts "
+                    f"{frame_counts.tolist()}"
+                )
+            return [
+                item.view(t, 3, h, w)
+                for item, t, (h, w) in zip(
+                    videos.split(counts), frame_counts.tolist(), hw
+                )
+            ]
+        assert videos.dim() == 5, (
+            f"Expected [B, T, C, H, W] video tensor, got {videos.shape}"
+        )
+        return [videos[i] for i in range(videos.shape[0])]
+
+    def _get_patch_count(self, item: torch.Tensor) -> int:
+        """Number of output patches for an image or video tensor."""
+        if item.ndim == 3:  # [C, H, W]
+            return get_navit_patch_count(
+                img_h=item.shape[1],
+                img_w=item.shape[2],
+                patch_h=self._patch_height,
+                patch_w=self._patch_width,
+                downsample_factor=self._downsample_factor,
+            )
+        if item.ndim == 4:  # [T, C, H, W] or [N, C, H, W]
+            return get_navit_video_patch_count(
+                video_t=item.shape[0],
+                video_h=item.shape[2],
+                video_w=item.shape[3],
+                patch_t=self._patch_temporal,
+                patch_h=self._patch_height,
+                patch_w=self._patch_width,
+                downsample_factor=self._downsample_factor,
+            )
+        raise ValueError(f"Unexpected vision item shape: {item.shape}")
+
+    def _encode_vision(self, vision_items: list[torch.Tensor]) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+        """NaViT -> vision_projection -> perception_emb_norm, split per item."""
+        if not vision_items:
+            return []
+        vision_params = next(self.vision_model.parameters(), None)
+        if vision_params is not None:
+            vision_items = [
+                x.to(
+                    device=vision_params.device,
+                    dtype=vision_params.dtype,
+                    non_blocking=True,
+                )
+                for x in vision_items
+            ]
+
+        if self._use_vision_dp:
+            h_vision = self._run_dp_sharded_navit(vision_items)
+        else:
+            h_vision = self.vision_model(vision_items)
+
+        h_vision, _ = self.vision_projection(h_vision)
+
+        h_vision = self.perception_emb_norm(h_vision)
+
+        patch_counts = [self._get_patch_count(item) for item in vision_items]
+        assert h_vision.shape[0] == sum(patch_counts), (
+            f"NaViT output {h_vision.shape[0]} patches != calculated "
+            f"{sum(patch_counts)}. Per-item: {patch_counts}, "
+            f"shapes: {[x.shape for x in vision_items]}"
+        )
+        return list(h_vision.split(patch_counts))
+
+    def _encode_audio(
+        self,
+        input_features: torch.Tensor | list[torch.Tensor],
+        sample_counts: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+        audio_params = next(self.audio_encoder.parameters(), None)
+        # reduce_data may stack same-length waveforms into [N, T].
+        if isinstance(input_features, torch.Tensor):
+            if input_features.dim() >= 2:
+                input_features = [
+                    input_features[i] for i in range(input_features.shape[0])
+                ]
+            elif sample_counts is not None and sample_counts.numel() > 1:
+                # The Rust frontend ships one flat buffer per batch.
+                counts = sample_counts.tolist()
+                if sum(counts) != input_features.shape[0]:
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        f"Flat audio samples {input_features.shape[0]} do not "
+                        f"match audio_sample_counts {counts}"
+                    )
+                input_features = list(input_features.split(counts))
+            else:
+                input_features = [input_features]
+        results: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+        for wav in input_features:
+            if audio_params is not None:
+                wav = wav.to(device=audio_params.device, dtype=audio_params.dtype)
+            audio_embeds = self.audio_encoder([wav])
+            if isinstance(audio_embeds, list) and len(audio_embeds) > 0:
+                audio_embed = audio_embeds[0]
+            else:
+                audio_embed = audio_embeds
+            # Audio takes tok_embeddings_norm, not perception_emb_norm.
+            audio_embed = self.model.tok_embeddings_norm(audio_embed)
+            results.append(audio_embed)
+        return results
+
+    def embed_multimodal(self, **kwargs: object) -> MultiModalEmbeddings:
+        """Encode all modalities in the order they appear in the kwargs."""
+        embeddings: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+        for key, value in kwargs.items():
+            if key == "images":
+                embeddings.extend(
+                    self._encode_vision(
+                        self._process_image_input(
+                            cast(torch.Tensor | list[torch.Tensor], value),
+                            cast(
+                                torch.Tensor | None,
+                                kwargs.get("image_target_hw"),
+                            ),
+                        )
+                    )
+                )
+            elif key == "videos":
+                embeddings.extend(
+                    self._encode_vision(
+                        self._process_video_input(
+                            cast(torch.Tensor | list[torch.Tensor], value),
+                            cast(
+                                torch.Tensor | None,
+                                kwargs.get("video_target_hw"),
+                            ),
+                            cast(
+                                torch.Tensor | None,
+                                kwargs.get("video_frame_counts"),
+                            ),
+                        )
+                    )
+                )
+            elif key == "input_features":
+                embeddings.extend(
+                    self._encode_audio(
+                        cast(torch.Tensor | list[torch.Tensor], value),
+                        cast(
+                            torch.Tensor | None,
+                            kwargs.get("audio_sample_counts"),
+                        ),
+                    )
+                )
+        return embeddings
+
+    def _run_dp_sharded_navit(
+        self,
+        vision_items: list[torch.Tensor],
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Run NaViT with items load-balanced across TP ranks and one all-gather."""
+        tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+        tp_rank = get_tensor_model_parallel_rank()
+
+        patch_counts = [self._get_patch_count(item) for item in vision_items]
+
+        shuffle_indices, gpu_sample_counts, gpu_loads = get_load_balance_assignment(
+            patch_counts, tp_size
+        )
+        cum_gpu_sample_counts = [0, *itertools.accumulate(gpu_sample_counts)]
+
+        local_image_indices = shuffle_indices[
+            cum_gpu_sample_counts[tp_rank] : cum_gpu_sample_counts[tp_rank + 1]
+        ]
+        local_vision_items = [vision_items[i] for i in local_image_indices]
+
+        if len(local_vision_items) > 0:
+            local_output = self.vision_model(local_vision_items)
+        else:
+            device = next(self.vision_model.parameters()).device
+            dtype = next(self.vision_model.parameters()).dtype
+            local_output = torch.empty(
+                0, self._adapter_output_dim, device=device, dtype=dtype
+            )
+
+        max_output_per_rank = max(gpu_loads) if max(gpu_loads) > 0 else 0
+
+        current_len = local_output.shape[0]
+        if current_len < max_output_per_rank:
+            padding = torch.empty(
+                max_output_per_rank - current_len,
+                local_output.shape[1],
+                dtype=local_output.dtype,
+                device=local_output.device,
+            )
+            local_output_padded = torch.cat([local_output, padding], dim=0)
+        else:
+            local_output_padded = local_output
+
+        gathered = tensor_model_parallel_all_gather(
+            local_output_padded.contiguous(), dim=0
+        )
+
+        original_order = [torch.Tensor()] * len(vision_items)
+        for rank in range(tp_size):
+            rank_start = rank * max_output_per_rank
+            count = gpu_sample_counts[rank]
+            if count == 0:
+                continue
+            rank_image_indices = shuffle_indices[
+                cum_gpu_sample_counts[rank] : cum_gpu_sample_counts[rank + 1]
+            ]
+            embed_offset = rank_start
+            for img_idx in rank_image_indices:
+                img_patches = patch_counts[img_idx]
+                original_order[img_idx] = gathered[
+                    embed_offset : embed_offset + img_patches
+                ]
+                embed_offset += img_patches
+
+        return torch.cat(original_order, dim=0)
+
+    def embed_input_ids(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        multimodal_embeddings: MultiModalEmbeddings | None = None,
+        *,
+        is_multimodal: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Mix vision/audio embeddings into token embeddings.
+
+        Training merges audio before tok_embeddings_norm and vision after it;
+        audio is pre-normed in embed_multimodal, so norming first is equivalent.
+        """
+        h = self.model.embed_tokens(input_ids)
+        h = self.model.tok_embeddings_norm(h)
+
+        if multimodal_embeddings is not None and is_multimodal is not None:
+            h = _merge_multimodal_embeddings(h, multimodal_embeddings, is_multimodal)
+
+        return h
+
+    def get_mm_mapping(self) -> MultiModelKeys:
+        return MultiModelKeys.from_string_field(
+            language_model="model",
+            connector=["vision_projection.", "perception_emb_norm."],
+            tower_model=["vision_model.", "audio_encoder."],
+        )

+"""Fused MuseSpark post-expert RMSNorm, route weighting and top-k sum."""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _post_expert_finalize_kernel(
+    x_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    tw_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    expert_ids_ptr,
+    expert_map_ptr,
+    HAS_EXPERT_MAP: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_ids,
+    idx_ptr,
+    PERMUTED: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_idx,
+    K,
+    H,
+    eps,
+    gain_center,
+    stride_xt,
+    stride_xk,
+    stride_twt,
+    stride_out,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_H: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    WEIGHT_FIRST: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    t = tl.program_id(0)
+    k = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+    offs = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_H)
+    k_mask = k < K
+    h_mask = offs < H
+    tw = tl.load(tw_ptr + t * stride_twt + k, mask=k_mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+    local = k_mask
+    if HAS_EXPERT_MAP:
+        expert = tl.load(expert_ids_ptr + t * stride_ids + k, mask=k_mask, other=-1)
+        local = k_mask & (
+            tl.load(expert_map_ptr + expert, mask=k_mask & (expert >= 0), other=-1) >= 0
+        )
+    if PERMUTED:
+        row = tl.load(idx_ptr + t * stride_idx + k, mask=k_mask, other=-1)
+        local = local & (row >= 0)
+        x_ptrs = x_ptr + row.to(tl.int64)[:, None] * stride_xt + offs[None, :]
+    else:
+        x_ptrs = x_ptr + t * stride_xt + k[:, None] * stride_xk + offs[None, :]
+    x = tl.load(
+        x_ptrs,
+        mask=local[:, None] & h_mask[None, :],
+        other=0.0,
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    if HAS_WEIGHT:
+        w = tl.load(w_ptr + offs, mask=h_mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32) + gain_center
+        if WEIGHT_FIRST:
+            x = x * w[None, :]
+    scale = tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(x * x, axis=1) / H + eps) * tw
+    acc = tl.sum(x * scale[:, None], axis=0)
+    if HAS_WEIGHT and not WEIGHT_FIRST:
+        acc = acc * w
+    tl.store(
+        out_ptr + t * stride_out + offs, acc.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=h_mask
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _post_expert_finalize_loop_kernel(
+    x_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    tw_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    expert_ids_ptr,
+    expert_map_ptr,
+    HAS_EXPERT_MAP: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_ids,
+    idx_ptr,
+    PERMUTED: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_idx,
+    K,
+    H,
+    eps,
+    gain_center,
+    stride_xt,
+    stride_xk,
+    stride_twt,
+    stride_out,
+    BLOCK_H: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    WEIGHT_FIRST: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    t = tl.program_id(0)
+    offs = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_H)
+    mask = offs < H
+    if HAS_WEIGHT:
+        w = tl.load(w_ptr + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32) + gain_center
+    acc = tl.zeros([BLOCK_H], dtype=tl.float32)
+    x_row = x_ptr + t * stride_xt
+    for k in range(K):
+        local = tl.full((), True, tl.int1)
+        if HAS_EXPERT_MAP:
+            expert = tl.load(expert_ids_ptr + t * stride_ids + k)
+            local = tl.load(expert_map_ptr + expert, mask=expert >= 0, other=-1) >= 0
+        if PERMUTED:
+            row = tl.load(idx_ptr + t * stride_idx + k)
+            local = local & (row >= 0)
+            x_k = x_ptr + row.to(tl.int64) * stride_xt
+        else:
+            x_k = x_row + k * stride_xk
+        x = tl.load(x_k + offs, mask=mask & local, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+        if HAS_WEIGHT and WEIGHT_FIRST:
+            x = x * w
+        var = tl.sum(x * x, axis=0) / H
+        y = x * (1.0 / tl.sqrt(var + eps))
+        if HAS_WEIGHT and not WEIGHT_FIRST:
+            y = y * w
+        tw = tl.load(tw_ptr + t * stride_twt + k).to(tl.float32)
+        acc += y * tw
+    tl.store(
+        out_ptr + t * stride_out + offs, acc.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=mask
+    )
+
+
+def fused_post_expert_finalize(
+    routed: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+    topk_weights: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    gain_center: float,
+    weight_first: bool,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    topk_ids: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    expert_map: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    permuted_idx: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``out[t] = sum_k tw[t, k] * norm(routed[t, k])`` written in ``out.dtype``.
+
+    Routes with a negative ``expert_map`` entry or ``permuted_idx == -1`` were
+    never written and are masked before the read.
+    """
+    if expert_map is not None:
+        assert topk_ids is not None and topk_ids.stride(1) == 1
+    if permuted_idx is not None:
+        assert permuted_idx.dtype == torch.int32 and permuted_idx.stride(1) == 1
+        T, K = permuted_idx.shape
+        H = routed.shape[-1]
+        stride_xt, stride_xk = routed.stride(0), 0
+    else:
+        T, K, H = routed.shape
+        stride_xt, stride_xk = routed.stride(0), routed.stride(1)
+    assert routed.stride(-1) == 1 and out.stride(1) == 1
+    assert topk_weights.stride(1) == 1
+    assert out.shape == (T, H) and topk_weights.shape == (T, K)
+    if T == 0:
+        return out
+    block_h = triton.next_power_of_2(H)
+    assert block_h <= 16384, "row too wide for the single-tile finalize"
+    block_k = triton.next_power_of_2(K)
+    tiled = block_k * block_h <= 65536
+    kernel = (
+        _post_expert_finalize_kernel if tiled else _post_expert_finalize_loop_kernel
+    )
+    tile_kwargs = {"BLOCK_K": block_k} if tiled else {}
+    kernel[(T,)](
+        routed,
+        weight if weight is not None else routed,
+        topk_weights,
+        out,
+        topk_ids if topk_ids is not None else topk_weights,
+        expert_map if expert_map is not None else topk_weights,
+        expert_map is not None,
+        topk_ids.stride(0) if topk_ids is not None else 0,
+        permuted_idx if permuted_idx is not None else topk_weights,
+        permuted_idx is not None,
+        permuted_idx.stride(0) if permuted_idx is not None else 0,
+        K,
+        H,
+        eps,
+        gain_center,
+        stride_xt,
+        stride_xk,
+        topk_weights.stride(0),
+        out.stride(0),
+        BLOCK_H=block_h,
+        HAS_WEIGHT=weight is not None,
+        WEIGHT_FIRST=weight_first,
+        num_warps=8 if (block_k * block_h if tiled else block_h) >= 4096 else 4,
+        **tile_kwargs,
+    )
+    return out

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Muse-Spark QK-norm + RoPE + KV-cache insert as one launch.
+
+Not a custom op since ``MuseSpark1xModel`` is ``@ignore_torch_compile``;
+re-enabling compile requires hiding the forward-context lookup from dynamo.
+"""
+
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+from vllm.config import get_current_vllm_config
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention.attention import get_attention_context
+
+# nvfp4 pages a different layout and keeps the unfused path.
+SUPPORTED_KV_CACHE_DTYPES = frozenset(
+    {"auto", "bfloat16", "float16", "fp8", "fp8_e4m3", "fp8_e5m2"}
+)
+
+
+def supports_fused_kv_insert(attn_layer: torch.nn.Module) -> bool:
+    """Whether this attention layer's backend and cache can take the insert.
+
+    The backend must keep its KV write out of ``forward``. Off under DCP, whose
+    FlashInfer prefill attends over the raw new-token k/v.
+    """
+    parallel_config = get_current_vllm_config().parallel_config
+    if parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size > 1:
+        return False
+    if attn_layer.attn_backend.forward_includes_kv_cache_update:
+        return False
+    if not attn_layer.attn_backend.supports_kv_cache_update_bypass:
+        return False
+    if attn_layer.kv_sharing_target_layer_name is not None:
+        return False
+    return attn_layer.kv_cache_dtype in SUPPORTED_KV_CACHE_DTYPES
+
+
+def fused_qk_norm_rope_kv_insert(
+    qkv: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor | None,
+    layer_name: str,
+    num_heads: int,
+    num_kv_heads: int,
+    head_dim: int,
+    rotary_dim: int,
+    eps: float,
+) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+    """Norm/rotate and insert KV; return FP8 Q when all attention tokens use it."""
+    metadata, attn_layer, kv_cache, slot_mapping = get_attention_context(layer_name)
+
+    q_fp8 = None
+    if attn_layer.attn_backend.get_name() == "FLASHINFER" and metadata is not None:
+        # SM90 may mix FP8 prefill Q with BF16 decode Q; emit FP8 Q only when
+        # every token uses it. The builder's Q dtypes are fixed for its
+        # lifetime, so full CUDA graph replays stay consistent.
+        from vllm.v1.attention.backends.flashinfer import FlashInferMetadata
+
+        if (
+            isinstance(metadata, FlashInferMetadata)
+            and metadata.num_actual_tokens > 0
+            and attn_layer.kv_cache_dtype in ("fp8", "fp8_e4m3")
+            and attn_layer._q_scale.numel() == 1
+            and (
+                metadata.num_prefill_tokens == 0
+                or metadata.q_data_type_prefill == torch.float8_e4m3fn
+            )
+            and (
+                metadata.num_decode_tokens == 0
+                or metadata.q_data_type_decode == torch.float8_e4m3fn
+            )
+        ):
+            q_fp8 = torch.empty(
+                (qkv.shape[0], num_heads * head_dim),
+                dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn,
+                device=qkv.device,
+            )
+
+    # No cache bound (profiling) or no slots: skip the insert, still norm+rotate.
+    insert = slot_mapping is not None and kv_cache.numel() > 0
+    insert_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    if insert:
+        kv_cache_dtype = attn_layer.kv_cache_dtype
+        is_fp8 = kv_cache_dtype not in ("auto", "bfloat16", "float16")
+        insert_kwargs = {
+            "slot_mapping": slot_mapping,
+            "kv_cache": kv_cache,
+            "block_size": kv_cache.shape[2],
+            "kv_cache_dtype": kv_cache_dtype,
+            "k_scale": attn_layer._k_scale if is_fp8 else None,
+            "v_scale": attn_layer._v_scale if is_fp8 else None,
+        }
+
+    ops.fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert(
+        qkv,
+        positions,
+        num_heads,
+        num_kv_heads,
+        head_dim,
+        eps,
+        cos_sin_cache=cos_sin_cache,
+        rotary_dim=rotary_dim,
+        q_fp8_out=q_fp8,
+        q_scale=attn_layer._q_scale if q_fp8 is not None else None,
+        **insert_kwargs,
+    )
+    return q_fp8

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Triton RMSNorm for MuseSpark1x, optionally fused with the gated residual add."""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+try:
+    from flashinfer.norm import gated_residual_rmsnorm as postnorm_gated_residual
+    from flashinfer.norm import supports_gated_residual_rmsnorm
+except (ImportError, AttributeError):  # pragma: no cover - optional FlashInfer API
+    postnorm_gated_residual = None
+
+    def supports_gated_residual_rmsnorm(*_args: object) -> bool:
+        return False
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _fast2sum(a, b):
+    """Fast2Sum: ``a + b == s + e`` exactly; requires ``|a| >= |b|``."""
+    s = a + b
+    z = s - a
+    return s, b - z
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _effective_weight(w_ptr, d, dm, gain_center):
+    """``weight + gain_center`` in fp32; the norm rounds only at its store."""
+    return tl.load(w_ptr + d, mask=dm, other=0.0).to(tl.float32) + gain_center
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _blend_and_store(
+    y_ptr,
+    s_ptr,
+    alpha_ptr,
+    beta_ptr,
+    idx,
+    d,
+    mask,
+    dm,
+    y,
+    alpha_scalar,
+    GATE_STREAM: tl.constexpr,
+    PER_CHANNEL: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """Store ``alpha * stream + beta * y``; ``y`` stays fp32 (one rounding fewer)."""
+    stream = tl.load(s_ptr + idx, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+
+    if PER_CHANNEL:
+        beta = tl.load(beta_ptr + d, mask=dm, other=0.0)[None, :]
+    else:
+        beta = tl.load(beta_ptr)
+
+    if GATE_STREAM:
+        if PER_CHANNEL:
+            alpha = tl.load(alpha_ptr + d, mask=dm, other=0.0)[None, :]
+        else:
+            alpha = tl.load(alpha_ptr)
+        out = alpha * stream + beta * y
+    else:
+        out = alpha_scalar * stream + beta * y
+
+    tl.store(y_ptr + idx, out.to(y_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=mask)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _rmsnorm_fwd_kernel(
+    x_ptr,
+    y_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    s_ptr,
+    alpha_ptr,
+    beta_ptr,
+    T,
+    D: tl.constexpr,
+    eps,
+    gain_center,
+    alpha_scalar,
+    HAS_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    INPUT_SCALE: tl.constexpr,
+    KAHAN: tl.constexpr,
+    SINGLE_TILE: tl.constexpr,
+    RESIDUAL: tl.constexpr,
+    GATE_STREAM: tl.constexpr,
+    PER_CHANNEL: tl.constexpr,
+    bT: tl.constexpr,
+    bD: tl.constexpr,
+    USE_PDL: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """RMSNorm over the last dim of ``[T, D]``; fp32 math, the store rounds once.
+
+    ``KAHAN`` uses compensated fp32 instead of fp64 for the cross-tile sum
+    (Blackwell runs fp64 at 1/64 rate).
+    """
+    if USE_PDL:
+        tl.extra.cuda.gdc_wait()
+
+    t_idx = tl.program_id(0)
+    t = t_idx * bT + tl.arange(0, bT)
+    tm = t < T
+
+    if SINGLE_TILE:
+        d = tl.arange(0, bD)
+        dm = d < D
+        idx = t[:, None] * D + d[None, :]
+        mask = tm[:, None] & dm[None, :]
+
+        x = tl.load(x_ptr + idx, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+        if HAS_WEIGHT:
+            w = _effective_weight(w_ptr, d, dm, gain_center)
+
+        if INPUT_SCALE and HAS_WEIGHT:
+            x = x * w[None, :]
+
+        sum_sq = tl.sum(x * x, axis=1)
+        y = x * tl.rsqrt(sum_sq * (1.0 / D) + eps)[:, None]
+
+        if RESIDUAL:
+            if HAS_WEIGHT and not INPUT_SCALE:
+                y = y * w[None, :]
+            _blend_and_store(
+                y_ptr,
+                s_ptr,
+                alpha_ptr,
+                beta_ptr,
+                idx,
+                d,
+                mask,
+                dm,
+                y,
+                alpha_scalar,
+                GATE_STREAM=GATE_STREAM,
+                PER_CHANNEL=PER_CHANNEL,
+            )
+        else:
+            if HAS_WEIGHT and not INPUT_SCALE:
+                y = y * w[None, :]
+            tl.store(y_ptr + idx, y.to(y_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=mask)
+    else:
+        if KAHAN:
+            sum_sq = tl.zeros([bT], dtype=tl.float32)
+            compensation = tl.zeros([bT], dtype=tl.float32)
+        else:
+            sum_sq = tl.zeros([bT], dtype=tl.float64)
+
+        for do in tl.range(0, D, bD):
+            d = do + tl.arange(0, bD)
+            dm = d < D
+            x = tl.load(
+                x_ptr + t[:, None] * D + d[None, :],
+                mask=tm[:, None] & dm[None, :],
+                other=0.0,
+                eviction_policy="evict_last",
+            ).to(tl.float32)
+            if INPUT_SCALE and HAS_WEIGHT:
+                w = _effective_weight(w_ptr, d, dm, gain_center)
+                x = x * w[None, :]
+            tile_sum = tl.sum(x * x, axis=1)
+            if KAHAN:
+                sum_sq, compensation = _fast2sum(sum_sq, tile_sum + compensation)
+            else:
+                sum_sq += tile_sum.to(tl.float64)
+
+        # Cast here so the fp64 accumulator does not promote the row multiply
+        # to fp64 (1/64 rate on Blackwell, and unlike the fp32 reference).
+        rstd = tl.rsqrt(sum_sq * (1.0 / D) + eps).to(tl.float32)
+
+        for do in tl.range(0, D, bD):
+            d = do + tl.arange(0, bD)
+            dm = d < D
+            idx = t[:, None] * D + d[None, :]
+            mask = tm[:, None] & dm[None, :]
+            x = tl.load(
+                x_ptr + idx, mask=mask, other=0.0, eviction_policy="evict_first"
+            ).to(tl.float32)
+            if HAS_WEIGHT:
+                w = _effective_weight(w_ptr, d, dm, gain_center)
+            if INPUT_SCALE and HAS_WEIGHT:
+                x = x * w[None, :]
+            if RESIDUAL:
+                y = x * rstd[:, None]
+                if HAS_WEIGHT and not INPUT_SCALE:
+                    y = y * w[None, :]
+                _blend_and_store(
+                    y_ptr,
+                    s_ptr,
+                    alpha_ptr,
+                    beta_ptr,
+                    idx,
+                    d,
+                    mask,
+                    dm,
+                    y,
+                    alpha_scalar,
+                    GATE_STREAM=GATE_STREAM,
+                    PER_CHANNEL=PER_CHANNEL,
+                )
+            else:
+                y = x * rstd[:, None]
+                if HAS_WEIGHT and not INPUT_SCALE:
+                    y = y * w[None, :]
+                tl.store(y_ptr + idx, y.to(y_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=mask)
+
+
+def fused_rmsnorm_fwd(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    w: torch.Tensor | None,
+    eps: float,
+    *,
+    gain_center: float = 0.0,
+    input_scale: bool = False,
+    use_kahan_summation: bool = True,
+    out: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    out_dtype: torch.dtype | None = None,
+    residual_stream: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    alpha: torch.Tensor | float | None = None,
+    beta: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """RMSNorm with a gain-centred weight, applied before or after the norm.
+
+    With ``residual_stream`` it returns ``alpha * residual_stream + beta * norm(x)``.
+    """
+    input_shape = x.shape
+    x = x.reshape(-1, x.shape[-1])
+    assert x.is_contiguous(), "fused RMSNorm requires a contiguous input"
+
+    T, D = x.shape
+    if w is None:
+        assert gain_center == 0.0, "gain_center requires a weight"
+        assert not input_scale, "input_scale requires a weight"
+    else:
+        assert w.shape == (D,), f"weight must be [{D}], got {tuple(w.shape)}"
+        assert w.stride(-1) == 1, "fused RMSNorm requires a contiguous weight"
+
+    residual = residual_stream is not None
+    gate_stream = False
+    per_channel = False
+    alpha_scalar = 1.0
+    if residual_stream is not None:
+        assert beta is not None, "residual_stream requires beta"
+        assert alpha is not None, "residual_stream requires alpha"
+        assert residual_stream.shape == input_shape, (
+            f"residual_stream must have x's shape {tuple(input_shape)}, got "
+            f"{tuple(residual_stream.shape)}"
+        )
+        residual_stream = residual_stream.reshape(-1, D)
+        assert residual_stream.is_contiguous(), (
+            "fused RMSNorm requires a contiguous residual_stream"
+        )
+        assert beta.numel() in (1, D), (
+            f"beta must be [1] or [{D}], got {tuple(beta.shape)}"
+        )
+        assert beta.is_contiguous(), "fused RMSNorm requires a contiguous beta"
+        if isinstance(alpha, torch.Tensor):
+            gate_stream = True
+            assert alpha.shape == beta.shape, (
+                f"alpha {tuple(alpha.shape)} and beta {tuple(beta.shape)} must match"
+            )
+            assert alpha.is_contiguous(), "fused RMSNorm requires a contiguous alpha"
+        else:
+            alpha_scalar = float(alpha)
+        per_channel = beta.numel() > 1
+
+    if (
+        postnorm_gated_residual is not None
+        and residual_stream is not None
+        and out is None
+        and (out_dtype is None or out_dtype == torch.float32)
+        and D == 8192
+        and x.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and residual_stream.dtype == torch.float32
+        and isinstance(alpha, torch.Tensor)
+        and alpha.dtype == torch.float32
+        and alpha.numel() == D
+        and beta is not None
+        and beta.dtype == torch.float32
+        and beta.numel() == D
+        and ((w is None and not input_scale) or (w is not None and input_scale))
+        and (w is None or w.dtype == torch.bfloat16)
+        and supports_gated_residual_rmsnorm(x, residual_stream, w, alpha, beta)
+    ):
+        return postnorm_gated_residual(
+            x,
+            residual_stream,
+            w,
+            alpha,
+            beta,
+            eps,
+            gain_center,
+        ).view(input_shape)
+
+    if out is None:
+        y = torch.empty_like(residual_stream if residual else x, dtype=out_dtype)
+    else:
+        assert out_dtype is None or out.dtype == out_dtype, (
+            f"out is {out.dtype}, out_dtype says {out_dtype}"
+        )
+        assert out.shape == input_shape, "out must have x's shape"
+        y = out.reshape(-1, D)
+        assert y.is_contiguous(), "out must be contiguous"
+
+    tile_elems = 8192
+    bD = min(triton.next_power_of_2(D), tile_elems)
+    # The residual epilogue's fp32 stream + blend make a full-width tile spill
+    # at larger T. B300, D=8192 (us, median): T=512 wants bD 4096 (14.4 vs
+    # 18.1), T=8192 wants 2048 (136.6 vs 170.1); T=1 keeps the single tile
+    # (8.2 vs 12.3 at bD 2048).
+    if residual:
+        if T >= 2048:
+            bD = min(bD, 2048)
+        elif T >= 128:
+            bD = min(bD, 4096)
+    bT = max(1, triton.next_power_of_2(tile_elems // bD))
+    # A full-width residual tile is register-bound; extra warps hide spills.
+    num_warps = 16 if residual and bD >= D else 8
+
+    enable_pdl = current_platform.is_cuda() and current_platform.is_arch_support_pdl()
+    _rmsnorm_fwd_kernel[(triton.cdiv(T, bT),)](
+        x,
+        y,
+        w,
+        # Unused pointers must be valid; constexprs keep them undereferenced.
+        residual_stream if residual else x,
+        alpha if gate_stream else (beta if residual else x),
+        beta if residual else x,
+        T,
+        D=D,
+        eps=eps,
+        gain_center=gain_center,
+        alpha_scalar=alpha_scalar,
+        HAS_WEIGHT=w is not None,
+        INPUT_SCALE=input_scale,
+        KAHAN=use_kahan_summation,
+        SINGLE_TILE=bD >= D,
+        RESIDUAL=residual,
+        GATE_STREAM=gate_stream,
+        PER_CHANNEL=per_channel,
+        bT=bT,
+        bD=bD,
+        num_warps=num_warps,
+        USE_PDL=enable_pdl,
+        **({"launch_pdl": True} if enable_pdl else {}),
+    )
+    return y.view(input_shape)
+
+
+# The whole row must be live for the second norm, so this path is single-tile.
+_BOUNDARY_TILE_ELEMS = 8192
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize_on_alignment=["T"])
+def _norm_residual_norm_fwd_kernel(
+    branch_ptr,
+    stream_ptr,
+    new_stream_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    post_w_ptr,
+    pre_w_ptr,
+    alpha_ptr,
+    beta_ptr,
+    T,
+    D: tl.constexpr,
+    post_eps,
+    pre_eps,
+    post_gain_center,
+    pre_gain_center,
+    alpha_scalar,
+    POST_HAS_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    POST_INPUT_SCALE: tl.constexpr,
+    PRE_HAS_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    PRE_INPUT_SCALE: tl.constexpr,
+    GATE_STREAM: tl.constexpr,
+    PER_CHANNEL: tl.constexpr,
+    bT: tl.constexpr,
+    bD: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """One residual boundary: post-norm, gated add, and the next pre-norm."""
+    t = tl.program_id(0) * bT + tl.arange(0, bT)
+    tm = t < T
+    d = tl.arange(0, bD)
+    dm = d < D
+    idx = t[:, None] * D + d[None, :]
+    mask = tm[:, None] & dm[None, :]
+
+    # All loads before the first reduction: at decode this is latency-bound.
+    x = tl.load(branch_ptr + idx, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+    stream = tl.load(stream_ptr + idx, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+    if PER_CHANNEL:
+        beta = tl.load(beta_ptr + d, mask=dm, other=0.0)[None, :]
+    else:
+        beta = tl.load(beta_ptr)
+    if GATE_STREAM:
+        if PER_CHANNEL:
+            alpha = tl.load(alpha_ptr + d, mask=dm, other=0.0)[None, :]
+        else:
+            alpha = tl.load(alpha_ptr)
+    if POST_HAS_WEIGHT:
+        post_w = _effective_weight(post_w_ptr, d, dm, post_gain_center)
+    if PRE_HAS_WEIGHT:
+        pre_w = _effective_weight(pre_w_ptr, d, dm, pre_gain_center)
+
+    if POST_INPUT_SCALE and POST_HAS_WEIGHT:
+        x = x * post_w[None, :]
+    sum_sq = tl.sum(x * x, axis=1)
+    y = x * tl.rsqrt(sum_sq * (1.0 / D) + post_eps)[:, None]
+    if POST_HAS_WEIGHT and not POST_INPUT_SCALE:
+        y = y * post_w[None, :]
+
+    if GATE_STREAM:
+        new_stream = alpha * stream + beta * y
+    else:
+        new_stream = alpha_scalar * stream + beta * y
+    tl.store(
+        new_stream_ptr + idx,
+        new_stream.to(new_stream_ptr.dtype.element_ty),
+        mask=mask,
+    )
+
+    z = new_stream
+    if PRE_INPUT_SCALE and PRE_HAS_WEIGHT:
+        z = z * pre_w[None, :]
+    pre_sum_sq = tl.sum(z * z, axis=1)
+    z = z * tl.rsqrt(pre_sum_sq * (1.0 / D) + pre_eps)[:, None]
+    if PRE_HAS_WEIGHT and not PRE_INPUT_SCALE:
+        z = z * pre_w[None, :]
+
+    tl.store(out_ptr + idx, z.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=mask)
+
+
+def supports_norm_residual_norm(
+    branch: torch.Tensor,
+    stream: torch.Tensor,
+) -> bool:
+    """Whether :func:`fused_norm_residual_norm_fwd` can serve this boundary."""
+    if not (branch.is_cuda and stream.is_cuda):
+        return False
+    if branch.shape != stream.shape or branch.ndim < 2:
+        return False
+    if stream.dtype is not torch.float32:
+        return False
+    if not (branch.is_contiguous() and stream.is_contiguous()):
+        return False
+    return triton.next_power_of_2(branch.shape[-1]) <= _BOUNDARY_TILE_ELEMS
+
+
+def fused_norm_residual_norm_fwd(
+    branch: torch.Tensor,
+    stream: torch.Tensor,
+    post_weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+    pre_weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+    post_eps: float,
+    pre_eps: float,
+    *,
+    alpha: torch.Tensor | float,
+    beta: torch.Tensor,
+    post_gain_center: float = 0.0,
+    pre_gain_center: float = 0.0,
+    post_input_scale: bool = False,
+    pre_input_scale: bool = False,
+    out_dtype: torch.dtype | None = None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """A whole residual boundary in one kernel.
+
+    Computes, in fp32::
+
+        new_stream = alpha * stream + beta * post_norm(branch)
+        out = pre_norm(new_stream)
+
+    Only the sum-of-squares order differs from two ``fused_rmsnorm_fwd`` calls;
+    vs fp64 at D=8192, 9e-6 of the bf16 outputs differ by one ulp.
+    """
+    input_shape = branch.shape
+    assert supports_norm_residual_norm(branch, stream), (
+        "fused norm/residual/norm boundary: unsupported branch "
+        f"{tuple(branch.shape)}:{branch.dtype} over stream "
+        f"{tuple(stream.shape)}:{stream.dtype}; check "
+        "supports_norm_residual_norm() first"
+    )
+
+    branch = branch.reshape(-1, input_shape[-1])
+    stream = stream.reshape(-1, input_shape[-1])
+    T, D = branch.shape
+
+    for weight, gain_center, input_scale, name in (
+        (post_weight, post_gain_center, post_input_scale, "post"),
+        (pre_weight, pre_gain_center, pre_input_scale, "pre"),
+    ):
+        if weight is None:
+            assert gain_center == 0.0, f"{name}_gain_center requires a weight"
+            assert not input_scale, f"{name}_input_scale requires a weight"
+        else:
+            assert weight.shape == (D,), (
+                f"{name}_weight must be [{D}], got {tuple(weight.shape)}"
+            )
+            assert weight.stride(-1) == 1, f"{name}_weight must be contiguous"
+
+    assert beta.numel() in (1, D), f"beta must be [1] or [{D}], got {tuple(beta.shape)}"
+    assert beta.is_contiguous(), "beta must be contiguous"
+    per_channel = beta.numel() > 1
+    gate_stream = isinstance(alpha, torch.Tensor)
+    alpha_scalar = 1.0
+    if gate_stream:
+        assert isinstance(alpha, torch.Tensor)
+        assert alpha.shape == beta.shape, (
+            f"alpha {tuple(alpha.shape)} and beta {tuple(beta.shape)} must match"
+        )
+        assert alpha.is_contiguous(), "alpha must be contiguous"
+    else:
+        alpha_scalar = float(alpha)
+
+    out = torch.empty_like(branch, dtype=out_dtype)
+    new_stream = torch.empty_like(stream)
+
+    bD = triton.next_power_of_2(D)
+    bT = max(1, _BOUNDARY_TILE_ELEMS // bD)
+
+    num_warps = 32 if bD >= 8192 else (16 if bD >= 4096 else 8)
+    if D == 8192 and T >= 256 and current_platform.is_device_capability(100):
+        bT = 2
+        num_warps = 8
+    if current_platform.is_rocm():
+        # 64-thread wavefronts: 32 warps would exceed the 1024-thread limit.
+        num_warps = min(num_warps, 16)
+    _norm_residual_norm_fwd_kernel[(triton.cdiv(T, bT),)](
+        branch,
+        stream,
+        new_stream,
+        out,
+        # Unused pointers must be valid; constexprs keep them undereferenced.
+        post_weight if post_weight is not None else branch,
+        pre_weight if pre_weight is not None else branch,
+        alpha if gate_stream else beta,
+        beta,
+        T,
+        D=D,
+        post_eps=post_eps,
+        pre_eps=pre_eps,
+        post_gain_center=post_gain_center,
+        pre_gain_center=pre_gain_center,
+        alpha_scalar=alpha_scalar,
+        POST_HAS_WEIGHT=post_weight is not None,
+        POST_INPUT_SCALE=post_input_scale,
+        PRE_HAS_WEIGHT=pre_weight is not None,
+        PRE_INPUT_SCALE=pre_input_scale,
+        GATE_STREAM=gate_stream,
+        PER_CHANNEL=per_channel,
+        bT=bT,
+        bD=bD,
+        num_warps=num_warps,
+    )
+    return out.view(input_shape), new_stream.view(input_shape)
